  allocation_method varchar [note: 'Method by which participants are assigned to study arms. \'Randomized\' indicates use of RTSM/IRT for random assignment; \'non-randomized\' indicates assignment by investigator or other non-random method. Drives RTSM configuration in Medidata Rave and Oracle Clinical One.']

  amendment_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the protocol amendment per regulatory definitions. \'Substantial\' amendments require prior regulatory authority and IRB/IEC approval before implementation; \'non-substantial\' require notification only; \'administrative\' are clerical corrections with no impact on study conduct or subject safety.']

  intervention_model varchar [note: 'Describes the strategy for assigning interventions to participants. Determines the statistical analysis plan (SAP) structure, number of arms, and eCRF design in Medidata Rave. Aligns with CDISC SDTM ARM domain.']
  irb_iec_notification_status varchar [note: 'Status of the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) notification or approval for this protocol version or amendment. Tracks compliance with ethics review requirements across jurisdictions. Sourced from Veeva Vault regulatory module.']
  is_adaptive_design boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the study employs an adaptive design allowing pre-specified modifications to the trial or statistical procedures based on interim data analysis. Triggers additional regulatory review requirements and DSMB/DMC oversight obligations.']
  is_pediatric boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the study includes a pediatric population (subjects under 18 years). Triggers Pediatric Investigation Plan (PIP) requirements under EMA and Pediatric Study Plan (PSP) under FDA PREA/BPCA, and specific ICF/assent requirements.']

  number_of_arms varchar [note: 'Total count of treatment arms (groups) defined in the protocol. Drives RTSM randomization configuration, eCRF arm assignment, and statistical analysis plan (SAP) structure. Must be consistent with the intervention model.']
  planned_duration_months varchar [note: 'Total planned duration of the study in months from first subject first visit (FSFV) to last subject last visit (LSLV) or database lock (DBL), as specified in the protocol.   planned_end_date date [note: 'Anticipated date of last subject last visit (LSLV) or database lock (DBL) as defined in the protocol and project plan. Used for resource planning, regulatory submission timelines, and study close-out activities.']
  planned_sample_size varchar [note: 'Total number of subjects planned for enrollment across all study sites and arms as specified in the protocol. Derived from the statistical power calculation in the SAP. Used for site feasibility, patient recruitment planning, and IP supply forecasting.']
  planned_start_date date [note: 'Anticipated date of first subject first visit (FSFV) or study initiation as defined in the protocol and project plan. Used for milestone tracking, site activation planning, and regulatory submission timelines in Oracle Siebel CTMS.']
  primary_endpoint varchar [note: 'The principal outcome measure used to evaluate the primary objective of the study. Defines the variable, measurement method, timepoint, and population. Drives eCRF design in Medidata Rave and the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP).']
  primary_objective varchar [note: 'Formal statement of the primary scientific objective of the study as defined in the protocol. Describes the main question the study is designed to answer. Directly linked to the primary endpoint and powers the sample size calculation.']
  primary_purpose varchar [note: 'The primary reason for conducting the clinical study. Determines regulatory pathway, endpoint requirements, and IRB/IEC review criteria. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: treatment|prevention|diagnostic|supportive_care|screening|health_services_research|basic_science|device_feasibility — promote to reference product]']
  protocol_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known, sponsor-assigned unique alphanumeric identifier for the clinical study protocol (e.g., ABC-2024-001). Used across all regulatory submissions, site documents, and operational systems as the primary business key. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One.']
  protocol_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the protocol version. \'draft\' indicates under development; \'approved\' indicates IRB/IEC and sponsor approval obtained; \'amended\' indicates a formal amendment is in effect; \'superseded\' indicates replaced by a newer version; \'final\' indicates study completed and protocol finalized; \'retired\' indicates withdrawn. Sourced from Veeva Vault quality management workflow.']
  registry_identifier varchar [note: 'Public clinical trial registry identifier such as ClinicalTrials.gov NCT number (e.g., NCT12345678) or WHO ICTRP identifier. Required by ICMJE for publication eligibility and by FDA/EMA for transparency. Sourced from Oracle Siebel CTMS.']
  regulatory_submission_status varchar [note: 'Status of the regulatory authority submission for this protocol version or amendment (e.g., IND amendment to FDA, CTA variation to EMA/MHRA). Tracks compliance with regulatory notification and approval requirements. Sourced from Veeva Vault regulatory submissions module.']
  secondary_objectives varchar [note: 'Summary of secondary scientific objectives of the study as defined in the protocol. Describes additional questions the study is designed to address beyond the primary objective. Linked to secondary endpoints in the SAP.']
  short_title varchar [note: 'Abbreviated or lay-language title of the clinical study used in operational communications, CTMS displays, patient-facing materials, and internal reporting. Distinct from the full regulatory title.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Operational system of record from which this protocol record was sourced. Primary sources are Oracle Clinical One (study design and protocol configuration) and Veeva Vault (eTMF and regulatory document management). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.']
  source_system_identifier varchar [note: 'Native record identifier from the originating operational system (Oracle Clinical One study ID or Veeva Vault document ID). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the system of record for audit and reconciliation purposes.']
  study_phase varchar [note: 'ICH-defined phase of clinical development for the investigational product. Determines regulatory requirements, sample size expectations, and study design complexity. \'Not Applicable\' used for non-IND studies such as device or observational studies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Phase I|Phase I/II|Phase II|Phase II/III|Phase III|Phase IV|Not Applicable — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  study_population_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the target patient population for the study, including disease characteristics, demographic parameters, and key eligibility criteria summary. Used in IRB/IEC submissions, regulatory filings, and patient recruitment materials.']
  study_type varchar [note: 'Broad classification of the study design indicating whether participants receive an intervention or are observed. Determines applicable regulatory framework, IRB review requirements, and reporting obligations.']
  title varchar [note: 'Full official title of the clinical study protocol as it appears on the protocol document and regulatory submissions. Used in IRB/IEC submissions, clinical trial registries, and the Clinical Study Report (CSR).']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this protocol record in the source system or lakehouse. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and incremental data pipeline processing.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the protocol document (e.g., 1.0, 2.0, 3.1). Combined with protocol_number, uniquely identifies a specific iteration of the protocol. Incremented with each formal amendment. Sourced from Veeva Vault.']

  Note: 'Master record for the clinical study protocol including all formal amendments (version history). Captures protocol number, version, title, phase, therapeutic area, indication, investigational product, study design parameters (allocation method, intervention model, masking details, primary purpose, number of arms, adaptive design flags), primary/secondary objectives summary, study population description, planned sample size, study duration, sponsor reference, IND/CTA number, protocol status (draft, approved, amended, final), amendment history (amendment number, date, type, rationale, regulatory submission status, IRB/IEC notification, impact assessment), and GCP/ICH compliance declarations. This is the authoritative status field sourced from Oracle Siebel CTMS. Transitions are tracked in the study status history product.']
  study_type varchar [note: 'The fundamental classification of the clinical study design indicating whether participants receive an investigational intervention (Interventional), are observed without intervention (Observational), or receive investigational product outside a trial (Expanded Access). Determines applicable regulatory frameworks and GCP requirements.']
  target_enrollment varchar [note: 'The planned total number of subjects to be enrolled across all study sites as specified in the approved protocol and statistical analysis plan (SAP). Drives site allocation, recruitment planning, and power calculations. Sourced from Oracle Siebel CTMS.']
  termination_reason varchar [note: 'The documented reason for early termination of the clinical study when study_status is Terminated. Captures the primary rationale (e.g., Safety Concerns, Lack of Efficacy, Business Decision, Regulatory Hold, Enrollment Failure). Required for regulatory notifications and final CSR. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Safety Concerns|Lack of Efficacy|Business Decision|Regulatory Hold|Enrollment Failure|Sponsor Decision|Other — promote to reference product]']
  title varchar [note: 'The complete official title of the clinical study as stated in the approved protocol document. Used in regulatory submissions, IRB/IEC applications, informed consent forms, and the Trial Master File. Corresponds to the Protocol Title field in Oracle Siebel CTMS.']
  tmf_archival_date date [note: 'The date on which the Trial Master File (TMF) was formally archived following study close-out. The TMF must be retained for a minimum of 15 years (or longer per regional requirements) after study completion. Tracked in Veeva Vault eTMF.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when the study record was most recently modified in the source system (Oracle Siebel CTMS). Supports incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11.']

  Note: 'Top-level master entity representing a clinical trial as a business and operational unit. Captures the unique study identifier (sponsor study number, ClinicalTrials.gov NCT number, EudraCT number), study title, acronym, therapeutic area, indication, development phase, study type (interventional/observational), blinding type, randomization flag, study status with full lifecycle history (planned, startup, active, on-hold, completed, terminated), planned and actual start/end dates, target enrollment, closure details (DBL date, CSR submission, TMF archival), sponsor reference, and CRO assignment. SSOT for study identity and lifecycle state across all domains. Sourced from Oracle Siebel CTMS.'
}

Table study.arm {

  blinding_type varchar [note: 'Specifies the level of blinding applied to this arm: Open Label (no blinding), Single Blind (subject blinded), Double Blind (subject and investigator blinded), or Triple Blind (subject, investigator, and sponsor blinded).']

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Drug|Biologic|Device|Procedure|Behavioral|Dietary Supplement|Radiation|Genetic|Combination|Other — promote to reference product]']

  itt_population_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether subjects enrolled in this arm are included in the Intent-to-Treat (ITT) analysis population as defined in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP).']
  max_subjects_count varchar [note: 'The maximum allowable number of subjects that may be enrolled in this arm, including any over-enrollment buffer defined in the protocol. Distinct from planned_subjects_count which reflects the statistical target.']
  min_subjects_count varchar [note: 'The minimum number of subjects required in this arm to maintain statistical validity of the study, as defined in the SAP. Used for futility analysis and early stopping rule evaluation.']

  planned_subjects_count varchar [note: 'The planned (target) number of subjects to be enrolled and randomized into this arm as specified in the study protocol and statistical analysis plan (SAP).']

  protocol_version_ref varchar [note: 'The version identifier of the study protocol or protocol amendment under which this arm was defined or last modified. Ensures traceability of arm design to the governing protocol document.']
  randomization_ratio varchar [note: 'The allocation ratio for randomization of subjects into this arm relative to other arms (e.g., \'1:1\', \'2:1:1\'). Used by the RTSM/IRT system (Medidata Rave RTSM) to control subject assignment.']
  randomization_ratio_numeric decimal(5,2) [note: 'Numeric representation of the allocation weight for this arm relative to total allocation (e.g., 0.50 for a 1:1 ratio arm). Supports quantitative analysis and reporting of enrollment balance.']

  safety_population_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether subjects enrolled in this arm are included in the safety analysis population (all subjects who received at least one dose of study treatment), as defined in the SAP.']
  sdtm_arm_domain varchar [note: 'CDISC SDTM domain identifier confirming this arm maps to the ARM domain in the SDTM submission dataset. Always \'ARM\' per CDISC standard; included for regulatory submission traceability.']
  sequence_number varchar [note: 'Ordinal sequence number defining the display and processing order of arms within the study. Used for consistent ordering in reports, eCRFs, and SDTM datasets.']
  start_date date [note: 'The date on which the study arm became active and eligible for subject enrollment, as defined in the approved protocol or protocol amendment. Supports enrollment timeline tracking.']
  treatment_duration_days varchar [note: 'Planned duration of treatment for subjects in this arm, expressed in days. Used for supply planning, visit schedule design, and protocol compliance monitoring.']

  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this study arm record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11.']
  created_by varchar [note: 'The username or system identifier of the user or process that created this study arm record. Required for audit trail compliance under FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ (Attributable) principle.']

  Note: 'Defines each treatment arm or cohort within a clinical study. Records arm name, arm code, arm type (experimental, active comparator, placebo comparator, sham comparator, no intervention, other), description of intervention, planned number of subjects per arm, randomization ratio, arm status, and CDISC SDTM ARM domain mapping. Supports multi-arm and adaptive trial designs. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One.'

Table study.endpoint {
  endpoint_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for a study endpoint record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for the study_endpoint data product.']

  ctcae_version varchar [note: 'The version of the NCI Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) used to grade safety endpoints (e.g., \'5.0\', \'4.03\'). Applicable for oncology and safety-focused endpoints.']

  effective_until_date date [note: 'The date on which this endpoint definition was superseded or retired, typically aligned with a subsequent protocol amendment. Null for currently active endpoints. Supports temporal versioning.']

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: efficacy|safety|tolerability|PK_PD|quality_of_life|biomarker — promote to reference product]']
  endpoint_code varchar [note: 'Sponsor-assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this endpoint within the study (e.g., EP-PRI01, EP-SEC03). Used as the externally-known business identifier in SAP cross-references and regulatory submissions.']
  endpoint_description varchar [note: 'Full narrative description of the endpoint as defined in the study protocol, including the precise measurement, population, and timeframe. Directly referenced in regulatory submissions.']
  endpoint_name varchar [note: 'Short, human-readable name of the endpoint as it appears in the protocol and Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) (e.g., \'Overall Survival\', \'Change from Baseline in HbA1c at Week 24\').']
  endpoint_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the endpoint definition: draft (under authoring), active (protocol-approved), amended (modified via protocol amendment), retired (removed from protocol), locked (post-Database Lock). Drives SAP version control.']
  endpoint_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the endpoint role within the study hierarchy: primary (confirmatory, drives sample size), secondary (supportive), exploratory, safety, Pharmacokinetic (PK), Pharmacodynamic (PD), or biomarker. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: primary|secondary|exploratory|safety|PK|PD|biomarker — promote to reference product]']
  estimand_intercurrent_event_strategy varchar [note: 'The strategy for handling intercurrent events per ICH E9(R1): treatment_policy (ignore occurrence), hypothetical (counterfactual), composite (incorporate into outcome), while_on_treatment (restrict to on-treatment period), or principal_stratum (condition on intercurrent event status).']
  estimand_population varchar [note: 'The target population component of the ICH E9(R1) estimand, specifying the patient population to which the treatment effect applies (e.g., \'all randomised patients with baseline HbA1c ≥ 7.5%\').']
  estimand_population_level_summary varchar [note: 'The population-level summary measure component of the ICH E9(R1) estimand (e.g., \'difference in means\', \'hazard ratio\', \'odds ratio\'). Specifies how individual outcomes are aggregated to a treatment effect estimate.']
  estimand_treatment_condition varchar [note: 'The treatment condition component of the ICH E9(R1) estimand framework, describing the treatment regimen of interest (e.g., \'randomised treatment regardless of adherence\', \'treatment as prescribed\').']
  estimand_variable varchar [note: 'The variable component of the ICH E9(R1) estimand, defining the outcome measure for each patient (e.g., \'change from baseline in HbA1c at Week 24\'). Directly corresponds to the ADaM analysis variable.']
  measurement_instrument varchar [note: 'The validated instrument, scale, or tool used to measure the endpoint (e.g., RECIST 1.1, HAMD-17, SF-36, CTCAE v5.0, EORTC QLQ-C30). Required for regulatory submission and biostatistical analysis planning.']
  meddra_soc_code varchar [note: 'The MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC) code associated with this endpoint when the endpoint relates to an adverse event or safety outcome. Enables standardised safety reporting per ICH M1.']
  missing_data_strategy varchar [note: 'The pre-specified strategy for handling missing data for this endpoint per the SAP: Last Observation Carried Forward (LOCF), Baseline Observation Carried Forward (BOCF), Multiple Imputation (MI), Mixed Model for Repeated Measures (MMRM), observed cases only, worst-case, or best-case imputation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: LOCF|BOCF|MI|MMRM|observed_cases|worst_case|best_case — promote to reference product]']
  multiplicity_adjustment_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a multiplicity adjustment (e.g., Bonferroni, Holm, Hochberg, gatekeeping procedure) is applied to this endpoint to control the family-wise error rate. Critical for confirmatory trial design and regulatory acceptance.']
  multiplicity_procedure varchar [note: 'The specific statistical procedure used for multiplicity adjustment for this endpoint (e.g., \'Hochberg step-up\', \'Bonferroni\', \'Fixed-sequence testing\', \'Graphical gatekeeping\'). Populated only when multiplicity_adjustment_flag is True.']
  non_inferiority_margin decimal(18,6) [note: 'The pre-specified non-inferiority or equivalence margin (delta) for the endpoint, expressed in the unit of the primary outcome measure. Applicable only when statistical_hypothesis is non_inferiority or equivalence. Regulatory-critical value.']
  objective_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the study objective that this endpoint operationalises, enabling objective-to-endpoint traceability required by the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP).']
  objective_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the study objective associated with this endpoint: primary (confirmatory), secondary (supportive), exploratory (hypothesis-generating), or safety (adverse event characterisation).']
  protocol_section_reference varchar [note: 'The section number or heading in the study protocol document where this endpoint is formally defined (e.g., \'Section 3.2.1 Primary Endpoint\'). Enables direct cross-reference to the Trial Master File (TMF).']
  sap_section_reference varchar [note: 'The section number or heading in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) where the analysis method for this endpoint is specified. Provides the scientific rationale chain from objective through endpoint to SAP.']
  sdtm_domain varchar [note: 'The CDISC SDTM domain from which the source data for this endpoint is collected (e.g., AE, LB, EX, RS, TU, TR). Establishes the SDTM-to-ADaM data lineage chain required for regulatory submission.']
  sequence_number varchar [note: 'Ordinal position of this endpoint within its objective type group (e.g., 1st primary, 2nd secondary). Used for hierarchical ordering in the SAP and regulatory submission tables.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Identifies the operational system of record from which this endpoint definition originates: Medidata Rave (EDC), Oracle Clinical One (study design), SAS Drug Development (biostatistical analysis), or manual entry. Supports data lineage and audit.']
  source_system_endpoint_code varchar [note: 'The native identifier of this endpoint record in the originating operational system (e.g., Oracle Clinical One endpoint object ID, SAS Drug Development analysis parameter ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and ETL lineage.']
  statistical_hypothesis varchar [note: 'The formal statistical hypothesis framework applied to this endpoint: superiority (treatment better than control), non-inferiority (treatment not worse by a defined margin), equivalence (treatment within a symmetric margin), or descriptive (no formal hypothesis). Drives SAP design.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'The unit in which the endpoint outcome is expressed (e.g., \'months\', \'mg/dL\', \'mmHg\', \'score\', \'%\', \'events/patient-year\'). Required for ADaM AVALU mapping and regulatory submission.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this endpoint record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail and change control requirements.']

  Note: 'Defines the formal objectives and their associated endpoints (primary, secondary, exploratory) for a clinical study. Captures objective text, objective type, endpoint name, endpoint type (primary, secondary, exploratory, safety, PK, PD, biomarker), endpoint category (efficacy, safety, tolerability, PK/PD, quality of life), measurement instrument or scale, timepoint of assessment, statistical hypothesis (superiority, non-inferiority, equivalence), estimand definition per ICH E9(R1), objective-to-endpoint traceability, and CDISC ADaM parameter mapping. Provides the scientific rationale chain from objective through endpoint to SAP. Directly referenced by the biostatistics domain for analysis planning.'
}

  strength_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the investigational product strength (e.g., mg, mg/mL, IU). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mg|mg/mL|mg/kg|mcg|mcg/mL|IU|IU/mL|g|% — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tablet|capsule|vial|kit|syringe|patch|sachet|bottle|ampoule — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the investigational product master record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11, ALCOA+ principles, and change management tracking.']

  Note: 'Master record for the investigational medicinal product (IMP) or device used in a clinical study.   randomization_ratio varchar [note: 'Allocation ratio for randomization to this arm/regimen expressed as a colon-separated ratio (e.g., \'1:1\', \'2:1\', \'1:1:1\'). Used in RTSM/IRT configuration and statistical analysis plan (SAP) for sample size and power calculations.']
  regimen_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this dosing regimen within the study protocol (e.g., \'REG-001\', \'ARM-A-DOSE-1\'). Used in protocol documents, eCRFs, and CDISC SDTM EX submissions.']
  regimen_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the dosing regimen as defined in the study protocol (e.g., \'Low Dose QD\', \'High Dose BID\', \'Placebo TIW\'). Used in protocol documents, SAP, and CSR narratives.']
  regimen_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the dosing regimen within the study. \'draft\' indicates protocol development; \'active\' indicates currently administered; \'suspended\' indicates temporarily halted (e.g., pending safety review); \'discontinued\' indicates permanently stopped; \'completed\' indicates all subjects have completed this regimen.']
  sdtm_ex_mapping_notes varchar [note: 'Notes describing how this dosing regimen maps to the CDISC SDTM EX (Exposure) domain variables, including any derivation logic, controlled terminology mappings, or special handling required for regulatory submission datasets. Supports data lineage and ETL traceability in the Databricks Silver layer.']
  starting_dose_level decimal(18,6) [note: 'Initial dose amount at the start of the regimen, particularly relevant for titration or escalation regimens where the dose changes over time. Expressed in the same unit as dose_unit. Supports PK/PD baseline modeling.']

  washout_period_days varchar [note: 'Duration of the washout period in days required between treatment periods in crossover studies, or between prior therapy and study treatment. Null for parallel-group designs. Supports PK carryover analysis and crossover study scheduling.']

  alpha_level decimal(6,4) [note: 'Pre-specified Type I error rate (significance level) allocated to this objective in the SAP. Typically 0.05 for primary objectives or a fraction thereof when multiplicity adjustments are applied. Drives sample size calculations and hypothesis testing.']
  approved_date date [note: 'Date on which this objective (as part of the protocol or amendment) received formal approval from the sponsor and/or IRB/IEC. Marks the transition from draft to active status and is required for regulatory audit trails.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this study objective record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.']
  csr_section_reference varchar [note: 'Section number within the Clinical Study Report (CSR) where results for this objective are reported. Provides traceability from protocol objective through analysis to regulatory submission document per ICH E3 CSR structure.']
  ctd_section_reference varchar [note: 'Module and section reference within the Common Technical Document (CTD) / electronic CTD (eCTD) where this objective\'s results contribute to the regulatory dossier (e.g., Module 5.3.5.1). Supports regulatory submission traceability.']

  effective_end_date date [note: 'Date on which this version of the objective ceased to be effective, typically due to a protocol amendment superseding it. Null for currently active objectives. Supports temporal versioning of protocol objectives.']
  effective_start_date date [note: 'Date from which this version of the objective became effective in the approved protocol. For original protocol objectives, this is the initial protocol approval date. For amended objectives, this is the amendment approval date.']
  hypothesis_type varchar [note: 'Statistical hypothesis framework associated with this objective. Superiority objectives aim to demonstrate a treatment effect greater than control; non-inferiority objectives aim to show the treatment is not worse by a defined margin; equivalence objectives test for no meaningful difference; descriptive objectives have no formal hypothesis.']
  intercurrent_event_strategy varchar [note: 'ICH E9(R1) estimand attribute specifying the strategy for handling intercurrent events (post-randomization events that affect interpretation of the outcome) for this objective. Strategies include while-on-treatment, hypothetical, composite, principal stratum, and treatment policy.']
  irb_iec_review_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a change to this objective requires IRB/IEC review and approval (e.g., substantial protocol amendment). Drives the amendment workflow and site notification process.']
  last_amended_in_amendment_number varchar [note: 'Protocol amendment number in which this objective was most recently modified. Null if the objective has never been amended. Used to track the amendment history of each objective for regulatory submissions.']
  multiplicity_adjustment_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether statistical multiplicity adjustment (e.g., Bonferroni, Hochberg, hierarchical testing) is required for this objective due to multiple comparisons. Informs the SAP multiplicity control strategy.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional context, clarifications, or internal commentary related to this objective that does not fit structured fields. Used by data managers and biostatisticians during protocol development and SAP authoring.']
  objective_number varchar [note: 'Structured alphanumeric identifier for the objective within the protocol (e.g., P-1 for Primary Objective 1, S-2 for Secondary Objective 2). Used for cross-referencing in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) and Clinical Study Report (CSR).']
  objective_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the study objective. Draft objectives are under authoring review; active objectives are in the approved protocol; amended objectives have been modified by a protocol amendment; superseded objectives have been replaced; retired objectives have been removed from the protocol.']
  objective_text varchar [note: 'Full verbatim text of the study objective as stated in the approved protocol. This is the authoritative scientific statement of what the study aims to demonstrate or evaluate, used verbatim in regulatory submissions and the CSR.']
  objective_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the study objective by its scientific hierarchy and regulatory weight. Primary objectives drive the primary endpoint and sample size calculation; secondary objectives provide supportive evidence; exploratory objectives generate hypotheses. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: primary|secondary|exploratory|safety|pharmacokinetic|pharmacodynamic — promote to reference product]']
  population_description varchar [note: 'Description of the analysis population to which this objective applies (e.g., Intent-to-Treat (ITT), Per Protocol (PP), Safety Population). Aligns with the estimand population attribute per ICH E9(R1).']
  population_type varchar [note: 'Standardized code for the analysis population associated with this objective. Intent-to-Treat (ITT), modified ITT (mITT), Per Protocol (PP), Safety, Pharmacokinetic (PK), or Pharmacodynamic (PD) population. Drives dataset selection in SAS Drug Development CDISC ADaM programming.']
  protocol_section_reference varchar [note: 'Section number within the study protocol document where this objective is formally stated (e.g., Section 2.1, Section 3.2). Enables direct navigation to the source text in the protocol and eTMF.']
  regulatory_commitment_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this objective is a formal regulatory commitment (e.g., a post-marketing commitment to FDA or EMA, or a condition of approval). Regulatory commitment objectives require heightened change control and reporting.']
  sap_section_reference varchar [note: 'Section number or identifier within the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) that addresses the analysis corresponding to this objective. Provides direct traceability from protocol objective to statistical methodology, as required for regulatory submissions.']
  scientific_rationale varchar [note: 'Narrative justification for why this objective is scientifically important and how it contributes to the overall study goals. Supports regulatory review, protocol synopsis, and investigator brochure alignment.']
  sdtm_domain_reference varchar [note: 'CDISC SDTM domain(s) that contain the data supporting this objective (e.g., ADAE, ADEFF, ADTTE). Enables automated linkage between protocol objectives and SDTM/ADaM datasets in SAS Drug Development.']
  sequence_number varchar [note: 'Ordinal position of this objective within its objective type group (e.g., first primary objective = 1, second primary objective = 2). Governs display order in the protocol, SAP, and CSR sections.']
  short_title varchar [note: 'Concise human-readable label for the objective used in dashboards, reports, and CTMS displays where the full objective text is too lengthy. Typically 10–15 words summarizing the scientific intent.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Operational system of record from which this objective record was sourced or authored (e.g., Oracle Clinical One study design module, Veeva Vault protocol document). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the lakehouse.']
  source_system_record_code varchar [note: 'Native identifier of this objective record in the originating operational system (e.g., Oracle Clinical One objective GUID, Veeva Vault document section ID). Enables back-referencing and reconciliation with the system of record.']
  summary_measure varchar [note: 'Statistical summary measure used to quantify the treatment effect for this objective (e.g., difference in means, odds ratio, hazard ratio, response rate difference). Corresponds to the population-level summary attribute of the ICH E9(R1) estimand.']
  testing_hierarchy_level varchar [note: 'Numeric level in the hierarchical testing procedure for this objective. Level 1 is tested first; subsequent levels are tested only if the preceding level achieves statistical significance. Implements the gatekeeping strategy defined in the SAP.']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'Therapeutic area or disease indication to which this objective is aligned (e.g., Oncology, Cardiology, Neurology). Supports cross-study analytics and portfolio-level objective benchmarking.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this study objective record in the data platform. Required for change tracking, data lineage, and compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements.']
  variable_description varchar [note: 'Description of the variable (outcome measure) used to address this objective, as defined in the ICH E9(R1) estimand framework. Specifies what is measured on each subject to evaluate the treatment effect.']

  Note: 'Formally documents the primary, secondary, and exploratory objectives of a clinical study as stated in the protocol.   nominal_timepoint_label varchar [note: 'Descriptive label for the nominal PK sampling timepoint relative to dose administration (e.g., \'Pre-dose\', \'0.5h post-dose\', \'1h post-dose\', \'24h post-dose\'). Maps to CDISC SDTM PC.PCTPT.']

  nominal_timepoint_value decimal(10,4) [note: 'Numeric value of the nominal sampling timepoint relative to dose administration. Used for PK modeling and CDISC SDTM PC.PCTPTNUM mapping. Expressed in the unit defined by nominal_timepoint_unit.']
  number_of_aliquots varchar [note: 'Number of aliquots into which the collected sample must be divided for analysis, backup, and archival purposes. Drives sample labelling and supply requirements.']
  optional_sample boolean [note: 'Indicates whether collection of this sample is optional (e.g., exploratory biomarker, sub-study) or mandatory per the study protocol. Affects protocol deviation assessment.']
  pre_dose_sample boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this sampling timepoint is a pre-dose (trough) sample collected before drug administration. Used to assess baseline concentrations and trough levels.']
  processing_instructions varchar [note: 'Detailed instructions for processing the collected sample at the clinical site (e.g., centrifugation speed, time, temperature, aliquoting steps). Ensures sample integrity per bioanalytical method requirements.']
  protocol_version varchar [note: 'Version of the study protocol under which this PK/PD sampling schedule was defined or last amended. Enables traceability of schedule changes across protocol amendments.']
  required_sample_volume_ml decimal(8,3) [note: 'Volume of biological sample required for bioanalytical analysis, expressed in millilitres (mL). Used for supply planning, patient burden assessment, and protocol feasibility.']
  sample_type varchar [note: 'Biological matrix type to be collected for PK/PD analysis (e.g., blood, plasma, serum, urine, tissue). Maps to CDISC SDTM PC.PCSPEC. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: blood|plasma|serum|urine|cerebrospinal_fluid|tissue|saliva|feces|dried_blood_spot|other — promote to reference product]']
  sampling_category varchar [note: 'Classification of the sampling purpose: Pharmacokinetic (PK), Pharmacodynamic (PD), combined PK/PD, biomarker, immunogenicity, or safety assessment. Drives CDISC domain assignment (PC for PK, PP for PD).']
  schedule_code varchar [note: 'Unique alphanumeric code identifying this PK/PD sampling schedule entry within the study protocol. Used as the externally-known business identifier in CTMS and EDC systems such as Medidata Rave.']
  schedule_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name or label for this sampling schedule entry (e.g., \'Pre-dose Day 1\', \'2h Post-dose Cycle 2\'). Used in protocol documents and EDC eCRF annotations.']
  schedule_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of this PK/PD sampling schedule record. Tracks whether the schedule is in draft protocol design, active for data collection, amended via protocol amendment, retired, or cancelled.']
  sdtm_domain varchar [note: 'CDISC Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) domain to which this sampling record maps (e.g., PC for Pharmacokinetics Concentrations, PP for Pharmacokinetic Parameters). Required for regulatory submission datasets.']
  sdtm_pctptnum decimal(10,4) [note: 'Numeric representation of the planned timepoint as defined in CDISC SDTM PC.PCTPTNUM. Used for sorting and PK modeling in SAS Drug Development and ADaM datasets.']
  sequence_number varchar [note: 'Ordinal sequence number defining the order of this sampling timepoint within the visit or study day PK profile. Used for display ordering in eCRF and SDTM datasets.']
  shipping_condition varchar [note: 'Required temperature or condition for shipping the sample from the clinical site to the central or bioanalytical laboratory (e.g., dry ice, refrigerated, ambient).']
  sparse_sampling boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this timepoint is part of a sparse (population PK) sampling design rather than a full intensive PK profile. Drives population PK modeling strategy.']
  steady_state_sample boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this sampling timepoint is intended to characterize drug concentrations at pharmacokinetic steady state. Relevant for multiple-dose PK studies.']
  storage_temperature varchar [note: 'Required storage temperature condition for the collected sample prior to shipment to the bioanalytical laboratory (e.g., ambient, refrigerated 2-8°C, frozen -20°C, frozen -70°C). Critical for sample stability.']
  timepoint_reference varchar [note: 'The reference event from which the nominal timepoint is measured (e.g., first dose, previous dose, start of infusion, end of infusion). Maps to CDISC SDTM PC.PCTPTREF.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this PK/PD sampling schedule record was last modified. Supports audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.']
  window_lower_bound decimal(10,4) [note: 'Allowable lower deviation from the nominal timepoint for sample collection (expressed as a negative or zero offset in the same unit as nominal_timepoint_unit). Defines the acceptable collection window per protocol.']
  window_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the sampling window lower and upper bounds (e.g., minutes, hours, days).']
  window_upper_bound decimal(10,4) [note: 'Allowable upper deviation from the nominal timepoint for sample collection (expressed as a positive offset in the same unit as nominal_timepoint_unit). Defines the acceptable collection window per protocol.']

  Note: 'Defines the pharmacokinetic (PK) and pharmacodynamic (PD) blood/urine/tissue sampling schedule for a clinical study. Records sample type, nominal sampling timepoint (pre-dose, 0.5h, 1h, 2h, 4h, 8h, 24h post-dose, etc.), sampling window, visit association, analyte to be measured, bioanalytical method reference, sample volume, sample handling instructions, and CDISC SDTM PC (Pharmacokinetics Concentrations) domain mapping. Critical for DMPK studies.'
}

Table study.amendment_site_implementation {
  amendment_site_implementation_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the amendment_site_implementation association']
  study_protocol_amendment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the protocol amendment being implemented at this site.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the investigational site at which this amendment is being implemented.']
  edc_configuration_updated_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the site\'s Electronic Data Capture system has been updated to reflect the changes introduced by this amendment (e.g., new CRF fields, modified visit schedules, updated eligibility criteria).']
  implementation_date date [note: 'Date on which the site confirmed full operational implementation of the amendment, including staff training, EDC updates, and any required reconsent. Marks closure of the implementation workflow for this site.']
  implementation_deadline date [note: 'Sponsor or regulatory authority mandated deadline by which this site must complete implementation of the amendment. Used for escalation and compliance monitoring.']
  implementation_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the amendment implementation at this specific site. Drives operational follow-up by CRAs and clinical operations managers.']
  notification_date date [note: 'Date on which the site (principal investigator and study coordinator) was formally notified of this protocol amendment. Regulatory timelines for implementation are calculated from this date.']
  reconsent_completed_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether all currently enrolled subjects at this site who are impacted by the amendment have provided updated informed consent. Applicable only when the parent amendment has reconsent_required_flag = true.']
  sites_implemented_count varchar [note: 'Number of clinical investigative sites that have confirmed full implementation of the amendment, including staff training and updated procedures. Supports monitoring and close-out tracking. [Moved from study_protocol_amendment: This is a derived aggregate roll-up of implementation_status = \'implemented\' records in the amendment_site_implementation association. Same denormalization concern as sites_notified_count — should be computed, not stored on the amendment.]']
  sites_notified_count varchar [note: 'Number of clinical investigative sites that have been formally notified of this amendment. Used to track notification completeness against total active site count for the study. [Moved from study_protocol_amendment: This is a derived aggregate roll-up of notification_date records in the amendment_site_implementation association. It does not belong on the amendment itself — it should be computed from the association table. Storing it on study_protocol_amendment creates a denormalization that will drift out of sync.]']

  Note: 'This association product represents the Event between study_protocol_amendment and study_site. It captures the formal process by which each protocol amendment is communicated to, acknowledged by, and operationally implemented at a specific investigational site. Each record links one protocol amendment to one study site and carries implementation-specific attributes — status, dates, reconsent completion, and EDC update confirmation — that exist only in the context of this amendment-site pairing and belong to neither entity alone.. Existence Justification: In clinical trials, every protocol amendment must be formally implemented at each active investigational site — a site receives multiple amendments over a study\'s lifecycle, and each amendment must be tracked for implementation status, notification, and reconsent completion at every site independently. This is an operationally managed process: CRAs actively create, update, and close out amendment implementation records per site, making \'AmendmentSiteImplementation\' a genuine business entity that clinical operations teams manage daily. The relationship carries its own rich data (implementation_status, implementation_date, notification_date, reconsent_completed_flag, edc_configuration_updated_flag, implementation_deadline) that belongs to neither the amendment nor the site alone.'
}

Existence Justification: In clinical trials, an investigational product (IMP) is shipped to and stored at multiple investigational sites simultaneously across a study, and each site handles multiple IMPs across different studies. Managed by regulatory affairs teams as part of the country-level dossier lifecycle.. Existence Justification: In clinical trials, a single regulatory submission (e.g., a CTA package) can cover multiple countries simultaneously, and a single country\'s study activation requires multiple discrete submissions over time (initial CTA filing, substantial amendments, annual safety reports, responses to agency queries). The business actively manages and tracks each country-submission pairing as an operational record — regulatory affairs teams create, update, and close these records as part of the regulatory lifecycle. Table study.product_designation {

  special_designation_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the special regulatory designation record granted to this investigational product.']

Belongs to the association because the same product may receive different designations at different development phases. Sourced from detection phase relationship data.']
  designation_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the special regulatory designation as it applies to this specific investigational product pairing. Sourced from detection phase relationship data. Captures which type of expedited pathway applies in this product-designation context.']
  grant_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the health authority officially granted this specific designation to this specific investigational product. Belongs to the association because the same product may receive the same designation type at different dates for different indications. Sourced from detection phase relationship data.']
  indication_scope varchar [note: 'The specific disease, condition, or patient population for which this designation applies to this investigational product.   Note: 'This association product represents the regulatory designation grant relationship between an investigational_product and a special_designation. Each record links one investigational_product to one special_designation with attributes that exist only in the context of this product-designation pairing — such as the specific indication for which the designation was granted to that product and the applicable development phase.. Existence Justification: In clinical research, an investigational product (IMP) can receive multiple special regulatory designations simultaneously — e.g., a single drug may hold both Orphan Drug and Breakthrough Therapy designations from the FDA, plus a PRIME designation from the EMA, each for potentially different indications or scopes. Conversely, while a special designation is typically granted to a specific product-indication pair, a single designation record (e.g., an Orphan Drug designation for a rare disease) can in practice cover a product program that spans multiple formulations or related compounds. The business actively manages this relationship — regulatory affairs teams track which designations apply to which products, under what conditions, and for which indication scope, making this an operationally managed association with its own lifecycle data.'
}

  drug_shipment_auth_date date [note: 'Date on which authorization was granted to ship investigational medicinal product (IMP) to this site. A critical activation milestone managed via RTSM/IRT (e.g., Medidata RTSM). Shipment cannot proceed without IRB approval and regulatory clearance.']

  open_query_count varchar [note: 'Number of currently open data queries (discrepancies or clarification requests) raised against eCRF data submitted by this site in the EDC system. A key data quality KPI for site performance management.']

  protocol_number varchar [note: 'Sponsor-assigned protocol identifier for the study associated with this site. Denormalized here for operational convenience and regulatory traceability without requiring a join to the study entity.']

  screened_count varchar [note: 'Total number of subjects who have undergone screening procedures at this site, regardless of eligibility outcome. Used to calculate screen failure rate and assess site recruitment efficiency.']
  selection_date date [note: 'Date on which the site was formally selected by the sponsor or CRO for participation in the study, following feasibility assessment and committee review.']
  selection_rationale varchar [note: 'Narrative justification for selecting this site for the study, including patient population access, PI expertise, infrastructure capability, and prior performance. Captured during the site selection committee review.']
  site_closeout_date date [note: 'Date on which the formal site close-out visit was completed and the site was officially closed for this study. Triggers archival of site documents in eTMF and final reconciliation activities.']
  site_number varchar [note: 'Sponsor-assigned alphanumeric site number unique within the study protocol. Used in EDC, RTSM, and regulatory submissions to identify the site within the trial context. Typically formatted as a 3–10 character code (e.g., \'US001\', \'DE002\').']
  site_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the site within this study. Drives operational workflows in CTMS: candidate (under feasibility review), selected (approved for activation), initiated (Site Initiation Visit completed), enrolling (actively recruiting subjects), enrollment_complete (target met or enrollment closed), closed (site formally closed out).']
  siv_date date [note: 'Date on which the Site Initiation Visit (SIV) was conducted by the CRA. The SIV confirms site readiness, trains site staff on the protocol and EDC system, and is a key activation milestone before first subject enrollment.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to this study-site association record. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.']
  withdrawn_count varchar [note: 'Number of enrolled subjects who withdrew consent or were discontinued from the study at this site. Tracked for safety reporting, ITT/PP population analysis, and site performance assessment.']

  Note: 'Association entity representing the full lifecycle relationship between a specific study (protocol) and an investigational site, from selection through activation to closeout. Captures site selection decision (rationale, committee approval, rejection reasons), activation workflow milestones (CDA execution, IRB submission, SIV scheduling, drug shipment authorization, EDC provisioning), site number assignment, enrollment targets, enrollment open/close dates, site status (candidate, selected, initiated, enrolling, enrollment complete, closed), and FPFV date. This is the operational hub for all study-site activity and the primary entity for site lifecycle management.'
}

  performance_status varchar [note: 'Current enrollment performance status of the site for the reporting period, indicating whether the site is meeting, exceeding, or falling short of its planned enrollment targets. Drives CRA escalation and site management actions in the CTMS.']
  planned_completion_date date [note: 'The originally planned date by which the site was expected to complete enrollment of its assigned target, as defined in the site enrollment plan or study protocol timeline.']
  planned_enrolled_count varchar [note: 'The target number of subjects planned to be enrolled (randomized or consented per protocol definition) at this site during the reporting period. Derived from the site-level enrollment plan agreed with the sponsor.']
  planned_screened_count varchar [note: 'The number of subjects planned to be screened at this site during the reporting period, as defined in the site enrollment plan or feasibility agreement. Baseline for screen failure rate analysis.']
  projected_completion_date date [note: 'The forecasted date by which the site is expected to complete enrollment of its assigned target, based on current enrollment rate. Updated each reporting period in the CTMS for timeline management.']
  protocol_deviation_count varchar [note: 'The number of protocol deviations recorded at this site during the reporting period. Includes both major and minor deviations as classified per the study deviation management plan. Sourced from CTMS deviation tracking.']
  randomized_count varchar [note: 'The number of subjects who were randomized (assigned to a treatment arm via RTSM/IVRS) at this site during the reporting period. Distinct from enrolled count in studies where enrollment precedes randomization.']
  record_created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this enrollment performance record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.']
  record_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this enrollment performance record was most recently updated in the data platform. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11.']
  reporting_period_end_date date [note: 'The last calendar date of the enrollment performance reporting period. Together with reporting_period_start_date, defines the window for all enrollment metrics in this record.']
  reporting_period_start_date date [note: 'The first calendar date of the enrollment performance reporting period (e.g., start of a monthly or weekly reporting window). Used to define the temporal boundary for all enrollment metrics in this record.']
  reporting_period_type varchar [note: 'Granularity of the reporting period for this enrollment performance record. Determines the cadence at which site-level enrollment metrics are aggregated and reviewed.']
  sae_count varchar [note: 'The number of Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) reported at this site during the reporting period. Sourced from Oracle Argus Safety. Used to assess site safety profile and trigger risk-based monitoring escalation.']
  screen_failure_count varchar [note: 'The number of subjects who were screened but did not meet eligibility criteria and were therefore not enrolled during the reporting period. A key metric for site feasibility and protocol amendment decisions.']
  screen_failure_rate decimal(5,2) [note: 'The proportion of screened subjects who failed screening, expressed as a percentage (screen_failure_count / actual_screened_count × 100). Stored as a raw business metric captured from CTMS; used to assess site eligibility criteria adherence and protocol feasibility.']
  site_capacity varchar [note: 'The maximum number of subjects the site can concurrently manage based on staff, facilities, and resources, as assessed during site feasibility. Used to evaluate whether the site is operating within capacity.']
  site_enrollment_target varchar [note: 'The total number of subjects the site is contracted or planned to enroll over the full duration of the study, as agreed in the site initiation agreement or enrollment plan. Denominator for cumulative enrollment progress percentage.']
  site_number varchar [note: 'The sponsor- or CRO-assigned unique site identifier code for the investigational site. Used as the externally-known business identifier for the site in regulatory submissions and CTMS reporting.']

  Note: 'Tracks actual vs. planned enrollment performance at the study-site level over time. Captures reporting period, planned enrollment target, actual subjects screened, subjects enrolled, screen failure count, screen failure rate, dropout count, and cumulative enrollment to date. Enables site-level enrollment forecasting and performance management. Sourced from CTMS enrollment tracking integrated with EDC subject data.'
}

  imaging_capability boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the site has on-site medical imaging capability (e.g., MRI, CT, PET, X-ray, ultrasound) relevant to clinical trial endpoint assessments. Sites without imaging may require referral to external imaging centers.']

  lab_sample_processing_capacity varchar [note: 'Maximum number of clinical trial samples the on-site laboratory can process per day. Null if the site does not have on-site laboratory processing capability. Used to assess feasibility for high-frequency sampling protocols.']
  last_monitoring_visit_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent on-site monitoring visit conducted by a Clinical Research Associate (CRA). Used to assess the currency of the GCP compliance status and schedule the next monitoring visit.']
  max_concurrent_protocols varchar [note: 'Maximum number of distinct clinical trial protocols the site can run simultaneously without compromising GCP compliance or subject safety. Used for workload balancing across the site portfolio.']
  max_concurrent_subjects varchar [note: 'Maximum number of trial subjects the site can actively manage simultaneously across all concurrent protocols, as declared or assessed. This is the principal capacity metric used in site selection scoring and enrollment planning.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for CRA or site management notes regarding specific capacity constraints, caveats, or contextual information not captured in structured fields (e.g., planned staff changes, facility renovations, seasonal patient volume variations).']
  pharmacy_cold_chain_capable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the site pharmacy has validated cold chain storage capability (e.g., 2–8°C refrigeration or -20°C / -80°C freezer storage) for temperature-sensitive investigational medicinal products.']
  pharmacy_storage_capacity_units varchar [note: 'Number of discrete storage units (e.g., refrigerator slots, freezer compartments, or shelf units) available in the site pharmacy for investigational medicinal product (IMP) storage. Constrains the number of concurrent protocols requiring pharmacy support.']
  pi_fte_allocation decimal(4,2) [note: 'Proportion of the Principal Investigator\'s time (expressed as FTE) allocated to clinical research activities at this site. A PI with 0.5 FTE allocation is available 50% of their working time for trial oversight.']
  recruitment_rate_per_month decimal(6,2) [note: 'Historical average number of subjects recruited per month by this site across prior clinical trials, based on CTMS enrollment data. Used as a predictive input for enrollment planning and site selection scoring.']
  screen_failure_rate_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Historical percentage of screened subjects who failed to meet eligibility criteria and were not enrolled, based on prior trial data at this site. A high screen failure rate reduces effective enrollment capacity.']
  site_selection_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Composite numeric score (typically 0–100) assigned to the site based on capacity, feasibility, and performance metrics for use in site selection ranking. Calculated by the CTMS or feasibility scoring model.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time at which this site capacity record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.']
  utilization_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the site\'s maximum concurrent subject capacity currently in use, calculated as (active_subject_count / max_concurrent_subjects) * 100. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 75.50 for 75.5%). Used for workload balancing and site selection scoring.']
  version varchar [note: 'Monotonically incrementing version number for this site capacity record, enabling historical tracking of capacity changes over time. Version 1 represents the initial assessment.']

  Note: 'Captures the declared and assessed operational capacity of an investigational site for concurrent trial participation. Tracks maximum concurrent subjects, available examination rooms, dedicated research staff FTE, pharmacy storage capacity, lab processing capability, competing protocol load, and capacity utilization percentage. Used for site selection scoring, enrollment planning, and workload balancing across the site portfolio.'

  confidentiality_agreement_signed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the assigned CRA has signed the required confidentiality or non-disclosure agreement (NDA) for this study prior to accessing study data. True = signed; False = pending. Regulatory and sponsor compliance requirement.']

  planned_end_date date [note: 'The originally planned end date for the CRA assignment at the time of creation. Enables comparison against actual end date to track assignment duration variances and resource planning accuracy.']
  protocol_training_completed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the assigned CRA has completed the required study protocol-specific training prior to initiating monitoring activities at the site. True = training completed; False = pending. Regulatory requirement per GCP.']
  protocol_training_date date [note: 'The date on which the CRA completed the study protocol-specific training required for this assignment. Supports audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness.']
  risk_tier varchar [note: 'The risk classification of the assigned site as assessed under the risk-based monitoring (RBM) framework. Determines monitoring intensity, visit frequency, and SDV scope for this assignment. \'high\' = intensive monitoring required.']
  sdv_rate_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'The agreed or actual percentage of critical data fields subject to Source Data Verification (SDV) for this CRA-site assignment, as defined in the monitoring plan. Reflects risk-based monitoring (RBM) strategy. Valid range: 0.00 to 100.00.']
  start_date date [note: 'The date on which the CRA\'s monitoring responsibility for the assigned study-site combination becomes effective. Used for coverage planning and workload scheduling.']
  termination_reason varchar [note: 'The reason for ending or cancelling the CRA assignment before or at its planned conclusion. Populated only when assignment_status is \'completed\', \'cancelled\', or \'transferred\'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: study_completion|site_closure|cra_departure|reassignment|performance|sponsor_request|other — promote to reference product]']
  territory_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code representing the primary country of the CRA\'s assigned territory (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Supports geographic reporting and regulatory jurisdiction tracking.']
  total_visits_completed varchar [note: 'The cumulative count of monitoring visits (on-site and remote) completed by this CRA at the assigned site under this assignment. Used for performance tracking and monitoring coverage reporting.']
  travel_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether overnight or significant travel is required for the CRA to conduct on-site monitoring visits at this assigned site. True = travel required; False = local or remote only. Used for travel budget planning and CRA logistics.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this CRA assignment record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.']
  visit_frequency_planned varchar [note: 'The planned frequency of on-site or remote monitoring visits for this CRA-site assignment as defined in the monitoring plan. Drives visit scheduling and resource forecasting in the CTMS.']
  workload_allocation_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'The percentage of the CRA\'s total available working capacity allocated to this specific study-site assignment. Used for workload balancing across multiple concurrent assignments. Valid range: 0.00 to 100.00.']

  Note: 'Records the assignment of Clinical Research Associates (CRAs) to study-site combinations for monitoring coverage. Captures CRA identity reference (FK to workforce domain), assignment start/end dates, assignment type (primary, backup, co-monitor), geographic territory, workload allocation percentage, and assignment status. Enables monitoring coverage planning, workload balancing, and visit scheduling within CTMS.'
}

Table site.ib_site_distribution {

Business justification: Investigator Brochure distribution to a site requires PI acknowledgment of receipt (receipt_confirmed_by field exists). The PI is the responsible party who must review and acknowledge the IB per GCP r']
  distribution_date date [note: 'Date on which this IB version was distributed to the investigational site. Required for GCP compliance and TMF completeness verification.']
  distribution_method varchar [note: 'Method by which the IB version was transmitted to the investigational site (e.g., Veeva Vault notification, email, courier). Captured per distribution event as method may vary by site capability.']
  ib_version_at_distribution varchar [note: 'The version number of the IB as distributed to this site (e.g., 2.0, 3.1). Denormalized here to provide an audit-safe snapshot of the version label at the time of distribution, independent of any subsequent version record updates.']
  investigator_notification_date date [note: 'Date on which Principal Investigators (PIs) at active study sites were notified of this new IB version. ICH E6(R2) requires sponsors to notify investigators of IB updates promptly. Tracked for GCP compliance. [Moved from investigator_brochure_safety: This attribute on investigator_brochure_safety records a single date for investigator notification, but in reality notification occurs per site on different dates. The per-site notification date belongs to the ib_site_distribution association record (as receipt_confirmed_date or a separate notification_date), not as a single scalar on the IB record. The IB-level field may be retained as a \'first notification date\' or \'target notification date\' but the operational per-site tracking belongs in the association.]']
  irb_iec_notification_date date [note: 'Date on which the site\'s local IRB/IEC was notified of this IB version update. Tracked per site because each site has its own IRB/IEC with independent notification obligations and timelines.']
  irb_iec_notification_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the site\'s IRB/IEC must be notified of this IB update per local regulatory requirements. Determined per site per IB version, as requirements vary by jurisdiction and amendment type.']
  receipt_confirmed_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the site personnel (typically the Principal Investigator or site coordinator) who confirmed receipt of this IB version.']
  receipt_confirmed_date date [note: 'Date on which the investigational site confirmed receipt of this IB version. Required for GCP essential document tracking and site readiness verification.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the IB Distribution Log event between investigational_site and investigator_brochure_safety. It captures the GCP-mandated record of each Investigator Brochure version distributed to each investigational site, including receipt confirmation, distribution method, and IRB/IEC notification tracking. Each record links one investigational_site to one investigator_brochure_safety version and carries attributes that exist only in the context of this site-specific distribution event.. Existence Justification: In clinical trials, an Investigator Brochure (IB) version is distributed to every active investigational site participating in the relevant study — one IB version goes to many sites. Simultaneously, a single site receives multiple IB versions over the lifecycle of a study (initial version, safety amendments, annual updates). The business actively manages this distribution as a GCP-mandated essential document process called the \'IB Distribution Log\', tracking per-site receipt confirmation, distribution method, and IRB/IEC notification obligations for each IB version delivered to each site.'
}

Table site.sponsor_site_qualification {
  sponsor_site_qualification_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the sponsor_site_qualification association']
  investigational_site_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the investigational site being qualified within the sponsor\'s network']
  organization_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the sponsor organization that owns and manages this site qualification record']
  disqualification_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text or coded reason for disqualification if site_qualification_status is DISQUALIFIED or SUSPENDED. Null for active/qualified sites. Belongs to the relationship — a site may be disqualified by one sponsor for sponsor-specific reasons.']
  historical_study_count varchar [note: 'Total number of clinical studies this site has conducted for this sponsor over the lifetime of the relationship. Belongs to the relationship — the same site\'s study count differs per sponsor.']
  last_qualification_review_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent periodic re-qualification review conducted by the sponsor for this site. Sponsors periodically re-assess site qualification status; this date drives re-qualification scheduling.']
  preferred_site_tier varchar [note: 'Sponsor-assigned tier classification for this site within their preferred site network. Distinct from the site\'s global site_tier — a site may be Tier 1 for one sponsor and Tier 3 for another based on therapeutic area fit and historical performance.']
  preferred_therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'The therapeutic area(s) for which this sponsor preferentially engages this site, based on the site\'s specialization and the sponsor\'s pipeline focus. May be a subset of the site\'s full therapeutic_area_specializations.']
  qualification_date date [note: 'Date on which the site was formally qualified by this sponsor following completion of site qualification visit and document review. Distinct from relationship_start_date (initial contact) — this marks formal approval.']
  relationship_start_date date [note: 'Date on which the sponsor formally established a working relationship with this investigational site. Used to calculate relationship tenure and for sponsor portfolio reporting.']
  site_performance_rating varchar [note: 'Sponsor\'s aggregate performance rating for this site based on enrollment delivery, data quality, protocol compliance, and regulatory inspection outcomes across all studies conducted under this sponsor. Belongs to the relationship — the same site may have different ratings from different sponsors.']
  site_qualification_status varchar [note: 'Current qualification status of the investigational site within this sponsor\'s network. Drives whether the site is eligible to be selected for new studies under this sponsor. Belongs to the relationship, not the site (a site may be QUALIFIED for Pfizer but SUSPENDED for Novartis).']

  Note: 'This association product represents the formal qualification and relationship contract between an investigational_site and a sponsor organization. It captures the operational record of a sponsor\'s qualification, rating, and preferred-network designation of a specific site — data that exists only in the context of this sponsor-site pairing. Each record links one investigational_site to one organization and tracks the qualification status, performance history, and preferred-site designation that the sponsor actively manages as part of their site network strategy.. Existence Justification: In clinical trials operations, investigational sites actively work with multiple sponsor organizations simultaneously across different studies, and each sponsor organization maintains relationships with dozens to hundreds of sites across their trial portfolio. This is not an analytical correlation — sponsors actively manage a \'qualified site roster\' or \'preferred site network\' as an operational business concept, tracking each site\'s qualification status, performance rating, and preferred-site designation per sponsor. The relationship itself carries meaningful data (qualification status, performance rating, relationship start date, historical study count) that belongs to neither the site nor the sponsor alone.'
}

Table site.pi_qualification {
  pi_qualification_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the pi_qualification association']
  organization_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the Sponsor Organization that is granting or managing the PI qualification.']
  principal_investigator_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the Principal Investigator being qualified by the sponsor organization.']

A sponsor may approve a PI for Oncology but not Neurology; this scope is specific to the sponsor-PI qualification.']
  debarment_check_date date [note: 'Date on which this sponsor most recently performed an FDA debarment check for this PI. Sponsors conduct their own independent debarment verifications; this date is specific to the sponsor-PI relationship and differs from the PI master record\'s global debarment_check_date.']
  historical_study_count varchar [note: 'Total number of clinical studies this PI has conducted specifically for this sponsor organization. Distinct from the PI master record\'s global prior_study_count, which spans all sponsors. Used by sponsors for investigator selection and risk assessment.']
  pi_performance_rating varchar [note: 'Sponsor\'s internal performance rating for this PI based on past study conduct, protocol compliance, data quality, and site management. This rating is sponsor-specific and confidential; a PI may have different ratings from different sponsors.']
  qualification_date date [note: 'Date on which the sponsor formally approved and qualified this PI for study participation. Specific to the sponsor-PI pairing; a PI may have different qualification dates with different sponsors.']
  qualification_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the sponsor\'s qualification approval for this PI. Drives eligibility to be assigned to studies under this sponsor\'s portfolio. Cannot reside on the PI master record because a PI may be ACTIVE with one sponsor and SUSPENDED with another simultaneously.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the Qualification relationship between a Principal Investigator and a Sponsor Organization. It captures the formal regulatory approval process by which a sponsor certifies a PI as eligible to conduct studies under their IND portfolio. Each record links one Principal Investigator to one Sponsor Organization and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific sponsor-PI qualification relationship, including approval status, therapeutic area scope, performance history, and compliance verification dates.. Existence Justification: In clinical research, a Principal Investigator is formally qualified and approved by each sponsor organization independently before being permitted to conduct studies for that sponsor. A single PI may be qualified by multiple sponsors (e.g., Pfizer, Roche, Novartis) simultaneously, and each sponsor maintains a roster of many qualified PIs. This is an actively managed regulatory process — sponsors track debarment status, GCP compliance, therapeutic area approvals, and performance ratings per PI, and the qualification must be renewed or revoked independently per sponsor.'
}

This is a site-assignment-level compliance flag, distinct from the employee\'s general gcp_certified status, as site-specific training requirements may vary.']
  role_at_site varchar [note: 'The GCP-defined functional role the employee performs at this specific investigational site. Distinct from the employee\'s general gcp_role, as a staff member may serve different roles across different site assignments (e.g., CRA at one site, Site Manager at another).']

  Note: 'This association product represents the Role-based assignment between investigational_site and employee. It captures the operational record of each staff member assigned to an investigational site, including their functional role, assignment period, GCP compliance status for that site, and delegation of authority log reference. Each record links one investigational_site to one employee and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific staff-site assignment. This is the system of record for site staffing in clinical operations.. Existence Justification: In clinical research operations, an investigational site employs or hosts multiple staff members (CRAs, monitors, site coordinators) simultaneously, and each employee can be assigned to multiple investigational sites across different studies. The business actively manages this relationship as a \'site staff roster\' — a named operational concept in clinical operations — tracking each staff member\'s role at a site, their assignment dates, GCP training currency, and delegation log references, none of which belong to either the site or the employee record alone.'
}

Supports regulatory traceability for site-level safety actions and DSMB/DMC reporting.. Existence Justification: In clinical trials, a safety signal is typically detected at the study level but must be evaluated across all participating sites — a single signal (e.g., hepatotoxicity) may implicate multiple study sites with differing case counts and require site-specific risk assessments and actions.
