  review_due_date date [note: 'Target date by which the assigned reviewer must complete the review and disposition of the alert, as defined by the monitoring plan SLA for the given alert severity level.']
  review_narrative varchar [note: 'Free-text narrative entered by the reviewer documenting the findings, rationale for the review outcome, and justification for the chosen disposition. Supports audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness per ALCOA+ principles.']
  review_outcome varchar [note: 'Conclusion reached by the reviewer after investigating the alert. CONFIRMED: the anomaly or KRI breach is genuine and requires action. FALSE_POSITIVE: the alert was triggered in error or the signal is not clinically meaningful. INCONCLUSIVE: insufficient data to determine; requires further monitoring. PENDING: review not yet completed.']
  source_system_record_reference varchar [note: 'Native record identifier from the originating operational system (Oracle Siebel CTMS or CSM engine) for this alert. Enables lineage tracing and reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the system of record.']
  sponsor_notification_date date [note: 'Date on which the sponsor was formally notified of this alert. Null when sponsor_notified is False. Used to verify compliance with sponsor notification SLAs defined in the monitoring plan.']
  sponsor_notified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the study sponsor has been formally notified of this alert, as required for critical or high-severity alerts under the monitoring plan and sponsor oversight obligations per ICH E6(R2).']
  threshold_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the breached threshold was the amber (warning) or red (action-required) threshold level as defined in the monitoring plan. Drives escalation logic and response SLA.']
  threshold_value decimal(18,4) [note: 'The amber or red threshold value that was breached at the time the alert was generated. Captured at alert generation time to preserve the threshold configuration in effect, as thresholds may be revised over the study lifecycle.']
  trigger_source varchar [note: 'System or process that generated the alert. AUTOMATED_CSM: centralized statistical monitoring (CSM) engine. MANUAL_ENTRY: entered directly by a central monitor. EDC_INTEGRATION: triggered by Electronic Data Capture (EDC) system data feed (e.g., Medidata Rave). CTMS_RULE: rule-based trigger from Oracle Siebel CTMS. SAFETY_SYSTEM: triggered from Oracle Argus Safety integration.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'Unit in which the observed_value and threshold_value are expressed (e.g., \'percent\', \'days\', \'count\', \'ratio\'). Required for correct interpretation of the KRI metric values in alert review and reporting.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this alert record was last modified in the Databricks Silver Layer, capturing status changes, review updates, and disposition entries. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.']

  Note: 'Automated or manually triggered alert generated by the centralized statistical monitoring (CSM) system when a KRI threshold breach or data anomaly is detected at a site. Captures alert type, triggering KRI or data signal, site and study context, alert severity, alert generation date, assigned reviewer, review outcome, and disposition (escalated to on-site visit, remote follow-up, no action required). Supports proactive risk management in the RBM framework.'
}

Table monitoring.checklist_item {
  checklist_item_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for checklist_item']
  checklist_template_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the checklist template to which this item belongs, linking items to their parent monitoring checklist definition.']

  applicable_phase varchar [note: 'The clinical trial phase(s) for which this checklist item is applicable, as different phases may have varying monitoring requirements.']
  approved_date date [note: 'Date when this checklist item was formally approved for use in monitoring activities, per quality management review processes.']
  capa_trigger boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether non-compliance on this item automatically initiates a Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) workflow.']
  category varchar [note: 'High-level classification category grouping the checklist item by monitoring focus area such as regulatory compliance, patient safety, or data quality.']
  code varchar [note: 'Unique business code assigned to the checklist item for identification in monitoring workflows and CTMS systems.']

  description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the checklist item explaining the monitoring task, verification requirement, or assessment criteria.']
  deviation_classification varchar [note: 'Classification of the type of deviation that would be recorded if this checklist item is found non-compliant during monitoring.']
  effective_from_date date [note: 'Date from which this checklist item version becomes effective and available for inclusion in monitoring visit checklists.']
  effective_to_date date [note: 'Date until which this checklist item version remains effective. Null indicates the item is currently active with no planned retirement.']
  escalation_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a non-compliant finding on this checklist item automatically triggers an escalation workflow or CAPA initiation.']
  expected_response varchar [note: 'The expected or compliant response value for this checklist item, used to auto-flag deviations when actual responses differ.']
  frequency varchar [note: 'How frequently this checklist item should be assessed during the course of monitoring a clinical trial site.']
  guidance_text varchar [note: 'Instructional guidance or help text provided to CRAs explaining how to properly assess or complete this checklist item during monitoring.']
  is_critical_to_quality boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this checklist item is designated as Critical to Quality (CtQ) per the study risk assessment, requiring heightened monitoring attention.']
  is_mandatory boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this checklist item must be completed during every applicable monitoring visit or if it can be optionally skipped by the CRA.']
  item_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the type of monitoring action required: verification (source data check), assessment (judgment-based), confirmation (yes/no), collection (document retrieval), or observation (visual inspection).']
  last_modified_date timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this checklist item definition, supporting change tracking and version control.']
  monitoring_method varchar [note: 'The monitoring method for which this checklist item is applicable, supporting risk-based monitoring (RBM) strategies that combine on-site, remote, and centralized approaches.']
  name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name or title of the checklist item as displayed to Clinical Research Associates (CRAs) during monitoring visits.']
  region_applicability varchar [note: 'Geographic region or country codes where this checklist item is applicable, supporting multi-regional trial monitoring with jurisdiction-specific requirements.']
  regulatory_reference varchar [note: 'Citation to the specific regulatory requirement, guideline section, or standard operating procedure (SOP) that mandates this checklist item.']
  requires_documentation boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether completion of this checklist item requires supporting documentation or evidence to be attached to the monitoring visit report.']
  response_type varchar [note: 'Defines the expected response format when a CRA completes this checklist item during a monitoring visit.']
  retired_date date [note: 'Date when this checklist item was retired from active use, maintaining historical reference while preventing inclusion in new monitoring checklists.']
  risk_category varchar [note: 'Risk classification of the checklist item indicating the severity level if the item is found non-compliant, aligned with risk-based monitoring (RBM) strategy.']
  sdv_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this checklist item requires source data verification against original patient records or source documents.']
  section_name varchar [note: 'The section or sub-grouping within the monitoring checklist where this item is organized, enabling structured checklist navigation.']
  sort_order varchar [note: 'Numeric sequence defining the display order of this checklist item within its parent checklist or category grouping.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The operational system of record from which this checklist item definition originates, such as Oracle Siebel CTMS or other clinical trial management systems.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the checklist item in the master reference table, controlling its availability for use in monitoring visit checklists.']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'The therapeutic area or disease indication for which this checklist item is specifically relevant, if not universally applicable across all studies.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Version identifier for the checklist item definition, supporting version control as monitoring requirements evolve across protocol amendments.']
  visit_type_applicability varchar [note: 'Indicates which type of monitoring visit this checklist item applies to: site initiation visit (SIV), interim monitoring visit (IMV), close-out visit (COV), or all visit types.']
  weight_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Numeric weighting factor assigned to this checklist item for calculating overall site compliance scores in risk-based monitoring analytics.']

  Note: 'Master reference table for checklist_item. Referenced by checklist_item_id.'
}

Table biostatistics.sample_size_calc {
  sample_size_calc_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each sample size calculation record within the biostatistics domain.']
  analysis_population_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to biostatistics.analysis_population. Business justification: sample_size_calc has analysis_population (STRING) indicating which population the sample size calculation targets. Normalizing to a FK to analysis_population.analysis_population_id enforces referentia']
  approved_by_employee_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Sample size calculations require a named approving statistician for protocol and regulatory submission documentation. Linking to workforce.employee enables GCP training verification and inspection-rea']
  pipeline_asset_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to sponsor.pipeline_asset. Business justification: Sample size assumptions (effect_size, dropout_rate, event_rate_control) are derived from the pipeline asset\'s prior clinical data and development phase. Sponsors review sample size calculations at por']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific protocol version under which this sample size calculation was conducted, supporting traceability to protocol amendments.']
  rand_scheme_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.rand_scheme. Business justification: Sample size calculations depend directly on the randomization scheme\'s allocation_ratio, block structure, and stratification. Regulatory submissions require sample size justification to reference the ']
  sap_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) document that governs or references this sample size calculation.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study for which this sample size calculation was performed.']
  accrual_period_months varchar [note: 'The assumed patient accrual (enrollment) period in months, used in time-to-event sample size calculations to determine the number of events required.']
  allocation_ratio varchar [note: 'The randomization allocation ratio between treatment arms (e.g., \'1:1\', \'2:1\', \'1:1:1\'), specifying the relative number of subjects assigned to each arm.']
  alpha_level decimal(10,6) [note: 'The pre-specified Type I error rate (significance level, alpha) used in the sample size calculation, typically 0.05 for two-sided or 0.025 for one-sided tests.']
  alpha_spending_method varchar [note: 'The alpha-spending function applied to control Type I error across planned interim analyses (e.g., O\'Brien-Fleming, Pocock, Lan-DeMets). Null or \'none\' if no interim analysis is planned.']
  amendment_reason varchar [note: 'Narrative justification for revising a prior version of the sample size calculation, such as updated assumptions from interim data, protocol amendment, or regulatory feedback.']
  approval_date date [note: 'The date on which the sample size calculation was formally approved by the responsible biostatistician, marking readiness for inclusion in regulatory submissions.']
  calc_date date [note: 'The date on which this sample size calculation was performed or finalized, serving as the principal business event date for regulatory traceability.']
  calc_identifier varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric code or reference number assigned to this sample size calculation, used in regulatory submissions and protocol documentation (e.g., SSC-2024-001).']
  calc_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the sample size calculation record, from initial draft through regulatory approval to archival.']
  calc_version varchar [note: 'Version number of this sample size calculation (e.g., v1.0, v2.1), enabling tracking of revisions driven by protocol amendments or updated assumptions.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this sample size calculation record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.']
  dropout_rate decimal(10,6) [note: 'The assumed proportion of enrolled subjects expected to discontinue or be lost to follow-up, used to inflate the calculated sample size to ensure adequate evaluable subjects.']
  effect_size decimal(18,6) [note: 'The clinically meaningful difference or effect size assumed between treatment arms (e.g., mean difference, odds ratio, hazard ratio) used as the basis for the sample size calculation.']
  effect_size_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measurement for the assumed effect size (e.g., mmHg, %, hazard ratio, odds ratio, mean difference), providing dimensional context for regulatory interpretation.']
  event_rate_control decimal(10,6) [note: 'The assumed event rate or response rate in the control arm, applicable for binary or time-to-event endpoints. Null for continuous endpoints.']
  event_rate_treatment decimal(10,6) [note: 'The assumed event rate or response rate in the treatment arm, applicable for binary or time-to-event endpoints. Null for continuous endpoints.']
  follow_up_period_months varchar [note: 'The assumed minimum follow-up period in months after the last patient enrolled, used in time-to-event calculations to ensure sufficient events are observed.']
  hypothesis_type varchar [note: 'The statistical hypothesis framework applied (superiority, non-inferiority, equivalence), which determines the directionality and margin used in the sample size formula.']
  interim_analysis_planned boolean [note: 'Indicates whether one or more interim analyses are planned for this study, which may require alpha-spending adjustments to the sample size calculation.']
  median_survival_control decimal(18,6) [note: 'The assumed median survival time in the control arm for time-to-event endpoints, used in log-rank or exponential model-based sample size calculations. Null for non-survival endpoints.']
  non_inferiority_margin decimal(18,6) [note: 'The pre-specified non-inferiority or equivalence margin (delta) used in the hypothesis test, applicable when hypothesis_type is non_inferiority or equivalence. Null for superiority designs.']
  number_of_arms varchar [note: 'Total number of treatment arms (including control) in the study design, used to determine the allocation structure and multiplicity adjustments.']
  number_of_events_required varchar [note: 'The minimum number of primary endpoint events (e.g., deaths, progressions) required to achieve the specified power for time-to-event analyses. Null for non-event-driven endpoints.']
  power decimal(10,6) [note: 'The pre-specified statistical power (1 minus Type II error rate, beta) used in the calculation, representing the probability of detecting the assumed effect size. Typically 0.80 or 0.90.']
  primary_endpoint_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the primary endpoint used in the sample size calculation (e.g., \'Change from baseline in HbA1c at Week 24\'), providing clinical context for regulatory reviewers.']
  primary_endpoint_type varchar [note: 'Statistical nature of the primary efficacy endpoint (e.g., continuous, binary, time-to-event, ordinal, count) that drives the choice of sample size formula.']
  reference_source varchar [note: 'Citation or reference for the data source used to derive the assumed effect size, standard deviation, or event rate (e.g., published literature citation, prior Phase II study identifier, internal pilot data).']
  sample_size_per_arm varchar [note: 'The calculated number of subjects required per treatment arm to achieve the specified power at the given alpha level, accounting for the assumed effect size and standard deviation.']
  software_name varchar [note: 'Name of the validated statistical software used to perform the sample size calculation (e.g., PASS, nQuery Advisor, SAS PROC POWER, R), required for regulatory audit trail.']
  software_version varchar [note: 'Version number of the statistical software used (e.g., PASS 2023, nQuery 9.1), required for reproducibility and regulatory validation documentation.']
  standard_deviation decimal(18,6) [note: 'The assumed population standard deviation for continuous endpoints, derived from prior studies or literature, used in the sample size formula. Null for non-continuous endpoints.']
  statistical_method varchar [note: 'The specific statistical formula or method used for the calculation (e.g., two-sample t-test, log-rank test, chi-square test, Kaplan-Meier), providing methodological traceability.']
  study_design_type varchar [note: 'The clinical trial design type (e.g., parallel group, crossover, factorial, adaptive) that determines the statistical methodology applied in the sample size calculation.']
  study_phase varchar [note: 'Clinical development phase of the study (Phase I through Phase IV) for which the sample size is being calculated, influencing regulatory expectations and statistical rigor.']
  test_sidedness varchar [note: 'Specifies whether the statistical test is one-sided or two-sided, directly affecting the critical value and resulting sample size.']
  total_enrollment_target varchar [note: 'The total number of subjects to be enrolled (randomized) after inflating the total sample size by the assumed dropout rate, representing the actual recruitment target submitted in the protocol.']
  total_sample_size varchar [note: 'The total number of subjects required across all treatment arms before applying the dropout inflation, representing the minimum evaluable sample.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this sample size calculation record was most recently modified, supporting version control and audit trail requirements.']

  Note: 'Records sample size calculations performed during study design and protocol development. Captures study phase, primary endpoint type, assumed effect size, standard deviation, alpha level, power, dropout rate, allocation ratio, calculated sample size per arm, total enrollment target, software used (e.g., PASS, nQuery), and version. Supports regulatory submission and protocol amendments.'
}

  core_designation varchar [note: 'CDISC ADaM core classification indicating the mandatory status of the variable: Required (must be present), Expected (should be present unless not applicable), Permissible (optional, may be included), or Conditionally Required (required when specific conditions are met).   spec_status varchar [note: 'Lifecycle status of this variable specification document.   spec_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier for this variable specification record, following semantic versioning (e.g., v1.0, v1.1, v2.0). Incremented when derivation algorithm, source variables, or controlled terminology references are updated. Supports audit trail and change management.']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'Therapeutic area or disease indication for which this variable specification is designed (e.g., Oncology, Cardiology, Neurology). Relevant for CDISC Therapeutic Area User Guides (TAUGs) compliance and cross-study reuse.']

  variable_length varchar [note: 'SAS storage length for the variable. For Character variables, specifies maximum character width (e.g., 200). For Numeric variables, typically 8 (SAS default double-precision float). Used in SAS dataset creation and DEFINE-XML.']
  variable_name varchar [note: 'The SAS-compliant variable name as defined in the ADaM dataset specification. Must conform to CDISC ADaM naming conventions: uppercase, up to 8 characters, starting with a letter. Examples: USUBJID, AVAL, DTYPE, PARAMCD.']
  variable_order varchar [note: 'Sequential position of this variable within the ADaM dataset column order as defined in the specification. Determines the column sequence in the SAS dataset and DEFINE-XML variable listing. Required for consistent dataset structure across programming and QC.']

Drives alpha spending calculations.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for capturing additional context, operational notes, deviations from the pre-specified plan, or DSMB/DMC commentary relevant to this interim analysis that is not captured in structured fields.']

  observed_test_statistic decimal(10,6) [note: 'The actual computed test statistic (e.g., z-score, chi-square, log-rank statistic) from the interim analysis dataset. Compared against efficacy and futility boundaries to determine the outcome.']
  planned_analysis_date date [note: 'Pre-specified calendar date on which the interim analysis is planned to be conducted, as documented in the SAP and DSMB/DMC charter.']
  regulatory_submission_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the interim analysis results or the resulting design adaptation must be submitted to a regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, PMDA, etc.) as part of an IND, NDA, BLA, or MAA amendment (True = submission required; False = not required).']
  results_disclosed_externally boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the interim analysis results have been disclosed externally (e.g., to regulators, in a public registry, or in a publication) prior to study completion (True = disclosed; False = not disclosed). Tracks blinding integrity at the study level.']
  revised_sample_size varchar [note: 'Updated total sample size determined through the pre-specified sample size re-estimation procedure at this interim analysis. Null if sample_size_reestimated is False.']
  sample_size_reestimated boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a pre-specified sample size re-estimation was performed as part of this interim analysis (True = sample size re-estimated; False = no re-estimation performed).']
  sas_program_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the SAS Drug Development program or analysis package used to execute this interim analysis, enabling reproducibility and audit traceability.']
  stopping_rule_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the specific stopping rule(s) triggered at this interim analysis, including the criterion crossed and the observed vs. boundary values. Populated only when stopping_rule_triggered is True.']
  stopping_rule_triggered boolean [note: 'Indicates whether any pre-specified stopping rule (efficacy, futility, or safety) was triggered by the results of this interim analysis (True = stopping rule crossed; False = no stopping rule triggered).']
  subjects_enrolled_at_cutoff varchar [note: 'Total number of subjects enrolled in the study as of the data cutoff date for this interim analysis. Provides context for the information fraction and statistical power.']
  unblinding_authorization_date date [note: 'Date on which formal authorization was granted to unblind the interim analysis data, as documented in the unblinding log. Required for audit trail and blinding integrity compliance.']
  unblinding_scope varchar [note: 'Defines the extent of treatment assignment unblinding performed for this interim analysis: full (all treatment assignments revealed to the analysis team), partial (only aggregate or summary-level unblinding), or none (blinded analysis only). Critical for blinding integrity management and regulatory compliance.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this interim analysis record was most recently modified, supporting audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.']

  Note: 'Records planned and executed interim analyses for a study. Captures interim analysis number, type (efficacy, futility, safety, adaptive), planned information fraction, actual analysis date, DSMB/DMC involvement flag, unblinding scope (full/partial/none), stopping rules triggered, outcome (continue/stop/adapt), alpha spending function parameters, and confidentiality controls. Critical for regulatory compliance and blinding integrity management.'
}

  rand_list_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.rand_list. Business justification: Pre-lock QC checklists require reconciliation of all randomized subjects in the locked dataset against the active rand_list version. The subjects_locked_count must match the rand_list\'s allocated_slot']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study for which this database lock event applies. Links the DBL event to the parent study master record.']

Linking the biostatistics DBL event to the CTMS study_milestone enables timeline variance reporting, contractual milestone billing rec']
  tertiary_database_medical_monitor_approver_employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the Medical Monitor who authorized the database lock. Confirms clinical data completeness and medical review is satisfactory prior to lock.']
  actual_lock_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the database was formally locked. This is the principal business event date for the DBL milestone and is recorded in the eTMF, regulatory submissions, and CSR statistical sections.']
  amendment_number varchar [note: 'Sequential amendment number for post-lock data corrections. Zero for the original lock; increments with each formal unlock and re-lock cycle. Tracks the amendment history of the locked database.']
  amendment_reason varchar [note: 'Formal description of the reason for unlocking and re-locking the database after the initial lock. Documents the nature of the data correction or update requiring the amendment. Null for the original lock (amendment_number = 0).']
  analysis_type varchar [note: 'The type of statistical analysis for which this database lock is being performed. Determines the downstream workflow: interim analyses feed DSMB/DMC reviews; final analyses feed CSR and regulatory submissions (NDA/BLA/MAA).']
  biostatistics_approval_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time at which the Biostatistics representative provided electronic authorization for the database lock. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail.']
  coding_complete boolean [note: 'Indicates whether all medical coding assignments (MedDRA for adverse events/medical history, WHO-DD for concomitant medications) have been completed and verified in the EDC system prior to database lock.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time at which this database lock event record was first created in the lakehouse (Silver Layer). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ standards.']
  data_cut_date date [note: 'The clinical data cut-off date defining which subject data and observations are included in this lock. All data with a collection date on or before this date is included in the locked dataset. Critical for interim and partial locks.']

  edc_system_lock_reference varchar [note: 'The lock event reference number or identifier generated by the EDC system (Medidata Rave) at the time of lock execution. Used for cross-system traceability between the lakehouse and the source EDC system.']
  lock_memo_reference varchar [note: 'Document reference number for the formal database lock memo filed in the eTMF (Veeva Vault). The lock memo documents the lock rationale, approvals, outstanding items, and any deviations from the DMP.']
  lock_scope varchar [note: 'Defines the scope of data included in this lock event. Full study locks the entire study database; interim locks a defined data cut for interim analysis; partial locks a subset of data (e.g., specific sites or forms); cohort locks a defined patient cohort; site-specific locks data from one or more named sites.']
  lock_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the database lock event. Tracks progression from planning through execution and any subsequent unlock/re-lock cycles required for data corrections or amendments.']
  lock_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time (with timezone) at which the database lock was executed in the EDC system (Medidata Rave). Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail compliance and ALCOA+ data integrity standards.']
  lock_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the lock is a hard lock (no further data changes permitted without formal unlock and re-lock procedure) or a soft lock (data is locked for analysis but minor corrections may still be applied under controlled conditions). Hard locks are required prior to final DBL and regulatory submission.']
  medical_monitor_approval_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time at which the Medical Monitor provided electronic authorization for the database lock. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional context, observations, or operational notes related to this database lock event that are not captured in structured fields. Includes deviations from planned timelines or special circumstances.']
  outstanding_query_count varchar [note: 'Number of open data queries (discrepancies) remaining unresolved in the EDC system (Medidata Rave) at the time of database lock. A non-zero count must be formally justified and documented per GCP and ALCOA+ requirements.']
  outstanding_query_justification varchar [note: 'Formal written justification for proceeding with database lock when outstanding queries remain unresolved. Required by GCP and ALCOA+ when outstanding_query_count is greater than zero. Documented in the DMP and lock memo.']
  planned_lock_date date [note: 'The originally scheduled calendar date for the database lock event as defined in the Data Management Plan (DMP) and study timeline. Used for milestone tracking in Oracle Siebel CTMS and project planning.']
  pre_lock_qc_checklist_complete boolean [note: 'Indicates whether all items on the pre-database lock Quality Control (QC) checklist have been completed and signed off prior to lock execution. The checklist covers data cleaning, query resolution, coding completion, and SAE reconciliation.']
  pre_lock_qc_completion_date date [note: 'The date on which the pre-database lock QC checklist was formally completed and all items signed off. Must precede the actual lock date.']
  sae_reconciliation_complete boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the reconciliation between the EDC system (Medidata Rave) and the safety database (Oracle Argus Safety) for Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) has been completed and confirmed prior to database lock.']
  sdv_complete boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Source Data Verification (SDV) has been completed to the required percentage or scope across all sites prior to database lock. SDV confirms EDC data matches source documents per GCP requirements.']
  sites_locked_count varchar [note: 'Total number of investigative sites whose data is included in this database lock event. Relevant for partial and site-specific lock scopes.']
  study_part varchar [note: 'Identifies the specific study part, period, or epoch covered by this lock event (e.g., Part A, Part B, Period 1, Run-in, Treatment, Follow-up). Applicable for multi-part or adaptive study designs.']
  subjects_locked_count varchar [note: 'Total number of study subjects whose data is included in this database lock event. Used for completeness verification and comparison against enrollment targets defined in the SAP.']
  unblinding_date date [note: 'The date on which treatment assignment unblinding was performed following the database lock. Null if unblinding_required is false or unblinding has not yet occurred.']
  unblinding_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether treatment unblinding is required as part of or immediately following this database lock event. Applicable for blinded studies where the lock precedes the formal unblinding procedure for final or interim analysis.']
  unlock_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time at which the database was formally unlocked to permit post-lock data corrections. Null if the database has not been unlocked. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time at which this database lock event record was last modified in the lakehouse (Silver Layer). Tracks record-level changes for audit trail and data lineage compliance.']

  Note: 'Database Lock (DBL) event record for a study or study part. Captures lock scope (full study, interim, partial), planned and actual lock date, pre-lock QC checklist completion status, outstanding query count at lock, lock authorization approvers (DM, biostatistics, medical monitor), lock type (hard/soft), and post-lock amendment records. SSOT for DBL milestone consumed by biostatistics, data management, and regulatory domains.'
}

  charter_identifier varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric code or document number assigned to this DSMB/DMC charter, used for cross-referencing in the eTMF, regulatory submissions, and sponsor communications (e.g., STUDY-001-DSMB-CHR-001).']
  charter_scope_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the DSMB/DMC mandate and scope, including the populations, endpoints, and study phases covered by the committee\'s oversight responsibilities.']
  charter_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the DSMB/DMC charter document. Drives which version is operationally active for interim analyses and stopping rule enforcement.']
  charter_title varchar [note: 'Full descriptive title of the DSMB/DMC charter document as it appears on the official document header, typically including study name and committee type.']
  charter_version varchar [note: 'Version number of the DSMB/DMC charter document (e.g., v1.0, v2.0). Tracks amendments and superseded versions throughout the study lifecycle.']
  closed_session_scope varchar [note: 'Description of the agenda items and participants permitted in the closed (confidential) session of DSMB/DMC meetings, restricted to committee members and the independent statistician reviewing unblinded data.']
  committee_chair_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the independent physician or scientist designated as chair of the DSMB/DMC. The chair is responsible for convening meetings, managing deliberations, and communicating recommendations to the sponsor.']
  committee_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the independent monitoring committee type. DSMB (Data Safety Monitoring Board), DMC (Data Monitoring Committee), IDMC (Independent Data Monitoring Committee), ISMC (Independent Safety Monitoring Committee), and DSMC (Data and Safety Monitoring Committee) are used interchangeably across sponsors and regions.']
  confidentiality_requirements varchar [note: 'Narrative description of confidentiality obligations for DSMB/DMC members, including restrictions on disclosure of interim results, data firewall arrangements, and consequences of breach. Aligned with GDPR and HIPAA data protection requirements.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this DSMB charter record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and ALCOA+ data integrity requirements.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date from which this charter version becomes operationally binding for the DSMB/DMC. May differ from approval date if a transition period is specified.']
  efficacy_stopping_rule_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the pre-specified statistical criteria for early stopping of the study due to overwhelming efficacy (e.g., conditional power threshold, p-value boundary at each interim look). Authored by Biostatistics.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'Date on which this charter version ceases to be operative, typically upon supersession by an amended version or study close-out. Nullable for open-ended charters.']
  futility_rule_binding boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the futility stopping rule is binding (the DSMB recommendation to stop for futility is mandatory) or non-binding (advisory only). Binding rules have regulatory and operational implications.']
  futility_stopping_rule_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the pre-specified criteria for early stopping due to futility (e.g., conditional power below threshold, binding or non-binding futility boundary). Authored by Biostatistics.']
  governing_regulatory_framework varchar [note: 'Primary regulatory framework(s) under which the DSMB/DMC operates (e.g., FDA 21 CFR, EU CTR 536/2014, ICH E6(R2)). Determines applicable procedural and reporting requirements.']
  independent_statistician_organization varchar [note: 'Name of the organization or academic institution to which the independent DSMB statistician is affiliated, confirming independence from the sponsor and CRO.']
  interim_analysis_schedule_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the timing and triggers for each planned interim analysis (e.g., after 25%, 50%, 75% of events; after N subjects enrolled). Complements the structured interim analysis count.']
  mastercontrol_document_reference varchar [note: 'Document control identifier assigned to this DSMB charter in MasterControl, used for tracking approval workflows, training requirements, and audit trails associated with the charter.']
  meeting_frequency varchar [note: 'Scheduled frequency of DSMB/DMC meetings as defined in the charter. Governs the cadence of safety reviews and interim analyses. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: monthly|quarterly|semi_annual|annual|per_interim_analysis|ad_hoc|other — promote to reference product]']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional operational notes, clarifications, or contextual information about this DSMB charter record not captured in structured fields.']
  open_session_scope varchar [note: 'Description of the agenda items and participants permitted in the open (non-confidential) session of DSMB/DMC meetings, typically including sponsor representatives and investigators reviewing blinded aggregate safety data.']
  quorum_requirement varchar [note: 'Minimum number of DSMB/DMC members required to be present for a meeting to be valid and for recommendations to be binding. Defined in the charter.']
  recommendation_types_allowed varchar [note: 'Enumeration of the formal recommendation categories the DSMB/DMC is empowered to issue per the charter (e.g., continue as planned, modify protocol, stop for efficacy, stop for futility, stop for safety, increase sample size). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: continue|modify_protocol|stop_efficacy|stop_futility|stop_safety|increase_sample_size|other — promote to reference product]']
  reporting_timeline_days varchar [note: 'Maximum number of calendar days within which the DSMB/DMC must issue its written recommendation report to the sponsor following a meeting, as specified in the charter.']
  safety_stopping_rule_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the pre-specified criteria for early stopping or study modification due to unacceptable safety signals (e.g., excess SAE rate, SUSAR threshold, mortality imbalance). Aligned with Oracle Argus Safety signal detection.']
  sponsor_response_timeline_days varchar [note: 'Maximum number of calendar days within which the sponsor must formally respond to a DSMB/DMC recommendation, as defined in the charter.']
  total_interim_analyses_planned varchar [note: 'Total number of formal interim analyses planned for the study as specified in the DSMB charter and aligned with the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP). Drives alpha-spending allocation.']
  total_member_count varchar [note: 'Total number of voting members constituting the DSMB/DMC as defined in the charter. Typically an odd number (3–7) to enable majority voting on recommendations.']
  unblinding_procedure_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the procedures governing when and how unblinded data are provided to the DSMB/DMC independent statistician, including access controls, secure data transfer protocols, and firewall arrangements between the independent statistician and the sponsor.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this DSMB charter record, supporting audit trail and ALCOA+ data integrity requirements.']

  Note: 'Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) / Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) charter record for a study. Captures committee composition, member roles (chair, statistician, clinician), meeting frequency, interim analysis schedule, stopping rules, unblinding procedures, confidentiality requirements, charter version, and approval date. Biostatistics owns the statistical stopping rule design and independent statistician coordination.'
}

  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study for which this consent was obtained. Links the consent record to the parent study protocol.']

  capacity_assessment_outcome varchar [note: 'Result of the subject decision-making capacity assessment. \'capable\' = subject has full capacity to consent; \'incapable\' = subject lacks capacity, LAR consent required; \'borderline\' = capacity is uncertain, additional review required; \'not_applicable\' = assessment not required for this subject.']
  capacity_assessment_performed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a formal subject decision-making capacity assessment was performed prior to obtaining consent. Required for vulnerable populations and subjects with potential cognitive impairment.']
  comprehension_assessment_performed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a formal comprehension assessment (e.g., teach-back method, quiz) was administered to verify the subject understood the consent information. Increasingly required by IRBs and FDA for complex protocols.']

  consent_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the subject (or LAR) signed or electronically acknowledged the Informed Consent Form. This is the principal real-world event date for the consent transaction and is used for protocol eligibility window calculations.']
  consent_method varchar [note: 'Method by which informed consent was obtained. \'paper\' = traditional wet-ink signature on paper ICF; \'econsent\' = electronic consent via Clinpal eConsent platform; \'remote_econsent\' = remote electronic consent (e.g., telemedicine); \'telephone\' = verbal consent with witness (where permitted); \'legally_authorized_rep\' = consent obtained via a Legally Authorized Representative (LAR).']

  subject_questions_documented boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the subject\'s questions and the investigator\'s responses were documented during the consent discussion, as required by GCP. Supports audit readiness and IRB inspection compliance.']
  translation_language varchar [note: 'ISO 639-1/639-2 language code of the ICF translation provided to the subject (e.g., \'es\' for Spanish, \'fr\' for French, \'zh-CN\' for Simplified Chinese). Null if the ICF was provided in the site\'s primary language. Required for multi-lingual trial compliance.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this consent record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Required for change tracking, audit trail completeness, and ALCOA+ compliance.']
  withdrawal_date date [note: 'Date on which the subject formally withdrew consent to participate in the study. Populated only when consent_status is \'withdrawn\'. Triggers subject discontinuation workflow.']
  withdrawal_reason varchar [note: 'Primary reason for consent withdrawal as documented at the site. Used for subject disposition analysis and protocol feasibility reporting. Aligns with CDISC SDTM DS Domain disposition reason coding.']

  witness_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a witness was required for this consent event (e.g., for illiterate subjects, subjects with limited reading ability, or verbal consent scenarios per ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.9).']

  Note: 'Core transactional record capturing the consent event for a trial subject at a specific site and study. Records the date and time of consent, ICF version consented to, consent method (paper, eConsent via Clinpal), consenting staff (PI, CRC), witness details, subject capacity assessment outcome, LAR (Legally Authorized Representative) involvement flag, and consent status (consented, withdrawn, re-consent pending, expired). Table consent.econsent_session {
  econsent_session_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each eConsent workflow session initiated in Clinpal for a trial subject. Primary key for this data product.']
  consent_icf_version_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific IRB/IEC-approved Informed Consent Form (ICF) version presented to the subject during this session. Ensures the correct, current consent document was used.']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the site staff member (Principal Investigator or delegated Clinical Research Coordinator) who witnessed or facilitated the eConsent session. Required for GCP compliance and delegation log traceability.']
  investigational_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical trial site at which the subject is enrolled and where this consent session is associated. Supports site-level compliance monitoring.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study (protocol) for which this eConsent session was conducted. Enables study-level consent compliance reporting.']
  trial_subject_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the trial subject (participant) for whom this eConsent session was initiated. Links to the subject master record.']
  capacity_assessment_outcome varchar [note: 'Result of the capacity assessment performed for the subject. \'capable\' indicates the subject has decision-making capacity; \'not-capable\' indicates a legally authorized representative is required; \'not-assessed\' indicates no assessment was conducted; \'deferred\' indicates assessment was postponed.']
  capacity_assessment_performed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a formal capacity assessment was performed for the subject prior to or during this consent session (True = performed; False = not performed). Required for vulnerable populations and subjects with potential cognitive impairment.']
  clinpal_session_ref varchar [note: 'The native session identifier assigned by the Clinpal eConsent platform for this workflow session. Used for cross-system traceability and reconciliation with the source system of record.']
  communication_platform varchar [note: 'The teleconference or video communication platform used for remote consent sessions (e.g., Zoom, Microsoft Teams, WebEx). Applicable only when session_modality is \'remote-video\' or \'remote-phone\'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Zoom|Teams|WebEx|Skype|Clinpal-Video|Phone|Other — promote to reference product]']
  comprehension_attempt_number varchar [note: 'The sequential attempt number for the comprehension check within this session. Subjects may be permitted multiple attempts after remediation. Tracks how many times the subject attempted the comprehension assessment.']
  comprehension_check_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the comprehension check question set administered to the subject during this session. Ensures traceability to the specific validated question set used, as question sets may be updated with ICF amendments.']
  comprehension_overall_passed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the subject passed the overall comprehension check for this session (True = passed; False = failed). Determined by comparing the score against the minimum passing threshold defined in the ICF version.']
  comprehension_questions_passed varchar [note: 'Number of comprehension check questions answered correctly by the subject in this session. Used to compute the overall comprehension score and determine pass/fail outcome.']
  comprehension_questions_total varchar [note: 'Total number of comprehension check questions administered to the subject in this session. Used to calculate the comprehension score and assess understanding of the consent content.']
  consent_granted boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the subject (or legally authorized representative) granted informed consent at the conclusion of this session (True = consent granted; False = consent not granted or declined). The definitive consent outcome flag for this session.']
  consenter_role varchar [note: 'The role of the individual who provided consent during this session. \'subject\' indicates the participant themselves; \'legally-authorized-representative\' indicates a proxy consenter; \'parent\' or \'guardian\' applies to pediatric studies. Required for capacity assessment and consent validity determination.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time (with timezone offset) when this eConsent session record was first created in the data platform. Supports ALCOA+ (Attributable, Contemporaneous) audit trail requirements.']
  device_os varchar [note: 'Operating system and version of the device used during the eConsent session (e.g., iOS 16.4, Android 13, Windows 11). Supports technical audit trail and system validation requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.']
  device_type varchar [note: 'Category of device used by the subject to access and complete the eConsent session. Supports technical audit trail requirements and device compatibility analysis.']
  esignature_captured boolean [note: 'Indicates whether an electronic signature was successfully captured from the subject (or legally authorized representative) during this session (True = captured; False = not captured). A prerequisite for consent to be considered legally valid under 21 CFR Part 11.']
  esignature_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time (with timezone offset) when the subject\'s electronic signature was captured in Clinpal. Critical for ALCOA+ (Contemporaneous) compliance and 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail. Null if no signature was captured.']
  interpreter_used boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a language interpreter was used during the consent session (True = interpreter used; False = no interpreter). Relevant for non-English-speaking subjects and required for GCP documentation of consent comprehension.']
  ip_address varchar [note: 'IP address of the device used by the subject during the eConsent session. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records audit trail and GDPR accountability. May be considered PII in certain jurisdictions.']
  irb_approval_ref varchar [note: 'The IRB or IEC approval number or reference associated with the ICF version used in this session. Confirms the consent document presented was approved by the appropriate ethics body at the time of the session.']
  reconsent_trigger boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this session was initiated as a re-consent event (True) rather than an initial consent (False). Re-consent is triggered by protocol amendments, new safety information, or ICF version updates requiring subjects to re-affirm consent.']
  remediation_provided boolean [note: 'Indicates whether remediation (additional educational content or re-review of ICF sections) was provided to the subject following a failed comprehension check attempt (True = remediation was provided; False = not provided).']
  remediation_steps_count varchar [note: 'Number of remediation steps (re-review sections or educational modules) completed by the subject following a failed comprehension check. Null if no remediation was provided.']
  review_steps_completed varchar [note: 'The number of ICF review steps (content sections) the subject completed during this session. Compared against review_steps_total to assess session progress and identify drop-off points.']
  review_steps_total varchar [note: 'The total number of review steps (content sections or pages) defined in the ICF version presented during this session. Used to calculate completion percentage and identify where subjects abandoned the session.']
  session_end_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time (with timezone offset) when the eConsent session concluded, regardless of outcome (completed, abandoned, timed-out, or declined). Null if the session is still in-progress.']
  session_language varchar [note: 'IETF BCP 47 language tag representing the language in which the eConsent session was conducted (e.g., \'en\', \'es\', \'fr-CA\'). Ensures the subject received consent information in their preferred language, as required by GCP and GDPR.']
  session_modality varchar [note: 'The mode by which the consent session was conducted. \'in-person\' indicates the subject and site staff were physically co-located; \'remote-video\' indicates a teleconference/video call; \'remote-phone\' indicates a telephone-only session; \'hybrid\' indicates a combination. Supports FDA remote consent guidance compliance.']
  session_recording_ref varchar [note: 'Reference identifier or URL to the recording of the remote consent session (e.g., stored in Veeva Vault or a secure media repository). Applicable for remote sessions where recording is required per FDA remote consent guidance. Null for in-person sessions.']
  session_start_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time (with timezone offset) when the eConsent session was initiated by the subject or site staff in Clinpal. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.']
  session_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the eConsent workflow session. \'in-progress\' indicates an active session; \'completed\' indicates the subject finished all steps; \'abandoned\' indicates the subject exited without completing; \'timed-out\' indicates the session expired due to inactivity; \'declined\' indicates the subject explicitly refused consent.']
  subject_auth_method varchar [note: 'The method used to authenticate the subject\'s identity at the start of the eConsent session. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 identity verification requirements for electronic signatures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: password|otp-sms|otp-email|biometric|pin|site-staff-verified — promote to reference product]']
  subject_location_country varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country where the subject was physically located at the time of the eConsent session. Relevant for decentralized trials and cross-border GDPR/HIPAA compliance determination.']
  technical_issue_description varchar [note: 'Free-text description of any technical issue encountered during the session (e.g., \'Video connection dropped at step 3\', \'Signature pad unresponsive\'). Null if no technical issue was encountered. Supports deviation investigation and CAPA processes.']
  technical_issue_encountered boolean [note: 'Indicates whether any technical issue (connectivity failure, platform error, device malfunction, signature capture failure) was encountered during the session (True = issue encountered; False = no issues). Supports root cause analysis for incomplete sessions.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time (with timezone offset) when this eConsent session record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking and audit trail completeness under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+.']
  witness_esignature_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time (with timezone offset) when the site staff witness (PI or CRC) applied their electronic countersignature to the consent record. Required for GCP-compliant consent documentation. Null if witness signature was not captured in this session.']

  Note: 'Tracks each eConsent workflow session initiated in Clinpal for a subject, including both on-site and remote/decentralized consent sessions. Captures session start and end timestamps, device type, IP address, session modality (in-person, remote via teleconference/video), communication platform for remote sessions, session recording reference, subject location, session status (in-progress, completed, abandoned, timed-out), subject authentication method, number of review steps completed, comprehension check results (question set version, individual responses, pass/fail per question, overall score, attempts, remediation steps), electronic signature capture timestamp, technical issues encountered, and Clinpal session reference ID. Supports 21 CFR Part 11, FDA remote consent guidance, and GDPR audit requirements.'
}

  waiver_approval_date date [note: 'The date on which the IRB/IEC formally approved the waiver of re-consent for this trigger. Nullable when no waiver has been granted. Required for regulatory audit trail when resolution_status is \'waived\'.']
  waiver_justification varchar [note: 'Documented justification for waiving the re-consent requirement, as approved by the IRB/IEC. Required when resolution_status is \'waived\'. Must reference the IRB/IEC waiver approval and the regulatory basis for the waiver.']

  Note: 'Records events that necessitate re-consent of a subject, such as a protocol amendment, new safety information, ICF version update, or regulatory authority requirement. Drives re-consent workflow management across sites.'

Captures event timestamp, event type (created, signed, amended, withdrawn, re-consented, voided, status_changed), actor user ID and role, source system (Clinpal, Veeva Vault, CTMS), previous and new field values, applicable ICF version at time of change, digital signature hash, and IP address. Provides complete chronological consent status history per subject-study-site combination. Supports ALCOA+ data integrity requirements, 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance, GCP audit trail obligations, and regulatory inspection queries about subject consent history.'
}

  assent_method varchar [note: 'The method by which assent was obtained from the subject. \'written\' = paper-based signed form; \'verbal\' = verbal assent documented by witness; \'eassent\' = electronic assent via Clinpal platform; \'video_assisted\' = assent supported by video explanation; \'pictorial\' = assent using pictorial/visual aids for cognitively limited subjects.']
  assent_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for the assent record, used in regulatory submissions, audit trails, and site communications. Format: ASN-{StudyCode}-{Sequence}.']
  assent_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the assent record. \'obtained\' = assent successfully documented; \'declined\' = subject declined assent; \'withdrawn\' = previously given assent was withdrawn; \'pending\' = assent process initiated but not completed; \'not_applicable\' = subject determined incapable of providing assent; \'capacity_reassessed\' = subject capacity re-evaluated triggering re-assent.   scheme_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the randomization scheme (e.g., \'1.0\', \'2.1\'). Incremented when the scheme is amended post-approval. Supports audit trail and regulatory submission traceability.']
  strata_count varchar [note: 'Total number of distinct strata defined by the combination of stratification factors. Used to validate that the randomization list covers all strata and to monitor enrollment balance.']

  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to this randomization scheme record. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and version control in the silver layer.']

  Note: 'Master definition of a randomization scheme for a clinical study. Owned by the biostatistics/RTSM team and referenced by all randomization activities. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One and Medidata Rave RTSM module.'

  list_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the randomization list (e.g., v1.0, v2.0). Incremented when the list is regenerated or amended, supporting audit trail and regulatory traceability.']

  randomization_seed varchar [note: 'The random number generator seed value used to produce this list. Classified as confidential to protect blinding integrity. Required for reproducibility validation and regulatory inspection.']

  superseded_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this randomization list was superseded by a newer version. Null if the list is still active. Supports version lifecycle audit trail.']
  total_slots varchar [note: 'Total number of randomization positions (slots) in this list, representing the maximum number of subjects that can be assigned using this list.']
  treatment_arm_count varchar [note: 'Number of distinct treatment arms (including placebo/control) covered by this randomization list. Validates alignment with the protocol-defined study design.']
  unblinding_procedure varchar [note: 'Defined procedure type for unblinding this randomization list. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: emergency_unblinding|scheduled_dbl_unblinding|dsmb_unblinding|regulatory_unblinding — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]']

  Note: 'The generated randomization list produced from a randomization scheme.   level_count varchar [note: 'Total number of enumerated levels (strata) defined for this stratification factor. Drives the dimensionality of the stratification matrix and the number of randomization lists required. For example, a 3-region factor has level_count = 3.']
  max_imbalance_threshold decimal(5,2) [note: 'The maximum allowable imbalance (as a percentage or absolute count, per unit_of_imbalance) between treatment arms within any stratum defined by this factor before a balancing action is triggered in the minimization algorithm.']
  minimization_variant varchar [note: 'Specific variant of the minimization algorithm applied for this factor: \'pocock_simon\' for the Pocock-Simon method, \'weighted_minimization\' for factor-weighted minimization, \'biased_coin\' for biased-coin minimization, \'deterministic\' for deterministic minimization, \'none\' if minimization is not applicable.']
  minimization_weight decimal(5,4) [note: 'Numeric weight assigned to this stratification factor in a minimization or weighted minimization algorithm (e.g., Pocock-Simon). Values typically range from 0.0 to 1.0, with higher weights indicating greater influence on treatment allocation balance. Null if minimization is not used.']
  missing_value_handling varchar [note: 'Defines the RTSM system behavior when the stratification factor value is missing or unknown at the time of randomization: \'block_randomization\' to prevent randomization, \'assign_default_level\' to use a pre-specified default level, \'flag_and_hold\' to alert the site, \'exclude_from_minimization\' to proceed without this factor.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional operational notes, biostatistician comments, or RTSM configuration remarks related to this stratification factor that do not fit into structured fields. Not used for regulatory submissions.']
  protocol_section_reference varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific section of the study protocol document that defines this stratification factor (e.g., \'Section 8.2.1 Stratification Factors\'). Enables traceability from the data model to the governing protocol.']
  randomization_algorithm varchar [note: 'The randomization algorithm applied in conjunction with this stratification factor: \'permuted_block\' for block randomization within strata, \'minimization\' for adaptive minimization, \'stratified_block\' for stratified permuted block, \'dynamic_allocation\' for covariate-adaptive methods.']
  rtsm_factor_code varchar [note: 'The native identifier assigned to this stratification factor within the source RTSM/IRT system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM internal factor ID or Oracle Clinical One factor GUID). Used for system integration, reconciliation, and audit trail linkage.']
  rtsm_system varchar [note: 'Identifies the RTSM/IRT/IVRS system in which this stratification factor is configured and operationalized for subject randomization and kit assignment.']
  sap_section_reference varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific section of the Statistical Analysis Plan that describes the use of this stratification factor in primary and sensitivity analyses (e.g., \'SAP Section 5.3 Stratification\'). Supports regulatory audit traceability.']
  sdtm_variable varchar [note: 'The CDISC SDTM variable name that maps to this stratification factor for regulatory submission datasets (e.g., \'STRAT1\', \'REGION1\'). Used in SDTM TR/SUPPFA domains and ADaM ADSL derivations.']
  sort_order varchar [note: 'Integer defining the display and processing sequence of this stratification factor within the randomization scheme. Lower values appear first in RTSM screens, SAP tables, and stratification matrix axes.']
  unit_of_imbalance varchar [note: 'Specifies whether the max_imbalance_threshold is expressed as a \'percentage\' of subjects within the stratum or as an absolute \'subject_count\'. Determines how the RTSM system evaluates balance during randomization.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this stratification factor record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks configuration changes and supports change control audit trail under 21 CFR Part 11.']
  validation_rule varchar [note: 'Business rule or logical expression applied to validate the stratification factor value at the time of randomization (e.g., \'BMIBL >= 18 AND BMIBL < 30\'). Prevents invalid factor assignments and ensures data integrity per ALCOA+ principles.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Version identifier of this stratification factor definition, incremented with each protocol amendment or RTSM configuration change (e.g., \'1.0\', \'2.0\'). Supports change control and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.']

  Note: 'Defines the stratification factors used in a randomization scheme, including factor name, factor code, data source (eCRF field reference), factor type (categorical, continuous-binned), enumerated levels (level code, label, sort order, active status), and optional minimization parameters (weight value, algorithm variant such as Pocock-Simon or weighted minimization). Each factor belongs to one randomization scheme and its levels define the axes of the stratification matrix. Owned by the biostatistics/RTSM team as part of scheme design.'
}

Table randomization.stratification_cell {
  stratification_cell_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for a stratification cell record within the randomization scheme. Primary key for this entity.']
  rand_scheme_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the parent randomization scheme under which this stratification cell is defined. Links the cell to its governing allocation algorithm.']
  regulatory_protocol_amendment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.protocol_amendment. Business justification: Stratification cells are defined per protocol amendment version. Changes to stratification cell definitions require amendment approval. Regulatory audit trails and enrollment reports must link cells t']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study for which this stratification cell is defined. Enables cross-study reporting and enrollment balance monitoring.']
  treatment_arm_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the treatment arm associated with this stratification cell. Enables arm-level enrollment balance monitoring within each stratum.']
  actual_enrolled_count varchar [note: 'Current count of subjects who have been randomized and enrolled into this stratification cell. Updated in real time from the IRT/RTSM system (Medidata Rave RTSM / Oracle Clinical One) upon each randomization event.']
  allocation_ratio varchar [note: 'Ratio of subject allocation across treatment arms within this stratification cell (e.g., \'1:1\', \'2:1\', \'1:1:1\'). Defined in the protocol and SAP and configured in the RTSM system.']
  balance_tolerance_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Acceptable percentage deviation from the target enrollment count before the cell is flagged as imbalanced. Defined in the SAP and used by the RTSM system to trigger balance alerts.']
  block_size varchar [note: 'Size of the permuted block used for randomization within this stratification cell. A value of zero or null indicates variable block size or non-block-based methods. Stored as confidential to protect blinding integrity.']
  cell_balance_status varchar [note: 'Current enrollment balance status of this stratification cell relative to its target. \'balanced\' indicates enrollment is within acceptable tolerance; \'under_enrolled\' or \'over_enrolled\' indicate deviation from target; \'closed\' indicates the cell is no longer accepting subjects; \'suspended\' indicates temporary halt.']
  cell_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this stratification cell within the study randomization scheme. Used in IRT/IVRS/RTSM systems such as Medidata Rave RTSM and Oracle Clinical One for cell-level kit assignment and allocation tracking.']
  cell_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative description of the stratification cell, including the clinical rationale for the factor level combination and any protocol-specific notes.']
  cell_label varchar [note: 'Human-readable composite label describing the full combination of stratification factor levels that define this cell (e.g., \'Age>=65 / Male / ECOG 0-1\'). Used in study reports, CSR tables, and enrollment dashboards.']
  cell_sequence varchar [note: 'Ordinal sequence number of this cell within the randomization scheme, used for consistent ordering in reports, listings, and IRT/RTSM system configuration.']
  cell_status varchar [note: 'Operational lifecycle status of the stratification cell within the randomization scheme. \'active\' means the cell is open for randomization; \'inactive\' means it has been deactivated; \'closed\' means enrollment is complete; \'suspended\' means temporarily halted; \'draft\' means not yet activated.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this stratification cell record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.']
  enrollment_close_date date [note: 'Date on which this stratification cell was closed to further subject randomization, either due to reaching the enrollment cap or protocol-driven closure.']
  enrollment_open_date date [note: 'Date on which this stratification cell was opened for subject randomization and enrollment, as recorded in the RTSM system.']
  geographic_region varchar [note: 'Geographic region stratification factor level associated with this cell (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific), when geography is used as a stratification factor. Supports regional enrollment balance monitoring.']
  is_active_for_enrollment boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this stratification cell is currently open and accepting new subject randomizations. Controlled by the RTSM system and updated when enrollment caps or protocol amendments are applied.']
  is_blinded boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the treatment arm assignment within this stratification cell is blinded to investigators and subjects. True for double-blind studies; False for open-label designs.']
  last_randomization_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent subject randomization event recorded within this stratification cell. Used to monitor cell activity and detect stalled enrollment.']
  maximum_enrollment_count varchar [note: 'Maximum number of subjects permitted in this stratification cell per treatment arm. Enrollment is capped at this value to prevent over-representation of a stratum.']
  minimum_enrollment_count varchar [note: 'Minimum number of subjects required in this stratification cell to maintain statistical validity of the study, as specified in the SAP. Triggers an alert if actual enrollment falls below this threshold.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text operational notes or comments regarding this stratification cell, such as enrollment challenges, protocol deviation impacts, or DSMB/DMC recommendations affecting cell management.']
  protocol_version varchar [note: 'Version of the study protocol under which this stratification cell definition was established or last amended. Ensures traceability of cell definitions to specific protocol versions for regulatory submissions.']
  randomization_method varchar [note: 'Randomization algorithm applied within this stratification cell (e.g., permuted block, minimization, dynamic allocation). Determines how subjects are allocated to treatment arms within the cell.']
  randomized_count varchar [note: 'Number of subjects who have received a randomization code assignment within this stratification cell, which may differ from enrolled count if subjects are randomized but not yet dosed.']
  rtsm_cell_reference varchar [note: 'External cell identifier as configured in the RTSM system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM or Oracle Clinical One IRT). Used for reconciliation between the data lakehouse and the operational RTSM system.']
  sap_version varchar [note: 'Version of the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) that defines the stratification factors, cell structure, and enrollment targets for this cell. Critical for regulatory audit traceability.']
  screened_count varchar [note: 'Number of subjects who have been screened and assessed for eligibility within this stratification cell, used to monitor the screening-to-enrollment funnel per stratum.']
  sdtm_stratum_value decimal(18,2) [note: 'CDISC SDTM-compliant stratum value code for this cell, mapped to the STRATCD variable in the RAND domain. Required for regulatory submission datasets and SDTM-to-ADaM derivations.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Operational system of record from which this stratification cell record originated (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM, Oracle Clinical One). Used for data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the Silver layer.']
  target_enrollment_count varchar [note: 'Protocol-specified target number of subjects to be enrolled in this stratification cell per treatment arm, as defined in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) and randomization schedule.']
  updated_by varchar [note: 'Username or system identifier of the user or process that last modified this stratification cell record. Required for electronic records compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ attributability.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this stratification cell record. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11.']
  withdrawn_count varchar [note: 'Number of subjects who were enrolled in this stratification cell but subsequently withdrew or were discontinued, used to assess cell-level dropout impact on balance.']
  created_by varchar [note: 'Username or system identifier of the user or process that created this stratification cell record. Required for electronic records compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ attributability.']

  Note: 'Represents the unique combination of stratification factor levels that defines a single stratum cell within a randomization scheme. Stores the cell identifier, composite cell label, target subject count per arm within the cell, actual enrolled count, and cell balance status. Used to monitor enrollment balance across strata.'
}

  source_system_record_code varchar [note: 'The native primary key or record identifier of this transaction as stored in the originating IRT/RTSM source system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM internal record ID). Enables lineage tracing from the silver layer back to the operational system.']
  stratification_factor_1 varchar [note: 'The value of the first stratification factor used in the randomization algorithm at the time of this transaction (e.g., disease severity, geographic region, age group). Captured from the RTSM at the point of randomization.']
  stratification_factor_2 varchar [note: 'The value of the second stratification factor used in the randomization algorithm at the time of this transaction (e.g., prior therapy, biomarker status). Nullable if the study uses fewer than two stratification factors.']
  stratification_factor_3 varchar [note: 'The value of the third stratification factor used in the randomization algorithm at the time of this transaction. Nullable if the study uses fewer than three stratification factors.']
  subject_number varchar [note: 'The human-readable subject identifier assigned by the IRT/RTSM system at the time of randomization (e.g., site-subject number such as 001-001). Used for cross-system reconciliation with EDC and eCRF data. Classified as restricted PII as it can identify a trial participant.']
  transaction_outcome varchar [note: 'The technical outcome of the IRT transaction as reported by the RTSM system, indicating whether the transaction was successfully processed or encountered an error condition. Distinct from transaction_status which reflects the business lifecycle state.']
  transaction_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the IRT transaction indicating whether it was successfully processed, failed, cancelled, or is pending confirmation in the RTSM system.']
  transaction_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the IRT/IVRS/RTSM transaction event occurred in the source system.   transaction_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the IRT transaction indicating the business event performed. Drives downstream processing logic for supply management and randomization audit. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: randomization|re_randomization|kit_assignment|dose_change|titration|cancellation|unblinding|screen_failure|withdrawal — promote to reference product]']
  unblinding_reason varchar [note: 'The documented reason for emergency unblinding of a subject\'s treatment assignment (e.g., SAE requiring knowledge of treatment, DSMB review). Populated only when blinding_status is unblinded.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this IRT transaction record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks corrections, reversals, or status updates applied after initial capture.']

  Note: 'Detailed log of all IRT/IVRS/RTSM system transactions related to randomization and kit dispensing. Captures transaction type (randomization, re-randomization, cancellation, kit assignment, dose change, titration), transaction timestamp, IRT system reference number, site identifier, subject identifier, operator ID, and transaction outcome. Provides the full audit trail of IRT interactions for GCP compliance and SDV. Sourced from Medidata Rave RTSM.'
}
