Table workforce.gcp_training_record {
  gcp_training_record_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each GCP training record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this transactional entity. TRANSACTION_HEADER role — captures a discrete training completion event for a workforce member.']
  certificate_document_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the scanned or electronic training certificate stored in Veeva Vault eTMF or MasterControl document management. Enables direct access to the source certificate for audit and inspection purposes.']
  electronic_signature_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of the electronic signature applied to this training record in MasterControl, confirming the workforce member\'s acknowledgment of training completion. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance for electronic records.']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the workforce member (CRA, CRC, biostatistician, data manager, medical monitor, regulatory specialist, etc.) who completed this GCP training. Sourced from Workday HCM employee record.']
  investigational_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical trial site for which this site-specific or protocol-specific GCP training was completed. Null for general GCP training not tied to a specific site. Used for site-level compliance reporting.']
  study_assignment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to workforce.study_assignment. Business justification: gcp_training_record already has employee_id and study_id, but linking to the specific study_assignment provides richer context — it ties the GCP training completion to the formal assignment record for']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study for which this protocol-specific GCP training was completed. Null for general GCP training not tied to a specific study. Used to verify study-specific training compliance on delegation logs.']
  training_course_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the training course master record in MasterControl that defines the course curriculum, version, and requirements for this GCP training.']
  training_curriculum_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to workforce.training_curriculum. Business justification: gcp_training_record has is_curriculum_required (BOOLEAN) indicating it may be part of a structured curriculum, but lacks a FK to training_curriculum. training_curriculum.gcp_training_included (BOOLEAN']
  assessment_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Numeric score achieved by the workforce member on the GCP training assessment, expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Null if no assessment was administered (read-and-acknowledge training type). Used for quality monitoring and remedial training decisions.']
  assigned_date date [note: 'The date on which this GCP training was formally assigned to the workforce member in MasterControl. Used to calculate time-to-completion and overdue status.']
  certificate_issued_date date [note: 'The date on which the training certificate was formally issued by the training provider. May differ from completion_date if certificate issuance involves a processing delay. Required for TMF documentation.']
  certificate_number varchar [note: 'Unique certificate or credential reference number issued upon successful completion of the GCP training. Used for regulatory inspection readiness, TMF filing, and delegation log verification. Aligns with ALCOA+ original documentation requirements.']
  comments varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional notes or context related to this GCP training record (e.g., special circumstances, remedial training context, inspector observations). Supports ALCOA+ completeness principle.']
  completion_date date [note: 'The date on which the workforce member successfully completed the GCP training. This is the principal business event date for this transaction record. Used to calculate training currency and expiry. Aligns with ALCOA+ principle of contemporaneous documentation.']
  course_code varchar [note: 'Alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the training course in MasterControl (e.g., \'TRN-GCP-001\'). Used for structured reporting, filtering, and integration with CTMS and eTMF systems.']
  course_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the GCP training course as defined in MasterControl (e.g., \'ICH E6(R2) GCP Fundamentals\', \'GCP Refresher Training\', \'Protocol-Specific GCP Training — Study XYZ-001\'). Used for reporting and compliance verification.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which this GCP training record was first created in the source system (MasterControl). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and ALCOA+ compliance verification.']
  due_date date [note: 'The deadline by which the workforce member must complete this GCP training as defined in MasterControl. Used for compliance monitoring, overdue tracking, and escalation workflows.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'The date on which this GCP training certification expires and a refresher training is required. Typically 2–3 years from completion date per sponsor and regulatory requirements. Null if the training does not expire (e.g., one-time protocol-specific training).']
  gcp_guideline_version varchar [note: 'The specific version of the GCP guideline covered by this training (e.g., ICH E6(R2), ICH E6(R3)). Critical for regulatory compliance verification — regulators require training to be current with the applicable guideline version.']
  is_curriculum_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this training record was generated from a mandatory curriculum assignment (True) or was voluntarily completed outside of a formal curriculum (False). Used to distinguish mandatory compliance training from elective training.']
  is_gcp_current boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this training record represents a currently valid (non-expired) GCP certification (True) or has expired (False). Derived from expiry_date vs. current date but stored as a business flag for efficient compliance queries and delegation log validation.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which this GCP training record was most recently modified in the source system (MasterControl). Used for change tracking, audit trail, and Silver Layer incremental load processing.']
  mastercontrol_record_code varchar [note: 'The externally-known unique identifier assigned by MasterControl training management system to this training completion record. Used for cross-system traceability and audit trail back to the system of record.']
  max_attempts_allowed varchar [note: 'The maximum number of assessment attempts permitted for this GCP training course as configured in MasterControl. Captured at training time to preserve the applicable policy.']
  number_of_attempts varchar [note: 'Total number of attempts the workforce member made on the GCP training assessment before achieving a pass or exhausting allowed attempts. Used for quality monitoring and identifying personnel who may need additional support.']
  pass_fail_status varchar [note: 'Outcome of the training assessment: \'pass\' (met or exceeded minimum passing score), \'fail\' (did not meet minimum passing score — remedial training required), \'not_applicable\' (no assessment required for this training type, e.g., read-and-acknowledge only).']
  passing_score_threshold decimal(5,2) [note: 'The minimum assessment score percentage required to pass this GCP training course (e.g., 80.00%). Captured at the time of training completion to preserve the applicable standard even if the course threshold changes in future.']
  regulatory_submission_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this training record has been included in a regulatory submission package (e.g., IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, eCTD) as evidence of GCP-trained personnel. True if included in at least one submission; False otherwise.']
  role_at_training varchar [note: 'The workforce role of the employee at the time of training completion (e.g., \'CRA\', \'CRC\', \'PI\', \'Sub-Investigator\', \'Data Manager\', \'Biostatistician\', \'Medical Monitor\', \'Regulatory Affairs Specialist\'). Captured at training time to preserve historical accuracy even if the employee\'s role changes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CRA|CRC|PI|sub_investigator|data_manager|biostatistician|medical_monitor|regulatory_specialist|study_coordinator|project_manager — promote to reference product]']
  signature_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which the workforce member applied their electronic signature to acknowledge completion of the GCP training in MasterControl. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail compliance.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The operational system of record from which this GCP training record was sourced (e.g., \'MasterControl\' for training management records, \'Workday\' for HR-managed training records, \'Manual\' for paper-based records digitized into the lakehouse).']
  tmf_filing_reference varchar [note: 'The TMF artifact reference number or section code where this training record is filed in the eTMF (e.g., Veeva Vault TMF section \'05.01 — Curriculum Vitae and GCP Training\'). Enables direct traceability between training records and TMF documentation.']
  trainer_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the instructor or trainer who delivered the GCP training (for classroom, webinar, or on-the-job training types). Null for self-paced e-learning. Required for regulatory documentation per ALCOA+ attributability principle.']
  trainer_qualification varchar [note: 'Qualifications or credentials of the trainer who delivered the GCP training (e.g., \'Certified GCP Trainer\', \'CCRP\', \'MD\', \'PhD\'). Documents trainer competency as required for regulatory inspection readiness.']
  training_delivery_method varchar [note: 'The modality through which the GCP training was delivered: \'e_learning\' (self-paced online module in MasterControl), \'classroom\' (in-person instructor-led), \'webinar\' (live virtual instructor-led), \'on_the_job\' (supervised practical training), \'blended\' (combination of modalities).']
  training_duration_hours decimal(5,2) [note: 'Total duration of the GCP training course in hours (e.g., 2.50 for a 2.5-hour e-learning module). Used for workforce capacity planning, training hour reporting, and regulatory documentation of training effort.']
  training_provider varchar [note: 'Name of the organization or entity that delivered the GCP training (e.g., \'CITI Program\', \'TransCelerate\', \'Internal Training Department\', \'ACRP\', \'SOCRA\', \'External CRO Training Vendor\'). Required for regulatory documentation and audit trail.']
  training_provider_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the training provider: \'internal\' (delivered by the CRO\'s own training department), \'external\' (third-party training vendor), \'sponsor\' (delivered by the pharmaceutical/biotech sponsor), \'regulatory_body\' (delivered by FDA, EMA, ICH, or equivalent).']
  training_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of this training record: \'completed\' (training finished and passed), \'in_progress\' (training assigned and started but not yet finished), \'overdue\' (past due date without completion), \'waived\' (formally waived with documented justification), \'cancelled\' (training assignment cancelled).']
  training_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the training event: \'initial\' (first-time GCP certification), \'refresher\' (periodic renewal), \'protocol_specific\' (study-specific GCP requirements), \'role_specific\' (role-based GCP training for CRA, CRC, PI, etc.), \'remedial\' (corrective training following a deviation or finding).']
  waiver_approved_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the authorized person (e.g., QA Manager, Training Manager) who approved the training waiver. Null if training_status is not \'waived\'. Required for regulatory accountability per ALCOA+ attributability principle.']
  waiver_date date [note: 'The date on which the training waiver was formally approved. Null if training_status is not \'waived\'. Required for audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness.']
  waiver_reason varchar [note: 'Documented justification for waiving this GCP training requirement (e.g., \'Equivalent training completed at prior employer within validity period\', \'Regulatory authority-recognized equivalent certification held\'). Null if training_status is not \'waived\'. Required for audit trail.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of GCP (Good Clinical Practice) training completions for each workforce member, sourced from MasterControl training management module. Captures training course name, ICH E6(R2) GCP version, training type (initial, refresher, protocol-specific), completion date, expiry date, training provider, assessment score, pass/fail status, and certificate reference. Critical for regulatory compliance — GCP training currency is required for all trial personnel per FDA 21 CFR Part 312 and ICH E6.'
}

Table workforce.certification {
  certification_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each professional certification record held by a clinical research workforce member. Primary key for the certification data product.']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the workforce member (CRA, CRC, biostatistician, data manager, medical monitor, regulatory specialist, etc.) who holds this certification. Links to the employee/worker master record in Workday HCM.']
  ce_credits_earned decimal(6,2) [note: 'Total number of continuing education (CE) credits earned by the workforce member in the current renewal cycle toward maintaining or renewing this certification. Compared against ce_credits_required to assess compliance gap.']
  ce_credits_required decimal(6,2) [note: 'Total number of continuing education (CE) credits required by the issuing body to maintain or renew the certification within the current renewal cycle. Used to track workforce compliance with professional development obligations.']
  ce_cycle_end_date date [note: 'End date of the current continuing education (CE) credit accumulation cycle for this certification. CE credits must be earned by this date to satisfy the renewal requirement.']
  ce_cycle_start_date date [note: 'Start date of the current continuing education (CE) credit accumulation cycle for this certification. CE credits earned before this date do not count toward the current renewal requirement.']
  certification_name varchar [note: 'Full human-readable name of the professional certification or credential (e.g., \'Certified Clinical Research Coordinator\', \'Certified Clinical Research Associate\', \'Regulatory Affairs Certification\', \'SAS Certified Base Programmer\'). Serves as the primary display label for reporting and dashboards.']
  certification_number varchar [note: 'Externally issued unique credential number assigned by the certifying body (e.g., ACRP certificate number, SOCRA CCRP number, RAC registration number). Used for verification with the issuing organization and regulatory audit purposes.']
  certification_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the certification record. \'active\' = valid and in good standing; \'expired\' = past expiry date without renewal; \'suspended\' = temporarily suspended by issuing body; \'revoked\' = permanently withdrawn by issuing body; \'pending\' = awarded but not yet confirmed/verified.']
  certification_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the professional credential by type, indicating the credential program category (e.g., clinical research coordinator, clinical research associate, regulatory affairs, biostatistics, data management). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CCRC|CCRA|CCRP|RAC|SAS_CERTIFIED|CCDM|CPIA|OTHER — promote to reference product]']
  cost_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Total monetary cost incurred by the organization for this certification, including examination fees, application fees, and renewal fees paid to the issuing body. Expressed in the currency specified by cost_currency. Used for workforce development budget tracking in SAP S/4HANA.']
  cost_currency varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost_amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Required for multi-currency financial reporting and budget consolidation in SAP S/4HANA.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this certification record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking.']
  credential_scope varchar [note: 'Geographic or organizational scope of the certification\'s recognition and applicability. \'global\' = recognized internationally (e.g., ICH-aligned); \'regional\' = recognized within a regulatory region (e.g., EU, Asia-Pacific); \'national\' = recognized within a single country; \'institutional\' = recognized only within a specific organization.']
  document_reference varchar [note: 'Reference identifier or URL pointing to the scanned certificate document stored in the eTMF or document management system (Veeva Vault / MasterControl). Enables direct retrieval of the credential document for regulatory inspections and audit purposes.']
  exam_date date [note: 'Date on which the workforce member sat the certification examination. Distinct from issue_date (when the credential was formally awarded). Null if no examination was required for this credential.']
  exam_location varchar [note: 'Name or description of the testing center, proctored online platform, or venue where the certification examination was administered (e.g., \'Prometric Testing Center - Chicago\', \'Online - ProctorU\'). Supports audit trail and verification.']
  exam_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Numeric score achieved by the workforce member on the certification examination, as reported by the issuing body. Expressed as a percentage or raw score per the issuing body\'s scale. Null if the certification does not require an examination.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the certification expires and is no longer valid unless renewed. Null indicates a lifetime or non-expiring credential. Used for automated renewal alerts, resource allocation eligibility checks, and regulatory compliance monitoring.']
  is_gcp_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this certification satisfies or is required as part of the workforce member\'s Good Clinical Practice (GCP) training and qualification obligations for study delegation. True = this credential is a GCP-required qualification; False = professional credential not tied to GCP mandate.']
  is_regulatory_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this certification is mandated by a regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA, Health Canada, TGA) as a prerequisite for performing specific clinical research activities. True = regulatory mandate; False = professional credential without direct regulatory mandate.']
  issue_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the certifying body officially awarded the certification to the workforce member. Establishes the start of the certification\'s validity period and is required for regulatory audit trails and delegation log verification.']
  issuing_body varchar [note: 'Name of the external organization that awarded and administers the certification (e.g., ACRP - Association of Clinical Research Professionals, SOCRA - Society of Clinical Research Associates, RAPS - Regulatory Affairs Professionals Society, SAS Institute, SCDM - Society for Clinical Data Management). Critical for verification and regulatory compliance.']
  issuing_body_country varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the certifying body is headquartered or where the certification was issued. Relevant for multi-jurisdictional regulatory compliance (FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA, Health Canada).']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional context, conditions, or remarks about the certification record (e.g., \'Renewal pending sponsor approval\', \'Exam waived per equivalency policy\', \'Certificate copy on file in Veeva Vault\'). Not used for structured data.']
  passing_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Minimum passing score required by the issuing body to achieve the certification. Used to contextualize the exam_score and confirm the workforce member met the threshold. Null if no examination is required.']
  reimbursement_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Actual monetary amount reimbursed to the workforce member for this certification, in the currency specified by cost_currency. May differ from cost_amount if partial reimbursement applies per company policy.']
  reimbursement_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the organization reimburses the workforce member for the cost of obtaining or renewing this certification under the company\'s professional development or tuition reimbursement policy. True = eligible for reimbursement; False = not eligible.']
  renewal_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the certification was most recently renewed by the issuing body. Distinct from issue_date (original award) and expiry_date (end of validity). Tracks the renewal lifecycle for credentials that require periodic recertification.']
  renewal_reminder_days varchar [note: 'Number of calendar days before the expiry_date at which automated renewal reminder notifications should be triggered for the workforce member and their manager. Configurable per certification type to align with issuing body renewal windows (e.g., 90 days for ACRP CCRC).']
  renewal_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the certification renewal process. \'not_due\' = renewal period has not yet opened; \'in_progress\' = renewal application being prepared; \'submitted\' = renewal application submitted to issuing body; \'renewed\' = renewal confirmed by issuing body; \'lapsed\' = certification expired without renewal.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Operational system of record from which this certification record was sourced or ingested into the lakehouse (e.g., Workday HCM worker certification object, MasterControl training/credential module, or manually entered). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.']
  source_system_record_code varchar [note: 'Native record identifier from the originating operational system (Workday HCM certification object ID or MasterControl record ID). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the system of record for reconciliation and audit.']
  specialty_area varchar [note: 'Clinical research functional specialty area covered by the certification (e.g., oncology, pharmacovigilance, biostatistics, data management, regulatory affairs, GCP monitoring, pharmacokinetics). Used for resource allocation matching and capability gap analysis.']
  sponsor_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this certification is specifically required by a pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor as a contractual condition for assigning the workforce member to their study. True = sponsor-mandated credential; False = not sponsor-mandated.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this certification record, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Required for change tracking, audit trail compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.']
  verification_date date [note: 'Date on which the organization last verified the certification\'s validity with the issuing body. Used to determine when re-verification is due and to support regulatory inspection readiness.']
  verification_status varchar [note: 'Status of the organization\'s independent verification of the certification with the issuing body. \'unverified\' = not yet checked; \'verified\' = confirmed valid with issuing body; \'failed_verification\' = issuing body could not confirm; \'pending_verification\' = verification request submitted, awaiting response. Required for GCP compliance and delegation log integrity.']
  verified_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the internal staff member (e.g., HR specialist, QA officer) who performed the verification of this certification with the issuing body. Supports audit trail requirements under GCP and ALCOA+ principles.']

  Note: 'Master record for professional certifications and credentials held by clinical research workforce members. Captures certification type (ACRP CCRC, ACRP CCRA, SOCRA CCRP, RAC, SAS Certified, etc.), issuing body, certification number, issue date, expiry date, renewal status, and continuing education credits earned. Distinct from GCP training records — these are externally awarded professional credentials with their own renewal lifecycle.'
}

  gcp_certified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the workforce member holds a valid GCP certification at the time of assignment. Mandatory compliance check per ICH E6(R2) before assignment activation. True = certified; False = not certified or expired.']

  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or contextual information related to the assignment. Not used for regulatory documentation; supplementary operational context only.']
  on_hold_date date [note: 'The date on which the assignment was placed on hold. Populated only when assignment_status = \'on-hold\'. Used for capacity planning and timeline impact analysis.']
  on_hold_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text description of the reason the assignment was placed on hold. Populated only when assignment_status = \'on-hold\'. Supports operational decision-making and audit trail.']
  phase varchar [note: 'The clinical development phase of the study to which the workforce member is assigned. Used for workforce competency matching and regulatory oversight level determination.']
  planned_fte_allocation_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'The originally planned FTE allocation percentage at the time of assignment creation, before any revisions. Enables variance analysis between planned and actual resource utilization.']
  protocol_version varchar [note: 'The version of the study protocol in effect at the time of assignment. Ensures the workforce member is trained on the correct protocol version and supports audit trail requirements.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Identifies the operational system of record from which this assignment record originated. CTMS = Oracle Siebel CTMS; Workday = Workday HCM project assignment; Manual = entered directly into the lakehouse. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.']
  start_date date [note: 'The date on which the workforce member formally begins their assignment to the study. Used as the effective-from date for FTE allocation and capacity planning calculations.']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'The therapeutic area of the assigned study (e.g., Oncology, Cardiology, Neurology). Captured at assignment level to support workforce competency matching and therapeutic area capacity reporting.']
  training_completion_date date [note: 'The date on which the workforce member completed all mandatory study-specific training requirements (protocol, ICF, EDC system) prior to or at assignment activation. Regulatory compliance prerequisite.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this study assignment record was last modified. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. Used for incremental data pipeline processing.']
  workday_assignment_code varchar [note: 'The native project assignment identifier from Workday HCM. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the Workday HCM source system for payroll and project accounting alignment.']

  Note: 'Transactional record capturing the formal assignment of a workforce member to a clinical study in a defined role, with FTE allocation percentage. Sourced from CTMS and Workday HCM project assignments. Captures employee, study reference, assigned role (CRA, CRC, Data Manager, Biostatistician, Medical Monitor, Regulatory Lead, Project Manager), assignment start and end dates, FTE allocation percentage, assignment status (active, on-hold, completed), and authorizing manager. This is the SSOT for study-level resource allocation and the primary input for capacity utilization calculations.'
}

  superseded_log_workforce_delegation_log_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the prior delegation log record that this entry supersedes or amends. Enables version chain traceability for regulatory inspection. Null for original entries.']
  tertiary_workforce_qa_reviewer_employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the QA staff member who reviewed and approved or rejected this delegation log entry. Null if QA review has not yet been performed or is not required.']
  tmf_artifact_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the corresponding document artifact stored in the Trial Master File (TMF) or electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) system (Veeva Vault). Links the transactional record to the regulatory document repository.']
  amendment_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text explanation for why this delegation log entry was created as an amendment to a prior version (e.g., staff role change, task scope expansion, personnel departure). Null for initial log entries.']
  comments varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional notes or clarifications related to this delegation log entry, such as special conditions, limitations on the delegation, or context for an amendment.']
  ctms_delegation_ref varchar [note: 'The external reference identifier for this delegation log entry as recorded in the source Clinical Trial Management System (Oracle Siebel CTMS). Used for cross-system reconciliation.']
  delegated_task_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code identifying the specific trial-related task or responsibility being delegated (e.g., IC_PROCESS, AE_ASSESSMENT, SDV_CONDUCT, DRUG_DISPENSING, SAMPLE_COLLECTION). Drawn from the site\'s task code reference list. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IC_PROCESS|AE_ASSESSMENT|SDV_CONDUCT|DRUG_DISPENSING|SAMPLE_COLLECTION|ECRF_ENTRY|ELIGIBILITY_REVIEW|RANDOMIZATION|PROTOCOL_DEVIATION_REVIEW|MEDICAL_HISTORY — promote to reference product]']
  delegated_task_description varchar [note: 'Free-text description of the specific trial-related duty or responsibility being delegated to the delegatee. Provides the full narrative of the scope of delegation as it appears on the formal delegation log document.']
  delegatee_name varchar [note: 'The full name of the delegatee as it appears on the signed delegation log document. Captured as a point-in-time regulatory artifact field required for GCP compliance and inspection readiness.']
  delegatee_qualification_confirmed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the PI has confirmed that the delegatee possesses the necessary training, qualifications, and experience to perform the delegated task per ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1.5.']
  delegatee_role_title varchar [note: 'The formal job title or role of the delegatee at the time of delegation (e.g., Sub-Investigator, Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC), Study Nurse, Pharmacist). Captured as a point-in-time record on the delegation log.']
  delegatee_signature_captured boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the delegatee\'s electronic or wet-ink signature has been captured and stored in the system for this delegation log entry. True = signature on file; False = pending.']
  delegatee_signature_date date [note: 'The date on which the delegatee signed the delegation log entry, acknowledging acceptance of the delegated responsibility. Required to confirm informed acceptance per GCP.']
  delegation_end_date date [note: 'The date on which the delegated task or responsibility ceases to be effective. Null indicates the delegation remains open-ended until formally withdrawn or the study closes.']
  delegation_log_number varchar [note: 'The externally-visible, human-readable identifier for the delegation log document as it appears in the TMF and on the physical or electronic document (e.g., DL-STUDY001-SITE042-001). Used for regulatory inspection and audit trail.']
  delegation_scope varchar [note: 'Categorizes the breadth of the delegation: \'full\' covers all aspects of the task, \'partial\' covers defined sub-tasks only, \'temporary\' is time-limited cover (e.g., PI absence), \'emergency\' is an unplanned urgent delegation.']

  gcp_guideline_version varchar [note: 'The version of the ICH GCP guideline under which this delegation log was prepared (e.g., ICH E6(R1), ICH E6(R2), ICH E6(R3)). Relevant for regulatory inspection and compliance assessment.']
  gcp_training_verified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the delegatee\'s current Good Clinical Practice (GCP) training certification has been verified and is on file at the time of delegation. Required per ICH E6(R2) and FDA regulations.']
  inspection_ready boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this delegation log entry has been reviewed and confirmed as inspection-ready for regulatory authority review (e.g., FDA, EMA inspection). Managed as part of TMF completeness and quality review.']
  irb_iec_approval_confirmed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the relevant IRB or IEC approval was in place at the time this delegation was executed. Ensures the delegation is made within an ethically approved study context.']
  log_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the delegation log record. \'Active\' indicates the delegation is currently in force; \'superseded\' indicates a newer version exists; \'withdrawn\' indicates the delegation was revoked.']
  log_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the delegation log document (e.g., v1.0, v2.0). Incremented each time the log is formally amended and re-signed. Required for TMF version control.']
  pi_name varchar [note: 'The full name of the Principal Investigator (PI) as it appears on the signed delegation log document. Captured as a point-in-time regulatory artifact field; the PI\'s name must appear on the document per GCP.']
  pi_signature_captured boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the PI\'s electronic or wet-ink signature has been captured and stored in the system for this delegation log entry. True = signature on file; False = pending.']
  pi_signature_date date [note: 'The date on which the Principal Investigator (PI) signed the delegation log entry, formally authorizing the delegation. This is a GCP-mandated regulatory artifact date per ICH E6(R2).']
  protocol_training_verified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the delegatee has completed and documented protocol-specific training for the study prior to performing the delegated task.']
  qa_review_date date [note: 'The date on which the QA reviewer completed their review of this delegation log entry. Null if review is pending or not required.']
  qa_review_status varchar [note: 'The current Quality Assurance (QA) review status of this delegation log entry. Tracks whether the QA team has reviewed and approved the delegation for TMF completeness and GCP compliance.']
  record_created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this delegation log record was first created in the system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements for contemporaneous data capture.']
  record_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this delegation log record was last modified in the system. Required for audit trail integrity and ALCOA+ compliance.']
  regulatory_authority varchar [note: 'The primary regulatory authority under whose jurisdiction this delegation log is filed (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA). Determines applicable GCP guidelines and inspection standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|MHRA|PMDA|TGA|Health Canada|Other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  site_number varchar [note: 'The sponsor- or CRO-assigned site number as it appears on the delegation log document. Provides a direct, point-in-time site identifier on the regulatory artifact independent of system FK resolution.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The operational system of record from which this delegation log record was sourced or ingested into the Silver Layer lakehouse (e.g., Oracle Siebel CTMS, Veeva Vault, MasterControl).']
  sponsor_protocol_number varchar [note: 'The sponsor-assigned protocol number associated with the study for which this delegation applies. Captured directly on the delegation log document as a regulatory identifier.']
  workday_worker_code varchar [note: 'The Workday HCM system worker identifier for the delegatee employee. Used to cross-reference HR records, training completions, and employment status at the time of delegation.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of the formal delegation of trial-related duties from the Principal Investigator (PI) to site staff and CRO personnel, as required by ICH E6(R2) Section 8.3.25. Captures delegating PI, delegatee employee, study, site, delegated task or responsibility, delegation start date, end date, PI signature date, and delegation log version. Regulatory artifact required in the Trial Master File (TMF). Distinct from study_assignment — this is a GCP-mandated legal document, not an operational resource record.'
}

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|approved|revised|superseded|closed — promote to reference product if additional states are needed]']

  curriculum_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the training curriculum (e.g., \'GCP Onboarding Curriculum for Clinical Research Associates\'). Used in training assignment reports and compliance dashboards.']
  curriculum_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the curriculum in MasterControl. Draft indicates the curriculum is being authored; active means it is currently assigned and enforced; retired means it is no longer in use; superseded means a newer version has replaced it; under_review means it is undergoing periodic review.']
  curriculum_type varchar [note: 'Categorical classification of the curriculum by its primary purpose. Onboarding curricula apply to new hires; role_based to specific job profiles; protocol_specific to study-assigned staff; system_specific to EDC/CTMS/eTMF users; regulatory to GCP/ICH/FDA compliance; refresher to periodic re-certification.']
  delivery_method varchar [note: 'The primary method by which this curriculum is delivered to employees. elearning: self-paced online modules; instructor_led: classroom or virtual instructor-led training; blended: combination of elearning and instructor-led; read_acknowledge: document read and electronic signature; on_the_job: supervised practical training.']
  effective_date date [note: 'The date from which this curriculum version becomes binding and must be completed by assigned personnel. Used to trigger training assignment notifications and compliance deadline calculations.']
  estimated_duration_hours decimal(6,2) [note: 'The estimated total time in hours required to complete all courses in the curriculum. Used for workforce capacity planning, onboarding scheduling, and resource allocation in Workday HCM.']
  gcp_training_included boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this curriculum includes at least one Good Clinical Practice (GCP) training course as required by ICH E6(R2). Critical flag for regulatory inspection readiness and delegation log verification.']
  geographic_scope varchar [note: 'The geographic region or country scope for which this curriculum is applicable (e.g., USA, EU, JPN, GLOBAL). Relevant for region-specific regulatory requirements such as FDA 21 CFR Part 312 (USA), EU CTR 536/2014 (EU), or PMDA guidelines (Japan). Multiple regions may be pipe-delimited.']
  inspection_ready boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this curriculum and its associated documentation are in a state ready for regulatory inspection (FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, Health Canada, TGA). True means all required approvals, version controls, and audit trails are complete.']
  language_code varchar [note: 'ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) for the primary language in which this curriculum is authored (e.g., en, en-US, fr, ja, de). Supports multi-regional deployment and regulatory submissions to PMDA, EMA, Health Canada, TGA.']
  last_review_date date [note: 'The date on which this curriculum was last reviewed for content accuracy and regulatory currency. Supports periodic review scheduling and GCP compliance verification.']
  mandatory_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether completion of this curriculum is mandatory for the assigned job profile or role. Mandatory curricula trigger compliance alerts and may block system access (e.g., EDC, CTMS) if not completed within the required window.']
  mastercontrol_curriculum_code varchar [note: 'The native document or curriculum identifier assigned by MasterControl (source system of record). Used for cross-system reconciliation between the Silver Layer lakehouse and MasterControl.']
  max_attempts_allowed varchar [note: 'The maximum number of times an employee may attempt the curriculum assessment before escalation or remediation is required. Null if unlimited attempts are permitted.']
  next_review_date date [note: 'The date by which the next periodic review of this curriculum must be completed. Calculated from last_review_date plus the review cycle interval. Drives review task creation in MasterControl.']
  passing_score_percent decimal(5,2) [note: 'The minimum percentage score required to pass assessments within this curriculum. Typically 80% for GCP-related curricula per industry standard. Null if the curriculum has no scored assessments (e.g., read-and-acknowledge only).']
  protocol_training_included boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this curriculum includes protocol-specific training courses. When true, the curriculum is typically linked to a specific study protocol and must be completed before site staff can perform protocol-defined activities.']
  recertification_period_months varchar [note: 'The interval in months after which employees must re-complete the curriculum to maintain certification (e.g., 24 months for GCP refresher). Null if the curriculum is a one-time completion requirement with no recertification cycle.']
  record_created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this training curriculum record was first created in the source system (MasterControl). Supports ALCOA+ data integrity principles (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) and 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements.']
  record_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this training curriculum record was last modified in the source system (MasterControl). Supports ALCOA+ data integrity principles and 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements for electronic records.']
  regulatory_basis varchar [note: 'The primary regulatory framework or guideline mandating this curriculum (e.g., ICH E6(R2) GCP, 21 CFR Part 312, EU CTR 536/2014, ISO 14155, GDPR). Multiple references may be pipe-delimited. Supports regulatory inspection readiness and audit documentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ICH E6(R2)|21 CFR Part 312|EU CTR 536/2014|ISO 14155|GDPR|HIPAA|21 CFR Part 11|ICH E8 — promote to reference product]']
  retirement_date date [note: 'The date on which this curriculum version was retired or superseded. Null if the curriculum is currently active. Supports lifecycle management and historical compliance reporting.']
  sop_training_included boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this curriculum includes Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) training courses. SOP training is a GCP requirement for all clinical research personnel performing regulated activities.']
  sponsor_specific boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this curriculum was developed to meet a specific sponsor\'s training requirements. Sponsor-specific curricula may include sponsor SOPs, sponsor EDC system training, or sponsor-mandated GCP guidelines.']
  system_training_included boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this curriculum includes training on operational systems such as EDC (Medidata Rave), CTMS (Oracle Siebel), eTMF (Veeva Vault), or IRT/RTSM. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 system access authorization.']
  target_department varchar [note: 'Organizational department or functional group for which this curriculum is designed (e.g., Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Data Management, Regulatory Affairs). Enables department-level compliance reporting.']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'The therapeutic area or disease indication for which this curriculum is designed (e.g., Oncology, Cardiology, Neurology, Infectious Disease). Null for general curricula applicable across all therapeutic areas. Supports targeted training assignment for specialized studies.']
  total_course_count varchar [note: 'The total number of individual training courses included in this curriculum. Provides a quick reference for workload estimation during onboarding planning and capacity management.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the curriculum following semantic versioning convention (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0.1). Incremented upon each approved revision. Critical for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance and audit trail integrity.']
  workday_learning_program_code varchar [note: 'The corresponding learning program identifier in Workday HCM Learning module, if the curriculum is also managed or tracked in Workday. Enables bidirectional reconciliation between MasterControl and Workday HCM for completion records.']

  Note: 'Master record defining structured training curricula assigned to job profiles or roles within the clinical research organization. Captures curriculum name, target job profile or role, list of required training courses (GCP, SOP, protocol-specific, system-specific), required completion timeline, regulatory basis (ICH E6, 21 CFR Part 312, EU CTR), curriculum version, and effective date. Managed in MasterControl. Enables systematic onboarding and ongoing compliance training management.'
}

Table workforce.payroll_record {
  payroll_record_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each payroll processing record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the payroll_record data product.']
  cost_center_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the financial cost center to which this payroll expense is allocated. Supports workforce cost allocation to clinical studies and SOX financial reporting controls.']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the employee record for whom this payroll disbursement was processed. Links to the workforce employee master in Workday HCM.']
  gl_account_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Payroll records post to specific GL accounts as part of the payroll journal entry process. Linking payroll records to GL accounts supports payroll-to-GL reconciliation, a named month-end close process']
  reversed_record_payroll_record_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the original payroll_record_id that this record reverses or corrects. Null if this is not a reversal record. Maintains the audit chain for payroll corrections per SOX requirements.']
  study_budget_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.study_budget. Business justification: Payroll records carry \'study_allocation_code\' indicating which study budget absorbs the labor cost. Formalizing this as a FK to study_budget supports study-level labor cost actuals reporting and budge']
  allowance_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'Total allowances paid to the employee in this pay period, including travel allowances, per diem, housing allowances, and other non-salary compensation components common in clinical research field roles.']
  bank_account_last4 varchar [note: 'Last four digits of the employee\'s bank account number to which direct deposit was made. Stored as a masked reference for audit and reconciliation purposes only; full account number is not retained.']
  base_salary_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'The fixed base salary component of gross pay for this pay period, prorated to the pay frequency. Excludes variable pay components such as overtime, bonuses, and allowances.']
  benefits_deduction decimal(18,4) [note: 'Total employee-paid benefits deductions withheld from gross pay, including health insurance premiums, dental, vision, and other voluntary benefit elections.']
  bonus_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'Discretionary or performance-based bonus pay included in this payroll record. May include study milestone bonuses, retention bonuses, or annual performance awards.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts in this payroll record are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).']
  department varchar [note: 'The organizational department to which the employee was assigned during this pay period (e.g., Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs). Supports workforce cost allocation reporting.']
  employee_full_name varchar [note: 'Full legal name of the employee as recorded in Workday HCM at the time of payroll processing. Retained as a point-in-time snapshot for audit and regulatory purposes.']
  employer_benefits_contribution decimal(18,4) [note: 'Employer-paid portion of employee benefits costs (health insurance, dental, vision, life insurance) for this pay period. Included in total workforce cost allocation to clinical studies.']
  employer_retirement_contribution decimal(18,4) [note: 'Employer matching or defined contribution to the employee\'s retirement plan for this pay period (e.g., 401(k) match, pension contribution). Part of total compensation cost for study budget allocation.']
  employer_tax_contribution decimal(18,4) [note: 'Employer-side payroll tax contributions (e.g., employer FICA/Social Security, Medicare, unemployment insurance) associated with this payroll record. Required for total labor cost allocation to clinical studies.']
  employment_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the employee\'s employment arrangement during this pay period. Determines applicable payroll rules, benefit eligibility, and tax treatment.']
  gross_pay decimal(18,4) [note: 'Total gross compensation earned by the employee for the pay period before any deductions. Equals the sum of all pay components (base salary, overtime, bonus, allowances). Key figure for SOX financial reporting and workforce cost allocation.']
  hours_worked decimal(10,2) [note: 'Total regular hours worked by the employee during the pay period as recorded in Workday HCM time tracking. Used for hourly pay calculations and study resource utilization reporting.']
  is_reversal boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this payroll record represents a reversal of a previously processed payroll entry. True if this record corrects or voids a prior disbursement. Critical for SOX audit trail integrity.']
  job_title varchar [note: 'The employee\'s job title at the time of payroll processing (e.g., Clinical Research Associate, Biostatistician, Data Manager). Captured as a point-in-time snapshot for workforce cost analytics.']
  net_pay decimal(18,4) [note: 'The actual amount disbursed to the employee after all deductions (taxes, benefits, retirement contributions) have been subtracted from gross pay. Represents the take-home pay amount.']
  overtime_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'Total overtime pay earned by the employee during this pay period, calculated per applicable labor law (e.g., FLSA 1.5x rate). Relevant for CRAs and site staff with variable field hours.']
  overtime_hours decimal(10,2) [note: 'Total overtime hours worked by the employee during the pay period beyond the standard threshold (e.g., >40 hours/week under FLSA). Drives overtime_amount calculation.']
  pay_frequency varchar [note: 'The frequency at which the employee is paid within this pay group (e.g., biweekly, monthly). Determines the number of pay periods per year for annualization calculations.']
  pay_group varchar [note: 'The Workday HCM pay group to which the employee belongs, determining pay frequency and processing rules (e.g., US-Biweekly, EU-Monthly, APAC-Monthly). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: US-Biweekly|US-Semimonthly|EU-Monthly|APAC-Monthly|CA-Biweekly|UK-Monthly — promote to reference product]']
  pay_period_end_date date [note: 'The last calendar date of the pay period covered by this payroll record. Defines the end of the compensation earning window.']
  pay_period_start_date date [note: 'The first calendar date of the pay period covered by this payroll record. Defines the beginning of the compensation earning window.']
  payment_date date [note: 'The actual date on which the net pay was disbursed to the employee. Used for cash flow reporting and SOX financial controls.']
  payment_method varchar [note: 'The method by which net pay was disbursed to the employee (e.g., direct deposit, check, wire transfer). Sourced from Workday HCM payment election settings.']
  payroll_run_reference varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the payroll run batch in which this record was processed, as assigned by Workday HCM. Enables traceability of all records processed in a single payroll run cycle.']
  payroll_run_type varchar [note: 'Classifies the nature of the payroll run: regular scheduled run, off-cycle correction, supplemental bonus run, or final paycheck upon termination.']
  record_created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this payroll record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and SOX financial reporting controls.']
  record_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this payroll record was last modified in the Databricks Silver Layer. Tracks data refresh cycles and supports SOX audit trail requirements.']
  retirement_deduction decimal(18,4) [note: 'Employee pre-tax or post-tax retirement contribution deducted from gross pay (e.g., 401(k), pension, RRSP). Supports benefits compliance and workforce total compensation reporting.']
  run_status varchar [note: 'Current processing lifecycle status of this payroll record within the Workday HCM payroll run workflow. Supports SOX audit trail requirements.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The operational system of record from which this payroll record was sourced. For this data product, the authoritative source is Workday HCM Payroll module.']
  study_allocation_code varchar [note: 'The clinical study or project code to which this payroll expense is allocated for workforce cost tracking. Enables direct linkage of labor costs to specific clinical trials for sponsor billing and budget management.']
  tax_jurisdiction_code varchar [note: 'The primary tax jurisdiction code applicable to this payroll record (e.g., US-CA for California, UK for United Kingdom). Determines which tax tables and rates are applied during payroll calculation.']
  tax_withholding_status varchar [note: 'The employee\'s federal/national tax filing status as declared on their withholding form (e.g., W-4 in the US), which determines the applicable tax withholding rate for this pay period.']
  total_tax_deduction decimal(18,4) [note: 'Aggregate amount withheld from gross pay for all applicable taxes (federal, state/provincial, local income tax, social security, Medicare/national insurance) during this pay period.']
  work_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the employee performed work during this pay period. Determines applicable tax jurisdiction, labor law, and regulatory compliance requirements.']
  workday_worker_code varchar [note: 'The native worker identifier assigned by Workday HCM for the employee. Used for system-of-record traceability back to the Workday Payroll module.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of payroll processing events for each employee, sourced from Workday HCM Payroll module. Captures pay period start and end dates, gross pay, net pay, pay components (base salary, overtime, bonus, allowances), deductions (tax, benefits, retirement), pay group, payment method, payment date, and payroll run reference. This is the SSOT for compensation disbursement history. Supports SOX financial reporting controls and workforce cost allocation to clinical studies.'
}

The \'gl_account_code\' plain string on org_unit is a denormalized reference that this FK normalizes, supporting org-unit']

  is_gcp_regulated boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this organizational unit performs GCP-regulated activities requiring mandatory GCP training, delegation log maintenance, and regulatory inspection readiness per ICH E6(R2) and FDA 21 CFR Part 312.']
  phone_number varchar [note: 'Primary contact phone number for the organizational unit. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.']
  physical_location varchar [note: 'Physical office location or facility name where this organizational unit is primarily based (e.g., \'Boston HQ – Floor 4\', \'London Office\'). Used for site management, facilities planning, and regulatory inspection logistics.']
  record_created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this organizational unit record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and ALCOA+ compliance requirements for clinical data management.']
  record_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this organizational unit record was most recently updated in the data platform. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and ALCOA+ compliance for regulated clinical research environments.']
  sop_owner varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the designated Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) owner for this organizational unit, responsible for maintaining and approving SOPs applicable to the unit\'s activities in MasterControl.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Operational system of record from which this organizational unit record was sourced. Workday HCM is the primary source; other systems may contribute supplementary attributes.']
  therapeutic_area_focus varchar [note: 'Primary therapeutic area specialization of the organizational unit (e.g., Oncology, Neurology, Cardiovascular, Infectious Disease). Supports study-to-resource matching and capacity planning for sponsor engagements.']
  time_zone varchar [note: 'IANA time zone identifier for the organizational unit\'s primary operating location (e.g., \'America/New_York\', \'Europe/London\'). Used for scheduling, meeting coordination, and timestamp normalization in multi-regional studies.']

  unit_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the organizational unit within the CRO hierarchy. Determines reporting rollup behavior and cost allocation rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: department|division|cost_center|team|function|business_unit — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]']

  Note: 'Reference master for the organizational hierarchy of the clinical research organization, sourced from Workday HCM.   budgeted_fte decimal(5,2) [note: 'Approved full-time equivalent headcount units budgeted for this position (e.g., 1.00 for full-time, 0.50 for half-time). Sourced from the annual headcount plan in Workday HCM and reconciled against SAP S/4HANA project accounting budgets.']
  clinical_role_category varchar [note: 'Functional classification of the position within the clinical research organization\'s role taxonomy. Determines GCP training requirements, delegation eligibility, and system access provisioning in Medidata Rave, Veeva Vault, and Oracle Argus Safety. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CRA|CRC|Biostatistician|Data Manager|Medical Monitor|Regulatory Specialist|Project Manager|Other — promote to reference product]']
  country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the primary country of assignment for this position (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU, JPN). Determines applicable employment law, GCP guideline version, and data privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA).']
  effective_end_date date [note: 'Date on which this position ceases to be active in the headcount plan. Null for open-ended permanent positions. Set when a position is eliminated, restructured, or converted to a different position type.']

  filled_date date [note: 'Actual date on which the position was filled by an incumbent employee. Populated when incumbency_status transitions to Filled. Used to calculate time-to-fill KPIs and assess recruiting efficiency.']
  freeze_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text explanation for why a position has been frozen (incumbency_status = Frozen). Common reasons include budget hold, organizational restructuring, study portfolio reduction, or sponsor funding delay. Null when position is not frozen.']
  geographic_region varchar [note: 'Operational geographic region to which this position is assigned. Drives regional headcount planning, site monitoring coverage analysis, and regulatory jurisdiction alignment (FDA, EMA, PMDA, TGA, Health Canada).']
  headcount_plan_year varchar [note: 'Fiscal year in which this position was approved in the annual headcount plan (e.g., 2024, 2025). Used to align position records with annual budget cycles in SAP S/4HANA and Workday HCM workforce planning.']
  incumbency_status varchar [note: 'Current occupancy state of the position within the approved headcount plan. Filled = active employee assigned; Vacant = approved but unoccupied; Frozen = headcount approved but hiring suspended; Pending-Approval = awaiting budget authorization; Eliminated = position removed from headcount plan. Critical for workforce planning KPI reporting.']
  is_delegation_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the position is eligible to appear on a site delegation log as a delegatee for PI-authorized tasks. Determined by job profile, GCP certification status, and protocol training requirements per ICH E6(R2) and FDA guidance.']
  is_gcp_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the incumbent of this position is required to hold a current GCP certification as a condition of role eligibility. True for all positions with direct study involvement (CRA, CRC, Medical Monitor, PI oversight). Drives mandatory training assignment in MasterControl.']
  is_pi_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the position is designated as eligible to serve as a Principal Investigator (PI) on a clinical study. PI-eligible positions require medical licensure verification and are subject to enhanced regulatory scrutiny by FDA, EMA, and IRB/IEC.']
  is_safety_reporting_role boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the position carries regulatory responsibility for adverse event (AE) and serious adverse event (SAE) reporting obligations. Positions flagged True require Oracle Argus Safety system access and SAE/SUSAR reporting training per ICH E2A and FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32.']
  job_family varchar [note: 'Broad functional grouping of the position within the clinical research organization\'s job architecture (e.g., Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Data Management, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Affairs, Finance). Enables cross-domain workforce planning and headcount analytics.']
  job_level varchar [note: 'Career level designation for the position within the job family hierarchy. Governs pay grade eligibility, delegation authority, and GCP oversight responsibilities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Entry|Associate|Mid|Senior|Principal|Director|Executive — promote to reference product if levels expand beyond 6]']
  pay_grade varchar [note: 'Compensation grade band assigned to this position in Workday HCM (e.g., G5, G6, M1). Governs salary range eligibility and is used in budget forecasting and compensation benchmarking. Classified as confidential business data.']

  non_compliance_category varchar [note: 'High-level category of the non-compliance or performance issue that triggered the CAPA. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gcp_violation|training_non_compliance|protocol_deviation|sop_violation|data_integrity|safety_reporting|delegation_breach|performance_issue — promote to reference product]']

  preventive_action_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the specific preventive actions planned or taken to proactively mitigate the risk of future non-compliance. Populated for preventive and combined CAPA types.']
  priority varchar [note: 'Business priority assigned to the CAPA to guide resource allocation and escalation. Derived from severity and potential patient safety or regulatory impact, but may be independently set by the CAPA owner.']

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lack_of_training|process_gap|communication_failure|resource_constraint|system_error|human_error|oversight_failure|other — promote to reference product]']
  root_cause_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative of the identified root cause of the non-compliance or performance issue, as documented by the CAPA owner following investigation. Required for regulatory inspection readiness.']
  severity varchar [note: 'Severity classification of the non-compliance event driving the CAPA. Critical and major findings typically require expedited closure timelines and may trigger regulatory notification obligations.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Identifies the operational system of record from which this CAPA record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  workday_worker_code varchar [note: 'The Workday HCM worker identifier for the employee who is the subject of the CAPA. Enables HR system cross-referencing for performance management and workforce analytics.']

  Note: 'Transactional record for Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs) initiated against workforce members for GCP compliance failures, training non-compliance, or performance issues identified during audits or inspections. Managed through MasterControl. Captures CAPA type (corrective, preventive), root cause category, description of non-compliance, assigned employee, CAPA owner, due date, completion date, effectiveness check date, and closure status. Distinct from monitoring.capa_record (site-level CAPAs) — this is workforce-specific HR and compliance CAPA.'
}

Table workforce.program_team_member {
  program_team_member_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the program_team_member association']
  clinical_program_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the clinical development program to which the employee is assigned']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the workforce member assigned to the clinical program team']
  assignment_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of this employee\'s assignment to the clinical program. Controls access permissions, delegation authority activation, and workforce allocation reporting.']
  delegation_authority_level varchar [note: 'The regulatory delegation scope granted to this employee for this specific clinical program. Delegation authority is program-specific and role-specific — the same employee may have different delegation levels across different programs. Required for delegation log compliance under ICH E6(R2).']
  end_date date [note: 'The date on which the employee\'s assignment to this clinical program team concluded. Null if the assignment is currently active. Required for historical team composition queries and regulatory audit trails.']
  fte_allocation_percentage decimal [note: 'The proportion of the employee\'s full-time equivalent capacity dedicated to this specific clinical program assignment. Enables workforce capacity planning and cost allocation across the program portfolio. Belongs to the assignment, not to the employee or program alone.']
  gcp_certification_status varchar [note: 'The GCP certification validity status of the employee at the time of and during this program assignment. Captured per assignment because certification status may change during a long-running program and regulatory submissions require point-in-time certification evidence.']
  program_role varchar [note: 'The GCP-defined functional role of the employee within this specific clinical program assignment. Distinct from the employee\'s general gcp_role — an employee may serve in different roles across different programs.']
  start_date date [note: 'The date on which the employee\'s assignment to this clinical program team became effective. Used for delegation log compliance, regulatory inspection readiness, and workforce timeline reporting.']
  therapeutic_area_expertise varchar [note: 'The specific therapeutic area expertise the employee is applying in the context of this program assignment. May differ from the employee\'s general therapeutic_area_expertise when an employee is cross-assigned to a program outside their primary TA. Captured per assignment for qualification documentation.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the Role-based assignment between an employee and a clinical_program. It captures the operational team membership record that the CRO actively manages for each employee-program pairing, including the employee\'s functional GCP role on the program, FTE allocation, delegation authority, GCP certification status at assignment time, and the full lifecycle of the assignment. Each record links one employee to one clinical_program with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific assignment relationship. This is the SSOT for program team composition and workforce allocation across the clinical development portfolio.. Existence Justification: In clinical research operations, employees (CRAs, Medical Monitors, Data Managers, etc.) are actively assigned to multiple clinical programs simultaneously, and each clinical program has a team of many employees in distinct functional roles. This is a core operational reality in CROs — a Medical Monitor may oversee 3 oncology programs concurrently, while a single program may have 15+ staff across CRA, CRC, biostatistics, and regulatory functions. The business actively manages these assignments with role designations, FTE allocations, delegation authority levels, and GCP certification status per assignment — this is not derivable from transactional data but is an explicitly managed operational record.'
}

  source_system_record_reference varchar [note: 'Native record identifier of this milestone in the originating operational system (e.g., Siebel CTMS milestone ID). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the system of record.']
  subtype varchar [note: 'Further granular classification within the milestone type (e.g., within \'regulatory\': IND Filing, NDA Submission, BLA Submission, MAA Submission; within \'clinical_phase\': Phase I Start, Phase II Start, Phase III Start, Phase IV Start). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IND_filing|NDA_submission|BLA_submission|MAA_submission|phase_I_start|phase_II_start|phase_III_start|phase_IV_start|DSMB_review|DBL|go_no_go — promote to reference product]']
  tmf_zone varchar [note: 'The TMF zone or section in the eTMF (Electronic Trial Master File) where the milestone evidence document is filed, per the DIA TMF Reference Model (e.g., Zone 01 - Trial Management, Zone 04 - Regulatory).']

  variance_commentary varchar [note: 'Free-text explanation of the root cause and impact of any schedule variance between planned and actual/forecast dates. Required when schedule_variance_days exceeds threshold. Supports portfolio governance escalation and executive reporting.']

  Note: 'Tracks key program-level milestones and their planned versus actual achievement dates across the clinical development lifecycle. Table program.program_study {
  program_study_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the program-study association record within the clinical development program portfolio.']
  clinical_program_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the parent clinical development program to which this study belongs. Enables program-level portfolio aggregation and cross-study coordination.']
