  actual_completion_date date [note: 'Actual date on which the study was completed (last patient last visit or database lock) as recorded in the CTMS. Enables planned vs. actual timeline variance analysis and program-level close-out tracking.']
  actual_start_date date [note: 'Actual date on which the study commenced (first patient first visit or first site activation) as recorded in the CTMS. Enables planned vs. actual timeline variance analysis at the program level.']
  added_to_program_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the study was formally added to the clinical development program scope, as recorded in the CTMS or program governance system. Supports program timeline analysis and audit trail.']
  approved_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the governance body or individual (e.g., Chief Medical Officer, Portfolio Review Board) who approved the inclusion of this study in the program. Supports accountability and audit trail requirements.']
  association_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier code for this program-study linkage, used in CTMS, portfolio dashboards, and regulatory dossier cross-references (e.g., PRG-001-STU-003).']
  association_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the program-study association. Active indicates the study is currently contributing to the program; removed indicates the study has been formally withdrawn from the program scope; pending indicates the association is under governance review.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this program-study association record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) compliance requirements.']
  cross_study_dependency varchar [note: 'Free-text description of any formal dependencies between this study and other studies within the program (e.g., \'Requires completion of Study 001 dose-escalation before initiating\', \'Shares DSMB charter with Study 003\'). Supports program-level coordination and risk management.']
  csr_submission_date date [note: 'Date on which the Clinical Study Report (CSR) for this study was submitted to the regulatory authority or included in the program\'s regulatory dossier. Supports eTMF completeness tracking and regulatory submission planning.']
  ctd_module_reference varchar [note: 'Reference to the CTD/eCTD module and section where this study\'s data will be submitted in the regulatory dossier (e.g., M5.3.5.1 for controlled clinical studies). Supports regulatory submission planning and dossier assembly.']
  data_readout_date date [note: 'Date on which the study\'s primary analysis results (top-line data) were made available to the program team and sponsor. Critical for program-level go/no-go decision gates and portfolio governance reviews.']
  eudract_number varchar [note: 'European Union Drug Regulating Authorities Clinical Trials (EudraCT) registration number for this study within the program. Required for EU regulatory compliance under EU CTR 536/2014.']
  geographic_scope varchar [note: 'Description of the geographic regions or countries in which this study is conducted as part of the program (e.g., global, US-only, EU, Asia-Pacific). Supports multi-regional regulatory strategy and program-level site distribution analysis.']
  governance_approval_date date [note: 'Date on which the program governance committee (e.g., Portfolio Review Board, Development Committee) formally approved the inclusion of this study in the program. Supports audit trail and governance compliance.']
  ind_number varchar [note: 'FDA Investigational New Drug (IND) application number under which this study is conducted within the program. Required for US regulatory compliance and cross-study IND amendment tracking.']
  indication_meddra_code varchar [note: 'MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) code for the therapeutic indication addressed by this study within the program. Enables standardized cross-study indication mapping and regulatory reporting alignment.']
  integrated_analysis_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this study\'s data is included in a program-level integrated analysis (e.g., Integrated Summary of Safety (ISS) or Integrated Summary of Efficacy (ISE)) for the regulatory dossier. True = included in integrated analysis.']
  is_gcp_compliant boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this study is conducted in full compliance with ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines, as required for regulatory submission. True = GCP-compliant; False = non-GCP (e.g., non-clinical or exploratory research not intended for regulatory submission).']
  is_registrational boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this study is designated as a registrational study intended to support a marketing authorization application (NDA, BLA, MAA). True = registrational; False = non-registrational (e.g., exploratory, mechanistic).']
  nct_number varchar [note: 'ClinicalTrials.gov National Clinical Trial (NCT) registration number for this study. Required for WHO ICTRP compliance and public disclosure obligations under FDAAA 801 and ICMJE policies.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for capturing additional context, rationale, or operational notes about the program-study association that are not captured in structured fields (e.g., strategic rationale for study inclusion, regulatory agency feedback driving study design).']
  phase varchar [note: 'Clinical development phase of the study as it contributes to the program (Phase I through Phase III). Enables program-level phase distribution analysis and regulatory milestone planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Phase I|Phase I/II|Phase II|Phase IIa|Phase IIb|Phase III|Phase III/IV|Phase IV — promote to reference product]']
  planned_completion_date date [note: 'Planned last patient last visit (LPLV) or database lock date as scheduled within the program timeline. Supports program-level milestone planning and regulatory submission timeline forecasting.']
  planned_start_date date [note: 'Planned first patient first visit (FPFV) or study initiation date as scheduled within the program timeline. Used for program-level Gantt chart planning and milestone dependency tracking.']
  population_type varchar [note: 'Characterizes the patient population targeted by this study within the program (e.g., adult, pediatric, geriatric, special population). Supports program-level population coverage and pediatric investigation plan (PIP) compliance tracking.']
  portfolio_priority varchar [note: 'Strategic priority level assigned to this study within the program portfolio by the program governance committee. Critical = must-have for regulatory submission; High = important for program success; Medium = supportive; Low = optional/exploratory.']
  primary_endpoint_category varchar [note: 'High-level category of the study\'s primary endpoint as it relates to the program\'s evidence generation strategy. Supports program-level endpoint coverage analysis and regulatory dossier planning.']
  program_milestone_dependency varchar [note: 'Description of the program-level milestone or go/no-go decision gate that this study\'s results are expected to inform or unlock (e.g., \'Phase II readout gates Phase III initiation\', \'Bridging study required before NDA submission\'). Supports program governance and portfolio decision-making.']
  regulatory_dossier_contribution boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this study\'s data is intended to contribute to the regulatory submission dossier (NDA, BLA, MAA, or CTD/eCTD package) for the program\'s therapeutic indication. True = study data will be included in the regulatory filing.']
  removal_reason varchar [note: 'Reason code explaining why the study was removed from the program. Completed indicates normal study conclusion; terminated indicates early discontinuation; superseded indicates replacement by a redesigned study; out_of_scope indicates strategic portfolio realignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: completed|terminated|superseded|out_of_scope|strategic_decision|regulatory_feedback|other — promote to reference product]']
  removed_from_program_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the study was formally removed or withdrawn from the clinical development program scope. Null if the study remains active within the program.']
  sequence_number varchar [note: 'Ordinal sequence number indicating the position of this study within the clinical development program timeline. Used for program-level ordering, milestone dependency mapping, and regulatory dossier sequencing.']
  shared_dsmb_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this study shares a Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) with other studies in the program. True = shared DSMB/DMC; False = study-specific DSMB/DMC or no DSMB required.']
  shared_sap_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this study\'s Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) is shared or integrated with other studies in the program (e.g., integrated summary of safety/efficacy). True = shared SAP; False = study-specific SAP.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Identifies the operational system of record from which this program-study association record was sourced (e.g., Oracle Siebel CTMS, Oracle Clinical One, Veeva Vault). Supports data lineage and Silver layer provenance tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse.']
  sponsor_protocol_number varchar [note: 'Sponsor-assigned protocol number for this study as it appears in the program\'s regulatory filings and CTMS. Serves as the primary cross-system identifier linking the study to the program in sponsor systems.']
  study_role varchar [note: 'Designates the functional role of the study within the clinical development program. Pivotal studies are designed to provide primary evidence for regulatory approval; supportive studies provide corroborating evidence; exploratory studies generate hypotheses; bridging studies extend data to new populations; PK/PD studies characterize pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics.']
  therapeutic_indication varchar [note: 'The disease, condition, or therapeutic indication that this study addresses within the program. Aligns with the program\'s target indication and supports cross-study indication consistency tracking.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this program-study association record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and ALCOA+ compliance for regulatory inspection readiness.']

  Note: 'Association entity representing the formal relationship between a clinical development program and the individual clinical studies (protocols) that constitute it. Captures the program-study linkage, study role within the program (pivotal, supportive, exploratory, bridging, PK/PD), study sequence number within the program, contribution to regulatory dossier flag, and the date the study was added to or removed from the program. Enables cross-study coordination and program-level portfolio views.'

  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this governance meeting record was first created in the system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record compliance.']
  decision_count varchar [note: 'Total number of formal decisions recorded during the governance meeting. Used for governance KPI reporting and meeting productivity analytics.']
  end_time timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the governance meeting concluded. Used to calculate meeting duration and for minutes accuracy.']
  escalation_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the issue or decision requiring escalation to a higher governance body. Populated only when escalation_required is True.']
  escalation_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether any decision or issue arising from this meeting requires escalation to a higher governance body (e.g., Executive Steering Committee, Sponsor). True = escalation triggered; False = no escalation required.']
  key_decisions varchar [note: 'Narrative summary of the principal decisions made during the governance meeting (e.g., protocol amendment approval, site expansion authorization, budget reallocation). Extracted from approved minutes for analytics and reporting.']
  location varchar [note: 'Physical venue or virtual platform where the meeting was held (e.g., \'Conference Room A, Boston HQ\' or \'Microsoft Teams\'). Recorded in minutes for audit trail purposes.']
  meeting_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the governance meeting was held or is scheduled to be held. Principal real-world event date for this transaction.']
  meeting_format varchar [note: 'Modality of the meeting: in_person (all attendees physically co-located), virtual (all attendees remote via teleconference/videoconference), or hybrid (mix of in-person and remote attendees).']
  meeting_frequency varchar [note: 'Cadence at which this type of governance meeting is regularly convened as defined in the committee charter. Used for scheduling compliance monitoring. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: weekly|bi_weekly|monthly|quarterly|semi_annual|annual|as_needed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  meeting_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known sequential or structured identifier for the meeting (e.g., PRG-GOV-2024-007). Used as the business-facing reference in agendas, minutes, and action item logs.']
  meeting_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the governance meeting record. Drives workflow routing for agenda preparation, minutes approval, and action item follow-up.']
  meeting_title varchar [note: 'Descriptive title of the governance meeting as it appears on the agenda and minutes document (e.g., \'Q3 2024 Program Review Board Meeting – PROG-001\').']
  meeting_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the meeting by its scheduling basis: scheduled (routine calendar meeting), ad_hoc (convened outside the regular schedule), emergency (convened urgently for a safety or critical operational issue), or extraordinary (special purpose outside normal governance cadence).']
  minutes_approved_date date [note: 'Date on which the meeting minutes were formally approved by the committee chair or designated approver. Required for regulatory audit trail and eTMF completeness.']
  minutes_approver_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the individual who formally approved the meeting minutes. Supports ALCOA+ compliance (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) for regulatory audit readiness.']
  minutes_status varchar [note: 'Current approval lifecycle state of the meeting minutes document: draft (initial preparation), under_review (circulated for comment), approved (formally signed off by chair), final (distributed to all attendees), archived (filed in eTMF).']
  next_meeting_date date [note: 'Scheduled date of the next governance meeting as agreed at the close of this meeting. Supports forward planning and governance calendar management.']
  open_action_items_from_prior varchar [note: 'Number of action items from previous governance meetings that remained open and were reviewed at this meeting. Key governance health indicator.']
  quorum_achieved boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the required quorum of voting members was present at the meeting, making decisions and resolutions formally binding. True = quorum met; False = quorum not met.']
  quorum_required varchar [note: 'Minimum number of voting members required to be present for the meeting to be quorate and for decisions to be binding, as defined in the committee charter.']
  regulatory_implication_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether any decision or discussion item from this meeting has a direct regulatory implication (e.g., protocol amendment requiring IND/CTA update, safety signal requiring expedited reporting). True = regulatory action may be required.']
  safety_topic_discussed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether any safety-related topic (e.g., SAE review, SUSAR assessment, DSMB recommendation, risk-benefit evaluation) was discussed during the meeting. Supports safety governance audit trail.']
  session_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the meeting (or a portion thereof) was conducted as an open session (all attendees), closed session (voting members only, e.g., for unblinded safety review), or executive session (senior leadership only). Relevant for DSMB and DMC governance.']
  start_time timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the governance meeting commenced. Used for quorum determination and minutes accuracy.']
  tmf_zone varchar [note: 'Reference to the TMF zone and section under which the meeting minutes and agenda are filed in the eTMF (e.g., \'Zone 1 / Section 1.3 – Governance\'). Supports eTMF completeness and inspection readiness.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this governance meeting record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and silver layer incremental processing.']
  voting_member_count varchar [note: 'Number of voting committee members who were present at the meeting. Used to confirm quorum achievement and validate the binding nature of decisions made.']

  Note: 'Transactional record for each formal program governance meeting held by a program oversight committee. Captures meeting date, meeting type (scheduled, ad hoc, emergency), agenda topics, attendees, quorum achieved flag, key decisions made, action items raised, minutes document reference, and next meeting date. Distinct from sponsor.governance_meeting which tracks sponsor-CRO commercial governance; this entity tracks internal program scientific and operational governance.'
}

Table program.timeline {
  timeline_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the program-level integrated timeline record. Primary key for this entity.']
  clinical_program_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical development program this timeline governs. Links the timeline to its parent program entity.']
  organization_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor organization funding and overseeing the clinical development program. Links to the sponsor master record.']
  owner_employee_id varchar [note: 'FK to workforce.employee']
  superseded_timeline_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on timeline (superseded_timeline_id)']
  timeline_employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the individual (typically a Program Director or Program Manager) accountable for maintaining and updating the program timeline. Supports governance accountability and escalation routing.']
  approval_date date [note: 'The date on which this version of the program timeline was formally approved by the program governance committee or sponsor. Marks the transition from draft to baseline.']
  approved_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the governance authority (individual or committee) that formally approved this program timeline version, supporting audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness.']
  baseline_end_date date [note: 'The approved baseline end date for the clinical development program, representing the originally planned program completion date. Used as the denominator for schedule variance and milestone tracking.']
  baseline_start_date date [note: 'The approved baseline start date for the clinical development program, established at the time of initial timeline approval. Serves as the reference anchor for schedule variance calculations.']
  comments varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional context, notes, or clarifications regarding the program timeline status, assumptions, or constraints not captured in structured fields. Supports governance review documentation.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The system timestamp when this program timeline record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and ALCOA+ compliance requirements.']
  critical_path_driver varchar [note: 'The primary activity, milestone, or dependency currently driving the critical path (e.g., \'Last Patient Last Visit\', \'Regulatory Submission\', \'Database Lock\'). Used for targeted risk mitigation and escalation.']
  critical_path_summary varchar [note: 'Narrative or structured summary identifying the critical path activities and milestones that determine the program\'s minimum duration. Highlights the sequence of dependent tasks with zero float that drive the forecast end date.']
  csr_target_date date [note: 'The target date for completion of the Clinical Study Report (CSR) for the program\'s pivotal study or integrated summary. Required for regulatory submission planning per ICH E3 guidelines.']
  forecast_end_date date [note: 'The current forecast completion date for the program, updated based on rolling re-projections from study-level timelines, enrollment rates, and regulatory milestones. Key input to portfolio governance and submission planning.']
  forecast_start_date date [note: 'The current forecast start date for the program, reflecting the latest re-planning based on actual progress, site performance, and enrollment data. May differ from baseline if program initiation was delayed.']
  governance_review_frequency varchar [note: 'The cadence at which this program timeline is reviewed by the program governance committee or sponsor. Determines the expected update frequency for forecast dates and status fields.']
  indication varchar [note: 'The specific disease or condition being studied within the program (e.g., \'Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer\', \'Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus\'). Aligns with MedDRA coding and regulatory submission labeling.']
  is_current_version boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this record represents the currently active and operative program timeline version. Exactly one record per program should have this set to True at any point in time.']
  last_updated_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the program timeline record was most recently updated, reflecting the latest forecast refresh or status change. Used for data currency monitoring in portfolio dashboards.']
  milestone_count_at_risk varchar [note: 'Number of program-level milestones currently flagged as at-risk of missing their forecast date. Key input to program risk dashboards and DSMB/DMC reporting.']
  milestone_count_completed varchar [note: 'Number of program-level milestones that have been achieved as of the last timeline update. Used to calculate program completion percentage and track progress against the baseline.']
  milestone_count_total varchar [note: 'Total number of program-level milestones tracked within this timeline version. Provides a structural summary of timeline complexity for governance reporting.']
  next_governance_review_date date [note: 'The scheduled date of the next program governance committee review at which this timeline will be assessed and potentially updated. Drives workflow notifications and reporting preparation.']
  program_phase varchar [note: 'The clinical development phase(s) covered by this program timeline (e.g., Phase II/III). Determines regulatory requirements, timeline complexity, and governance oversight level.']
  regulatory_submission_target_date date [note: 'The target date for the primary regulatory submission (NDA/BLA/MAA) derived from this program timeline. Critical milestone for sponsor portfolio planning and regulatory agency interactions.']
  revision_reason varchar [note: 'Narrative explanation for why this timeline version was created or revised (e.g., \'Protocol amendment impact\', \'Enrollment rate below target\', \'Regulatory feedback on IND\'). Required for governance accountability.']
  risk_level varchar [note: 'Overall risk classification for the program timeline, reflecting the likelihood and impact of schedule delays based on current program status, enrollment performance, and regulatory interactions.']
  risk_summary varchar [note: 'Narrative summary of the primary schedule risks and mitigation strategies for the program timeline, as assessed at the last governance review. Supports DSMB/DMC reporting and sponsor escalation.']
  schedule_variance_days varchar [note: 'The numeric difference in calendar days between the current forecast end date and the approved baseline end date. Positive values indicate delay; negative values indicate ahead-of-schedule performance. Core KPI for program governance.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The operational system of record from which this program timeline record was sourced or integrated (e.g., Oracle Siebel CTMS). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver layer.']
  source_system_record_reference varchar [note: 'The native identifier of this timeline record in the originating operational system (e.g., Oracle Siebel CTMS internal ID). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse and source systems.']
  study_count varchar [note: 'Number of individual clinical studies (trials) included within this program timeline. Reflects the scope of the integrated development program.']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'The therapeutic area or disease indication that the clinical development program targets (e.g., Oncology, Cardiology, Neurology). Used for portfolio segmentation and resource allocation.']
  timeline_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for this program timeline record, used in CTMS, eTMF, and sponsor communications to uniquely reference the schedule baseline.']
  timeline_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable descriptive name for the program timeline (e.g., \'Phase II/III Integrated Development Timeline v2\'), used in governance reports and portfolio dashboards.']
  timeline_status varchar [note: 'Current schedule health status of the program timeline, indicating whether the program is on-track, at-risk of delay, actively delayed, completed, or cancelled. Used in portfolio governance reporting and escalation workflows.']
  timeline_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the timeline record indicating whether it represents the approved baseline, current forecast, a scenario plan, or an archived historical version.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The system timestamp when this program timeline record was most recently modified. Enables change detection, incremental processing, and audit trail maintenance per ALCOA+ principles.']
  version varchar [note: 'Version identifier for this timeline record (e.g., v1.0, v2.3), enabling tracking of successive baseline revisions and forecast updates over the program lifecycle.']
  version_effective_date date [note: 'The date from which this timeline version became the operative schedule for the program. Enables point-in-time reconstruction of the program schedule for regulatory submissions and audits.']
  version_superseded_date date [note: 'The date on which this timeline version was superseded by a newer version. Null for the currently active version. Supports historical timeline reconstruction and version chain integrity.']

  Note: 'Master record for the integrated program-level timeline, capturing the overall schedule baseline and current forecast for a clinical development program. Captures timeline version, baseline start date, baseline end date, current forecast start date, current forecast end date, critical path summary, schedule variance (days), timeline status (on-track, at-risk, delayed), last updated date, and timeline owner. Provides the program-level scheduling backbone from which study-level timelines are derived.'
}

  program_milestone_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to program.program_milestone.   timeline_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to program.program_timeline.   delay_reason_description varchar [note: 'Free-text narrative providing additional context for the delay reason code, capturing specific circumstances contributing to the schedule variance. Supports root cause analysis and lessons learned.']
  dependency_type varchar [note: 'The logical dependency relationship between this event and its predecessor event, following standard project scheduling conventions (Finish-to-Start, Start-to-Start, Finish-to-Finish, Start-to-Finish). Used in critical path network construction.']
  duration_days varchar [note: 'The planned number of calendar days allocated for the completion of this timeline event, from start to finish. Used in resource planning and Gantt chart construction.']
  early_start_date date [note: 'The earliest possible date this event can begin based on predecessor completion and resource availability, as calculated in the critical path network. Used for schedule optimization and float analysis.']
  event_category varchar [note: 'High-level functional category grouping the event for portfolio analytics and cross-domain reporting. Enables filtering by clinical, regulatory, safety, biostatistics, data management, or operational workstreams.']
  event_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the timeline event, used in program plans, Gantt charts, and regulatory submissions. Follows the EVT- prefix convention in Oracle Siebel CTMS.']
  event_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative description of the timeline event, including scope, acceptance criteria, and any special conditions. Provides context for program team members and governance reviewers.']
  event_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the timeline event (e.g., \'First Patient First Visit\', \'Database Lock\', \'NDA Submission\', \'Advisory Committee Meeting\'). Used in program dashboards and milestone reports.']
  event_status varchar [note: 'Current workflow state of the timeline event reflecting its execution progress. Drives program schedule performance dashboards and escalation workflows. Values: planned, in_progress, completed, delayed, cancelled.']
  event_type varchar [note: 'Categorical classification of the timeline event indicating its business nature. Drives reporting groupings and critical path logic. Values: study_start, database_lock, regulatory_submission, advisory_committee_meeting, approval_decision, program_review. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: study_start|database_lock|regulatory_submission|advisory_committee_meeting|approval_decision|program_review|dsmb_meeting|interim_analysis|site_initiation|enrollment_complete|last_patient_last_visit|csr_submission|ind_filing|nda_submission|bla_submission|maa_submission — promote to reference product]']
  float_days varchar [note: 'The number of calendar days by which this event can be delayed without impacting the program critical path. Zero float indicates a critical path event. Supports proactive schedule risk management.']
  forecast_date date [note: 'The current best-estimate date on which this timeline event is expected to occur, updated as program conditions evolve. Reflects the most recent schedule projection used in program review meetings.']
  lag_days varchar [note: 'The number of calendar days of lag or lead time applied to the dependency relationship with the predecessor event. Positive values indicate a waiting period after predecessor completion; negative values indicate overlap.']
  late_finish_date date [note: 'The latest date by which this event must be completed without delaying the overall program end date. Used in critical path analysis to determine schedule float and prioritize risk mitigation.']
  milestone_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this timeline event is designated as a key program milestone (True) versus a routine scheduled deliverable (False). Milestone events are tracked at the executive and sponsor governance level.']
  owner_name varchar [note: 'Name of the individual or team lead responsible for ensuring this timeline event is completed on schedule. Used in program status reports and escalation communications.']
  planned_date date [note: 'The originally baselined date on which this timeline event was scheduled to occur, as defined in the approved program plan. Serves as the baseline reference for schedule variance calculations.']
  priority varchar [note: 'Business priority assigned to this timeline event reflecting its strategic importance to the program. Used to triage resource allocation and escalation decisions during program reviews.']
  regulatory_agency varchar [note: 'The regulatory authority to which a submission or approval decision event is directed (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA, TGA, Health Canada). Nullable for non-regulatory events. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|PMDA|MHRA|TGA|Health_Canada|Other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  regulatory_submission_type varchar [note: 'For events of type regulatory_submission, specifies the submission dossier type (e.g., IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, eCTD). Nullable for non-regulatory event types. Aligns with FDA, EMA, PMDA submission classifications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IND|NDA|BLA|MAA|eCTD|sNDA|sBLA — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  responsible_role varchar [note: 'The functional role or organizational unit accountable for delivering this timeline event (e.g., Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Data Management). Used for workload planning and accountability tracking.']
  risk_level varchar [note: 'Assessed risk level for this timeline event based on schedule sensitivity, predecessor dependencies, and program impact. Drives escalation thresholds and program governance reporting.']
  schedule_variance_days varchar [note: 'The difference in calendar days between the actual (or forecast) date and the planned baseline date. Positive values indicate delay; negative values indicate early completion. Key KPI for program schedule performance reporting.']
  source_event_reference varchar [note: 'The native identifier of this timeline event in the originating operational system (e.g., Siebel CTMS milestone ID, Oracle Clinical One event ID). Enables traceability back to the system of record.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The operational system of record from which this timeline event record was sourced (e.g., Oracle Siebel CTMS, Oracle Clinical One, Veeva Vault, or manual entry). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this timeline event record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and data currency validation in the Silver Layer lakehouse.']

  Note: 'Transactional record for individual scheduled events and deliverables within a program timeline. Captures event name, event type (study start, database lock, regulatory submission, advisory committee meeting, approval decision, program review), planned date, forecast date, actual date, event status (planned, in-progress, completed, delayed, cancelled), predecessor event reference, and schedule variance in days. Enables granular tracking of program schedule performance and critical path management.'
}

Table program.risk {
  risk_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the program-level risk record within the clinical development program risk register.']
  clinical_program_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical development program to which this risk belongs, enabling portfolio-level risk aggregation and governance reporting.']
  owner_employee_id varchar [note: 'FK to workforce.employee']
  owner_id varchar [note: 'FK to workforce.employee']
  parent_risk_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on risk (parent_risk_id)']
  risk_employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the workforce member (typically a Program Director, Clinical Lead, or Regulatory Affairs Lead) accountable for monitoring and managing this risk to resolution. Aligns with RACI accountability frameworks in GCP-compliant program governance.']
  actual_resolution_date date [note: 'Date on which the risk was actually resolved (mitigated, closed, or accepted). Null if the risk remains open. Used for cycle time analysis and governance performance reporting.']
  affected_studies varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of study protocol numbers or identifiers within the program that are impacted by this risk. Supports cross-study impact analysis and portfolio governance reporting. (Formal study-level linkage is established via the program_risk_study association product.)']
  capa_reference varchar [note: 'Reference identifier of any associated CAPA record in MasterControl or the quality management system, linking this risk to formal corrective and preventive action processes where applicable.']
  comments varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional context, reviewer notes, governance meeting minutes excerpts, or supplementary information related to the risk that does not fit structured fields. Supports audit trail completeness per ALCOA+ principles.']
  contingency_plan varchar [note: 'Documented fallback actions to be executed if the risk materializes despite mitigation efforts (e.g., \'If IND placed on clinical hold, initiate Type B meeting with FDA within 30 days\'). Supports business continuity and regulatory response planning.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this risk record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail, ALCOA+ compliance, and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record requirements.']
  escalation_date date [note: 'Date on which the risk was formally escalated to a higher governance level (e.g., program steering committee, sponsor, DSMB/DMC). Null if escalation has not occurred.']
  escalation_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this risk requires escalation to program leadership, the sponsor, DSMB/DMC, or a regulatory authority based on its risk score or category. Drives governance workflow routing.']
  escalation_target varchar [note: 'The governance body or individual to whom the risk has been escalated (e.g., Program Steering Committee, Sponsor Medical Monitor, DSMB, FDA). Supports audit trail and governance accountability.']
  financial_exposure_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Estimated financial exposure or potential cost impact if the risk materializes, expressed in US dollars. Used for financial risk quantification, budget contingency planning, and sponsor reporting. Classified as confidential due to commercial sensitivity.']
  identified_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the risk was first formally identified and entered into the program risk register. Supports risk aging analysis and regulatory audit trails per ALCOA+ principles.']
  identifier varchar [note: 'Human-readable, externally-known unique code assigned to this risk record within the program risk register (e.g., PRSK-ONC-000123). Used in governance reports, DSMB/DMC submissions, and sponsor communications.']
  impact_rating varchar [note: 'Qualitative assessment of the severity of consequences if the risk materializes, considering impact on program timeline, patient safety, regulatory approval, and financial outcomes.']
  impact_score varchar [note: 'Numeric value corresponding to the impact rating (e.g., 1=very low, 2=low, 3=medium, 4=high, 5=very high). Combined with probability_score to compute the composite risk score.']
  last_review_date date [note: 'Date on which the risk was most recently reviewed and assessed by the risk owner or program governance committee. Supports overdue review identification and governance compliance tracking.']
  mitigation_status varchar [note: 'Current implementation status of the mitigation strategy: not_started, in_progress, completed, or on_hold. Enables tracking of mitigation execution progress separate from the overall risk status.']
  mitigation_strategy varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the planned or implemented actions to reduce the probability or impact of the risk (e.g., \'Engage additional regulatory consultant for IND submission review\', \'Activate backup sites to offset enrollment shortfall\'). Core field for proactive risk management per ICH Q9.']
  next_review_date date [note: 'Planned date for the next formal review of this risk. Drives automated review reminders and governance calendar scheduling. Frequency is typically determined by risk priority (e.g., critical risks reviewed monthly).']
  patient_safety_impact_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this risk has a direct or potential impact on patient safety, including SAE/SUSAR reporting obligations, DSMB/DMC review triggers, or clinical hold risk. Ensures safety risks receive mandatory expedited review.']
  priority varchar [note: 'Derived priority classification based on the risk score (e.g., critical: score 20–25, high: 12–19, medium: 6–11, low: 1–5). Used to drive escalation workflows, governance review frequency, and resource allocation decisions.']
  probability_rating varchar [note: 'Qualitative likelihood rating that the risk event will materialize during the program lifecycle. Typically assessed on a 5-point scale (very low to very high) per the program\'s risk management framework. Used in risk scoring and prioritization.']
  probability_score varchar [note: 'Numeric value corresponding to the probability rating (e.g., 1=very low, 2=low, 3=medium, 4=high, 5=very high). Used in quantitative risk score calculation and portfolio-level risk heat map generation.']
  regulatory_impact_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this risk has a direct potential impact on regulatory submissions (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, eCTD) or regulatory agency interactions (FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA, TGA, Health Canada). Drives regulatory affairs team notification workflows.']
  residual_impact_rating varchar [note: 'Reassessed impact rating after mitigation controls have been applied. Used alongside residual_probability_rating to compute the residual risk score and confirm risk acceptability.']
  residual_probability_rating varchar [note: 'Reassessed probability rating after mitigation controls have been applied. Compared against the initial probability_rating to demonstrate risk reduction effectiveness.']
  residual_risk_score varchar [note: 'Composite risk score after mitigation (residual probability score × residual impact score). Compared to the pre-mitigation risk_score to quantify risk reduction and determine if the residual risk is within acceptable tolerance.']
  risk_category varchar [note: 'High-level classification of the risk domain: scientific (e.g., efficacy uncertainty), regulatory (e.g., IND/NDA/BLA/MAA submission risk), operational (e.g., site activation delays), competitive (e.g., competitor trial results), financial (e.g., budget overrun), or safety (e.g., emerging SAE signal).']
  risk_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative describing the nature of the risk, its potential cause, and the business context in which it was identified. Supports risk review meetings, DSMB/DMC briefings, and regulatory submissions.']
  risk_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the risk record: open (active and unresolved), mitigated (controls applied and risk reduced), closed (risk no longer applicable or resolved), accepted (risk acknowledged and formally accepted by program leadership without further mitigation).']
  score varchar [note: 'Composite numeric risk score, typically calculated as probability_score × impact_score (range 1–25 on a 5×5 matrix). Drives risk prioritization, escalation thresholds, and portfolio risk heat map reporting.']
  source_record_reference varchar [note: 'Identifier of the corresponding record in the originating source system (e.g., CTMS risk ID, Veeva Vault document ID, MasterControl CAPA ID). Supports data lineage tracing and reconciliation between the lakehouse and operational systems.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Operational system of record from which this risk record originated (e.g., Oracle Siebel CTMS for operational risks, Veeva Vault for regulatory/quality risks, MasterControl for CAPA-linked risks, or manual entry via governance process).']
  subcategory varchar [note: 'More granular classification within the risk category (e.g., within \'regulatory\': IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, PMDA, EMA; within \'safety\': SAE signal, SUSAR reporting, DSMB review). Supports detailed risk analytics and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ind_approval|nda_submission|bla_submission|maa_submission|ema_review|pmda_review|sae_signal|susar_reporting|dsmb_review|site_activation|patient_recruitment|data_quality|supply_chain|budget|competitor_data|scientific_validity — promote to reference product]']
  target_resolution_date date [note: 'Target date by which the risk is expected to be mitigated, closed, or formally accepted. Used for milestone tracking and program governance reporting.']
  timeline_impact_days varchar [note: 'Estimated number of calendar days by which the program or study timeline could be delayed if this risk materializes. Used for critical path analysis, milestone risk assessment, and sponsor portfolio reporting.']
  title varchar [note: 'Short, human-readable label summarizing the risk (e.g., \'Delayed IND approval due to CMC data gaps\'). Used as the primary display name in risk dashboards and portfolio governance reports.']
  tolerance_threshold varchar [note: 'Maximum acceptable risk score defined by the program governance framework. Risks with residual_risk_score exceeding this threshold require escalation to senior leadership or the sponsor. Supports risk acceptance decision-making.']
  trigger_criteria varchar [note: 'Defined conditions or early warning indicators that signal the risk is materializing or escalating (e.g., \'Enrollment rate falls below 60% of target for two consecutive months\'). Supports proactive risk monitoring and automated alerting.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this risk record, in ISO 8601 format. Supports change tracking, audit trail completeness, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver layer.']

  Note: 'Master record for program-level risks identified through risk management processes. Captures risk identifier, risk category (scientific, regulatory, operational, competitive, financial, safety), risk description, probability rating, impact rating, risk score, risk owner, mitigation strategy, contingency plan, risk status (open, mitigated, closed, accepted), identification date, and last review date. Supports proactive program risk management and portfolio governance reporting.'
}

Table program.risk_mitigation {

Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE category for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity. Typically a Program Manager, Risk Manager, or functional lead.']

Drives risk dashboard reporting and escalation workflows. \'overdue\' is set when planned_completion_date has passed without completion. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.']
  action_title varchar [note: 'Short, human-readable title summarizing the mitigation action (e.g., \'Implement enhanced site monitoring protocol\'). Used as the IDENTITY_LABEL in risk registers and dashboards.']
  action_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the mitigation action by its strategic intent: preventive (reduces likelihood), corrective (addresses root cause after occurrence), contingency (response plan if risk materializes), transfer (shifts risk to another party), or acceptance (formal acknowledgment of residual risk).']
  actual_completion_date date [note: 'The date on which the mitigation action was fully executed and confirmed complete. Null if the action has not yet been completed. Used to calculate cycle time and assess timeliness of risk response.']

  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this mitigation action record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail compliance.']
  data_integrity_impact_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the risk being mitigated has a direct or potential impact on clinical data integrity (ALCOA+ principles). True = data integrity is implicated; False = no direct data integrity impact. Relevant for EDC and CDISC compliance.']
  due_date_revised date [note: 'Updated target completion date if the original planned_completion_date was formally extended. Captures approved timeline changes and distinguishes legitimate extensions from overdue actions.']
  effectiveness_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text narrative from the effectiveness reviewer documenting the rationale for the effectiveness rating, evidence reviewed, and any observations about residual risk or further actions needed.']
  effectiveness_rating varchar [note: 'Post-execution assessment of how effectively the mitigation action reduced or eliminated the identified risk. Populated after action completion and formal effectiveness review. Drives decisions on whether additional mitigation is required.']
  effectiveness_review_date date [note: 'The date on which the formal effectiveness assessment of the completed mitigation action was conducted. Required for CAPA closure and regulatory inspection readiness.']
  implementation_approach varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the specific method, process, or procedure to be used in executing the mitigation action. May reference SOPs, work instructions, or system configurations (e.g., EDC edit checks, RTSM alerts).']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this mitigation action record was most recently modified. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail compliance.']
  linked_milestone varchar [note: 'Name or code of the program milestone (e.g., \'First Patient In\', \'Database Lock\', \'NDA Submission\') to which this mitigation action is tied. Enables milestone-level risk tracking and critical path analysis.']
  mitigation_action_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for the mitigation action, used in risk registers, audit trails, and regulatory submissions. Follows the pattern MIT-<PROGRAM_CODE>-<SEQUENCE>. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.']
  mitigation_strategy varchar [note: 'High-level strategic approach applied to manage the risk, aligned with ICH Q9 risk management principles. Distinguishes the overarching strategy from the specific action_type.']
  planned_completion_date date [note: 'The target date by which the mitigation action is expected to be fully executed and closed. Used to calculate overdue status and drive risk dashboard KPI reporting. Serves as the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date-precision) for this entity.']
  planned_start_date date [note: 'The date on which execution of the mitigation action is planned to begin. Used for timeline planning, Gantt chart generation, and milestone tracking within the program risk management plan.']
  priority_level varchar [note: 'Business priority assigned to this mitigation action, reflecting the urgency of execution relative to the risk severity and program timeline. Drives resource allocation and escalation thresholds.']
  recurrence_prevention_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes describing measures put in place to prevent recurrence of the risk after mitigation. Supports lessons-learned capture and cross-program knowledge transfer within the clinical development portfolio.']
  regulatory_impact_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this mitigation action has direct implications for regulatory submissions (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA) or regulatory agency notifications. True = regulatory impact identified; False = no direct regulatory impact.']
  residual_risk_acceptance_date date [note: 'The date on which the residual risk was formally accepted by the authorized governance body. Null if residual risk has not yet been accepted or if further mitigation is required.']
  residual_risk_accepted boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the residual risk level after mitigation has been formally accepted by the program risk governance body (e.g., DSMB, DMC, or Sponsor). True = accepted; False = further mitigation required.']
  residual_risk_level varchar [note: 'The assessed level of risk remaining after the mitigation action has been fully implemented and its effectiveness confirmed. Used to determine whether the residual risk is acceptable or requires further mitigation per the program risk acceptance criteria.']
  responsible_function varchar [note: 'The organizational function or department accountable for executing this mitigation action (e.g., Clinical Operations, Data Management, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, Biostatistics). Supports cross-functional risk governance reporting.']
  risk_domain varchar [note: 'The functional domain of the parent risk that this mitigation action addresses. Enables domain-specific risk reporting and cross-program benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: safety|regulatory|data_quality|operational|financial|supply_chain|site|subject_recruitment — promote to reference product]']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The operational system of record from which this mitigation action record originated (e.g., Oracle Siebel CTMS risk module, MasterControl CAPA module, Veeva Vault quality management). Supports data lineage and Silver Layer provenance tracking.']
  subject_safety_impact_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the risk being mitigated has a direct or potential impact on subject safety. True = subject safety is implicated; False = no direct subject safety impact. Drives prioritization and DSMB/DMC notification requirements.']
  supporting_systems varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of operational systems involved in executing or monitoring this mitigation action (e.g., Medidata Rave, Oracle Argus Safety, Veeva Vault). Supports system-level impact analysis and integration planning.']
  verification_date date [note: 'The date on which implementation of the mitigation action was formally verified as complete and effective. Distinct from actual_completion_date (when the action was done) and effectiveness_review_date (when effectiveness was assessed).']
  verification_method varchar [note: 'Description of the method used to verify that the mitigation action has been implemented as planned (e.g., site visit, SDV, EDC audit trail review, document review in Veeva Vault, monitoring report review). Supports GCP audit readiness.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Incrementing version counter for this mitigation action record, supporting optimistic concurrency control and audit trail versioning in the Databricks Silver Layer. Incremented on each substantive update.']

  Note: 'Transactional record capturing individual risk mitigation actions and their execution status for program-level risks. Captures mitigation action description, action owner, planned completion date, actual completion date, action status (planned, in-progress, completed, overdue), effectiveness assessment, and residual risk level after mitigation. Enables tracking of risk response execution and effectiveness evaluation within the program risk management framework.'
}

Table program.assumption {
  assumption_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the program assumption record within the clinical development program planning framework.']
  assumption_employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the Workday HCM workforce record of the individual (typically a Program Director, Clinical Lead, or Regulatory Affairs Lead) accountable for maintaining, validating, and updating this assumption.']
  assumption_validated_by_employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the Workday HCM workforce record of the individual who performed or approved the most recent validation of this assumption.']
  clinical_program_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical development program to which this assumption belongs. Links the assumption to its parent program for portfolio governance and milestone tracking.']
  owner_employee_id varchar [note: 'FK to workforce.employee']
  owner_id varchar [note: 'FK to workforce.employee']
  parent_assumption_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing identifier linking this assumption to a higher-level parent assumption, enabling hierarchical assumption structures within the clinical development plan (e.g., a site-level enrollment assumption nested under a program-level enrollment assumption).']
  revised_assumption_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on assumption (revised_assumption_id)']
  applicable_geography varchar [note: 'Geographic scope to which this assumption applies, expressed as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or regional designations (e.g., \'USA\', \'GBR\', \'JPN\', \'Global\'). Relevant for enrollment rate, regulatory timeline, and site activation assumptions.']
  applicable_phase varchar [note: 'Clinical development phase(s) to which this assumption applies. Allows program planners to scope assumptions to specific phases of the development program (Phase 1 through Phase 4 or across all phases).']
  assumption_category varchar [note: 'Categorical classification of the planning assumption type that drives program timeline and resource planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: enrollment_rate|regulatory_timeline|safety_profile|competitive_landscape|manufacturing_readiness|biomarker_prevalence|dropout_rate — promote to reference product]']
  assumption_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known, human-readable unique code assigned to this planning assumption for cross-referencing in clinical development plans, program governance documents, and regulatory submissions.']
  assumption_description varchar [note: 'Full narrative description of the planning assumption, including the basis for the assumption, supporting evidence, and its role in the clinical development plan timeline and resource projections.']
  assumption_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the planning assumption within the program governance workflow. Drives whether the assumption is actively used in program planning or has been retired/replaced.']
  assumption_value decimal(18,2) [note: 'The specific quantitative or qualitative value of the assumption (e.g., \'2.5 patients/site/month\', \'18 months for FDA review\', \'15% screen failure rate\'). Stored as STRING to accommodate diverse assumption types across categories.']
  confidence_level varchar [note: 'Qualitative assessment of the degree of certainty in the planning assumption, based on available evidence, historical data, and expert judgment. Drives risk-adjusted program timeline and resource planning.']
  confidence_rationale varchar [note: 'Narrative explanation supporting the assigned confidence level, including references to historical study data, literature, competitive intelligence, or expert opinion used to substantiate the assumption.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this program assumption record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Required for ALCOA+ audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11.']
  data_source varchar [note: 'Primary source of data or evidence underpinning this assumption (e.g., \'Medidata Rave enrollment metrics\', \'Published literature – NEJM 2022\', \'FDA precedent database\', \'Internal historical study database\', \'Competitive intelligence report\').']
  dependency_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the program plan elements, milestones, studies, or other assumptions that are dependent on this assumption. Identifies what would need to be revised if this assumption is invalidated.']
  effective_from_date date [note: 'Date from which this assumption version is considered active and applicable to program planning. Supports temporal versioning of assumptions across the clinical development lifecycle.']
  effective_to_date date [note: 'Date on which this assumption version ceases to be active. Null indicates the assumption is currently in effect. Supports historical tracking of assumption changes across program lifecycle.']
  invalidation_trigger varchar [note: 'Specific, pre-defined condition or threshold that, if observed, would constitute invalidation of this assumption and trigger a program plan revision (e.g., \'Enrollment rate falls below 1.0 patients/site/month for 3 consecutive months\').']
  is_dependency_trigger boolean [note: 'Indicates whether invalidation of this assumption would trigger a mandatory revision of dependent program plan elements, milestones, or other assumptions. True = this is a critical dependency assumption requiring escalation upon invalidation.']
  last_review_date date [note: 'Date on which this assumption was most recently formally reviewed by the program governance committee or assumption owner, regardless of whether the assumption value was changed.']
  lower_bound_value decimal(18,2) [note: 'Pessimistic or minimum plausible value for the assumption used in downside scenario planning and sensitivity analysis (e.g., \'1.5 patients/site/month\' as the low-end enrollment rate estimate).']
  next_review_date date [note: 'Scheduled date for the next formal review of this assumption by the program governance committee or assumption owner. Drives automated review reminders in the CTMS and program planning tools.']
  regulatory_agency varchar [note: 'Primary regulatory agency relevant to this assumption, particularly for regulatory timeline and submission assumptions. Drives agency-specific planning parameters in the clinical development plan. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|PMDA|MHRA|TGA|Health_Canada|WHO|Other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  review_frequency varchar [note: 'Scheduled frequency at which this assumption must be reviewed and revalidated by the assumption owner or program governance committee to ensure continued relevance to the clinical development plan.']
  risk_mitigation_plan varchar [note: 'Description of the contingency or mitigation actions to be executed if this assumption is invalidated, including fallback strategies, alternative approaches, and escalation paths within the program governance framework.']
  sensitivity_to_program varchar [note: 'Assessment of the degree to which invalidation of this assumption would materially impact the program timeline, budget, or probability of success. High sensitivity assumptions trigger mandatory program plan revision if invalidated.']
  subcategory varchar [note: 'Further granular classification within the assumption category (e.g., within \'enrollment_rate\': \'screen_failure_rate\', \'site_activation_rate\'). Enables detailed segmentation for sensitivity analysis and program risk management.']
  supporting_document_ref varchar [note: 'Reference identifier or URL to supporting documentation in Veeva Vault eTMF or document management system (e.g., Clinical Development Plan version, Feasibility Report, Regulatory Intelligence Report) that substantiates this assumption.']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'Therapeutic area or disease indication to which this assumption applies (e.g., \'Oncology\', \'Cardiovascular\', \'Rare Disease\', \'Neuroscience\'). Enables cross-program benchmarking of assumptions within the same therapeutic area.']
  title varchar [note: 'Concise, human-readable title summarizing the planning assumption (e.g., \'Phase 3 Enrollment Rate – North America Sites\'). Used as the primary label in program governance dashboards and Clinical Development Plan (CDP) documents.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this program assumption record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Required for ALCOA+ audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11.']
  upper_bound_value decimal(18,2) [note: 'Optimistic or maximum plausible value for the assumption used in upside scenario planning and sensitivity analysis (e.g., \'4.0 patients/site/month\' as the high-end enrollment rate estimate).']
  validation_date date [note: 'Date on which the assumption was most recently validated or invalidated by the assumption owner or program governance committee. Used to assess currency of assumptions in program planning.']
  validation_method varchar [note: 'Description of the method or evidence source used to validate the assumption (e.g., \'Historical enrollment data from Phase 2 study\', \'FDA precedent review\', \'DSMB interim analysis\', \'Competitive intelligence report\').']
  validation_status varchar [note: 'Current validation state of the assumption, reflecting whether supporting evidence has been reviewed and confirmed. Validated assumptions are used as confirmed inputs to program planning; invalidated assumptions trigger plan revision workflows.']
  value_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the assumption value where applicable (e.g., \'patients/site/month\', \'months\', \'percentage\', \'mg/kg\'). Ensures unambiguous interpretation of quantitative assumptions in program planning models.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Sequential version number of this assumption record, incremented each time the assumption value, confidence level, or validation status is formally revised. Supports audit trail and change history requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.']
  version_rationale varchar [note: 'Narrative explanation for why this version of the assumption was created, including the trigger event (e.g., \'Updated based on Phase 2 interim enrollment data\', \'Revised following FDA Type B meeting feedback\', \'Adjusted per DSMB recommendation\').']

  Note: 'Master record for key planning assumptions underlying the clinical development plan and program timeline. Captures assumption description, assumption category (enrollment rate, regulatory timeline, safety profile, competitive landscape, manufacturing readiness), assumption owner, confidence level, sensitivity to program outcome (high/medium/low), validation status, validation date, and assumption review frequency. Tracks the dependency assumptions that, if invalidated, would trigger program plan revisions.'
}

Table program.cross_study_dependency {
  cross_study_dependency_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the cross-study dependency record within the clinical development program. Primary key for this association entity.']
  predecessor_cross_study_dependency_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on cross_study_dependency (predecessor_cross_study_dependency_id)']
  primary_cross_clinical_program_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical development program under which this cross-study dependency is governed. Links the dependency to its overarching portfolio governance context.']
  primary_cross_predecessor_study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the study whose outcome, data, or completion gates the successor study. The predecessor study must reach a defined milestone or status before the successor can proceed.']
  program_milestone_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific program or study milestone record in the CTMS that represents the gating event in the predecessor study. Enables direct linkage between dependency tracking and milestone management.']
  actual_resolution_date date [note: 'Date on which the dependency was actually resolved, waived, or formally closed. Populated when dependency_status transitions to \'resolved\' or \'waived\'. Enables schedule variance analysis.']
  comments varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional context, notes, or observations about this dependency that do not fit into structured fields. Used by program managers and clinical operations teams for ad hoc annotations.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this cross-study dependency record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and ALCOA+ compliance requirements.']
  cross_program_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this dependency spans studies in different clinical development programs (True) or is contained within a single program (False). Cross-program dependencies require portfolio-level governance escalation.']
  data_package_required varchar [note: 'Description of the specific data package, dataset, or analysis output from the predecessor study required to satisfy this dependency (e.g., \'Interim PK/PD analysis dataset in CDISC ADaM format\', \'DSMB safety summary report\', \'Dose-response modeling results\'). Relevant for data dependencies.']
  dependency_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for this dependency record, used in program planning documents, integrated development plans, and CTMS tracking. Format: DEP- followed by 4-12 alphanumeric characters.']
  dependency_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative describing the nature, rationale, and conditions of the dependency between the predecessor and successor studies. Captures what specific data, outcome, or event from the predecessor is required and why.']
  dependency_direction varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the dependency flows in one direction only (predecessor gates successor) or bidirectionally (studies mutually constrain each other, e.g., platform trials with shared safety data). Bidirectional dependencies require special governance handling.']
  dependency_name varchar [note: 'Short human-readable label for the dependency, used in program planning dashboards, integrated timelines, and governance reports (e.g., \'Phase 1 PK Data Required for Phase 2 Dose Selection\').']
  dependency_owner varchar [note: 'Name or role of the individual or team accountable for monitoring and resolving this dependency (e.g., Program Director, Clinical Operations Lead, Regulatory Affairs Lead). Supports accountability in program governance.']
  dependency_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the dependency. \'active\' = dependency is in force and being tracked; \'resolved\' = predecessor condition has been met and dependency is satisfied; \'waived\' = dependency formally waived by program governance with documented rationale; \'on_hold\' = dependency tracking paused pending external decision; \'pending_review\' = dependency under governance review for waiver or modification.']
  dependency_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the nature of the dependency between studies. \'data\' = successor requires data outputs (e.g., PK/PD, biomarker) from predecessor; \'safety\' = successor requires safety review or DSMB/DMC clearance from predecessor; \'regulatory\' = successor requires regulatory milestone (IND, NDA, MAA) from predecessor; \'supply\' = successor requires drug supply or manufacturing readiness from predecessor; \'sequential_design\' = adaptive or platform trial design where predecessor results inform successor design; \'operational\' = site, staff, or resource dependency.']
  dsmb_review_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether resolution of this dependency requires a formal DSMB or DMC safety review of predecessor study data before the successor study may initiate. Particularly relevant for safety dependencies.']
  effective_from_date date [note: 'Date from which this dependency record is considered active and binding for program planning purposes. Supports temporal tracking of when dependencies were formally established.']
  effective_to_date date [note: 'Date on which this dependency record ceases to be active (e.g., upon resolution, waiver, or supersession by a revised dependency). Null for currently active dependencies. Supports slowly changing dimension tracking.']
  escalation_contact varchar [note: 'Name or role of the senior stakeholder to whom this dependency is escalated if it is at risk of not being resolved by the planned resolution date. Supports risk escalation workflows in program governance.']
  gating_condition_detail varchar [note: 'Precise, measurable condition or threshold that must be met in the predecessor study to release the successor (e.g., \'Minimum 80% of Phase 1 subjects must complete PK sampling\', \'No Grade 3+ DLTs observed at target dose level\'). Supports objective dependency resolution assessment.']
  gating_milestone varchar [note: 'Specific milestone or event in the predecessor study that must be achieved to satisfy this dependency (e.g., \'Database Lock\', \'DSMB Safety Review Completion\', \'Regulatory Clearance of IND Amendment\', \'Last Patient Last Visit\'). Aligns with CTMS milestone tracking.']
  governance_review_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this dependency requires formal review and sign-off by a program governance committee (e.g., Program Steering Committee, Joint Development Committee) before the successor study can proceed.']
  impact_if_unmet varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the business, regulatory, or patient safety impact if this dependency is not satisfied before the successor study proceeds. Used in risk management and program governance decision-making.']
  last_review_date date [note: 'Date on which this dependency record was most recently reviewed by the program governance team or dependency owner. Supports periodic dependency health checks in integrated program planning.']
  mitigation_plan varchar [note: 'Documented contingency or mitigation strategy to be executed if this dependency cannot be resolved by the planned date. Describes alternative approaches to allow the successor study to proceed with acceptable risk.']
  next_review_date date [note: 'Scheduled date for the next formal review of this dependency by the program governance team. Drives governance calendar and ensures active dependencies are not overlooked.']
  planned_resolution_date date [note: 'Target date by which the dependency is expected to be resolved (i.e., the predecessor gating milestone is expected to be achieved). Used in integrated program timeline planning and critical path analysis.']
  regulatory_agency_notification_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether resolution or waiver of this dependency requires notification to or approval from a regulatory agency (FDA, EMA, PMDA, etc.) before the successor study proceeds. Drives regulatory submission planning.']
  regulatory_submission_reference varchar [note: 'Reference number or identifier of the regulatory submission (IND amendment, CTA, protocol amendment) associated with the resolution or waiver of this dependency. Links to Veeva Vault regulatory submission records.']
  risk_level varchar [note: 'Assessed risk level associated with this dependency not being met on schedule. \'critical\' = program-stopping impact; \'high\' = significant delay or regulatory risk; \'medium\' = manageable delay with mitigation; \'low\' = minor impact with available workarounds. Supports integrated program risk management.']
  schedule_impact_days varchar [note: 'Estimated number of calendar days by which the successor study initiation would be delayed if this dependency is not resolved by the planned resolution date. Used in critical path and scenario planning.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Operational system of record from which this dependency record originated. \'CTMS\' = Oracle Siebel CTMS automated extraction; \'CTMS_MANUAL\' = manually entered in CTMS; \'IDP\' = Integrated Development Plan document; \'PROGRAM_OFFICE\' = Program Management Office planning tool.']
  source_system_record_reference varchar [note: 'Native identifier of this dependency record in the originating operational system (e.g., Oracle Siebel CTMS dependency object ID). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail back to the system of record.']
  successor_earliest_start_date date [note: 'Earliest permissible initiation date for the successor study, derived from the expected resolution of this dependency. Drives integrated program scheduling and site activation planning.']
  supply_dependency_detail varchar [note: 'Specific description of the drug supply, manufacturing batch, or IRT/RTSM configuration requirement from the predecessor study that must be fulfilled before the successor study can be supplied. Relevant for supply dependencies.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this cross-study dependency record was most recently modified. Supports change detection, incremental data loading, and audit trail for regulatory inspection readiness.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Sequential version number of this dependency record, incremented each time the dependency definition, gating condition, or resolution criteria is formally revised. Supports change history and audit trail.']
  waiver_approval_date date [note: 'Date on which the dependency waiver was formally approved by the designated governance authority. Required for audit trail completeness when dependency_status = \'waived\'.']
  waiver_approved_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the governance body or senior authority (e.g., Program Steering Committee, Chief Medical Officer, DSMB) that approved the waiver of this dependency. Supports audit trail for regulatory inspection.']
  waiver_rationale varchar [note: 'Documented justification for formally waiving this dependency, including the scientific, regulatory, or operational basis for proceeding without satisfying the original gating condition. Required when dependency_status = \'waived\'.']

  Note: 'Association entity capturing formal dependencies between studies within a program or across programs where one study\'s outcome, data, or completion gates another study\'s initiation or design. Captures dependency type (data dependency, safety dependency, regulatory dependency, supply dependency, sequential design), predecessor study reference, successor study reference, dependency description, dependency status (active, resolved, waived), and impact if dependency is not met. Critical for integrated program planning and risk management.'
}

  risk_rating varchar [note: 'Assessment of the risk level associated with the resource gap or plan assumptions, used to prioritize escalation and mitigation actions in program governance reviews.']
  site_count varchar [note: 'Total number of investigational sites across all studies in the program contributing to the resource demand captured in this plan.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Operational system of record from which this resource plan data was sourced, enabling data lineage tracing in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  source_system_record_reference varchar [note: 'The native record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Workday HCM position plan ID, Oracle Siebel CTMS resource plan ID), supporting data lineage and reconciliation.']
  study_count varchar [note: 'Number of active studies within the program that are aggregated into this resource plan, providing context for the scale of cross-study resource demand.']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'The therapeutic area or disease indication associated with the program (e.g., Oncology, Cardiovascular, Neurology), providing context for resource benchmarking across programs.']

  Note: 'Master record for program-level resource planning, capturing the aggregate workforce and functional resource requirements across all studies in a program. Captures resource plan version, planning period, functional area (clinical operations, data management, biostatistics, regulatory affairs, medical monitoring), planned FTE count, forecasted FTE count, resource gap, resource plan status, and approval date. Distinct from workforce.resource_plan which is study-level; this entity manages cross-study program-level resource aggregation and planning.'
