  supply_chain_budget_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Budget allocation for investigational product (IP) manufacturing, packaging, labeling, distribution, and RTSM/IRT system operations across the program.']
  total_approved_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total approved financial envelope for the entire clinical development program across all studies, phases, and functional areas. Represents the gross authorized spend ceiling approved by governance.']
  version varchar [note: 'Version identifier for this budget record (e.g., v1.0, v2.0, v3.1). Supports budget versioning and revision history tracking as budgets are revised through the program lifecycle.']
  wbs_code varchar [note: 'Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element code from SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting that maps this program budget to the project hierarchy for cost tracking and financial reporting.']

  Note: 'Master record for the program-level budget envelope governing total financial investment across all studies and activities within a clinical development program. Captures budget version, total approved budget, budget by phase (Phase I, II, III), budget by functional area, currency, budget status (draft, approved, revised), approval date, and budget owner. Distinct from finance.study_budget which is study-level; this entity owns the program-level financial envelope and cross-study budget governance.'
}

Business justification: Competitive intelligence entries are evaluated against the sponsor\'s own pipeline asset in the same indication.   superseded_competitive_intelligence_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on competitive_intelligence (superseded_competitive_intelligence_id)']

  commercial_threat_level varchar [note: 'Assessed level of commercial threat posed by the competing asset to the program\'s investigational product. Drives portfolio prioritization and investment decisions. Classified as confidential due to strategic sensitivity.']
  competitor_asset_code varchar [note: 'Internal development code or compound identifier for the competing asset (e.g., sponsor compound code, CAS number, or WHO INN code) as referenced in public registries.']

  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this competitive intelligence record was first created in the system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking per 21 CFR Part 11.']

  intelligence_source_type varchar [note: 'Category of the primary source from which this competitive intelligence was obtained. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: public_registry|conference_abstract|publication|press_release|analyst_report|regulatory_filing|kol_interview|other — promote to reference product]']
  intelligence_source_url varchar [note: 'URL or hyperlink to the primary source document or registry entry from which this competitive intelligence was obtained. Enables direct verification and audit trail.']

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: first_line|second_line|third_line_plus|maintenance|adjuvant|neoadjuvant|any — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  mechanism_of_action varchar [note: 'Pharmacological mechanism by which the competing asset exerts its therapeutic effect (e.g., PD-1 inhibitor, VEGFR antagonist, CAR-T). Informs differentiation strategy and Target Product Profile (TPP) refinement.']

  pricing_reimbursement_notes varchar [note: 'Notes on the competitor\'s known or anticipated pricing, reimbursement status, and health technology assessment (HTA) outcomes. Informs commercial threat assessment and program value proposition. Classified as confidential due to strategic sensitivity.']
  primary_endpoint_type varchar [note: 'Type of primary clinical endpoint used in the competitor\'s pivotal trial (e.g., Overall Survival, Progression-Free Survival, HbA1c reduction). Informs endpoint strategy and SAP design for the program.']

  regulatory_status varchar [note: 'Current regulatory status of the competing asset across major health authorities. Tracks IND/CTA filing, NDA/BLA/MAA submission, and approval status. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ind_filed|cta_filed|phase_3_ongoing|nda_bla_filed|maa_filed|approved|withdrawn|discontinued — promote to reference product]']
  regulatory_submission_date date [note: 'Anticipated or actual date of NDA/BLA/MAA or equivalent regulatory submission for the competing asset. Informs program urgency and submission timeline strategy.']
  review_frequency varchar [note: 'Scheduled frequency at which this competitive intelligence entry should be reviewed and updated. Drives operational cadence for the competitive intelligence monitoring process.']
  safety_profile_summary varchar [note: 'Narrative summary of the known or reported safety and tolerability profile of the competing asset, including key adverse events (AEs) and serious adverse events (SAEs). Informs the program\'s risk-benefit assessment and DSMB charter.']

  tpp_impact_assessment varchar [note: 'Narrative assessment of how this competitive intelligence entry impacts the program\'s Target Product Profile (TPP) — including potential need for differentiation in efficacy, safety, dosing, or patient population. Directly supports go/no-go decision-making.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this competitive intelligence record was last modified in the system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail and change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11.']
  veeva_vault_document_reference varchar [note: 'Reference identifier for the associated competitive intelligence report or source document stored in Veeva Vault eTMF or quality management module. Enables direct document traceability.']

  Note: 'Master record for competitive intelligence entries tracked at the program level, capturing the competitive landscape for the therapeutic indication being developed. Captures competitor company, competitor asset name, competitor development phase, indication overlap, mechanism of action, key differentiators, data readout dates, regulatory status, commercial threat level, intelligence source, and last updated date. Informs program strategy, TPP refinement, and go/no-go decision-making.'

Table program.kri {

  indicator_owner_employee_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: KRI ownership is assigned to named employees accountable for monitoring and reporting in risk-based oversight frameworks. indicator_owner is a denormalized plain-text field; a FK enables KRI accountab']
  obligation_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: KRIs are defined to monitor compliance with specific regulatory obligations (e.g., KRI tracking enrollment rate against a pediatric obligation timeline). Linking program_kri to compliance.obligation s']
  parent_kri_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on kri (parent_kri_id)']
  previous_version_kri_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the prior version of this KRI/KPI definition record, enabling a full version history chain for audit and regulatory inspection purposes.']
  applicable_development_phase varchar [note: 'The clinical development phase(s) for which this indicator definition is applicable (e.g., Phase_I, Phase_II, Phase_III, Phase_IV, all_phases). Allows phase-specific KRI/KPI frameworks within the same program.']
  applicable_therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'The therapeutic area for which this indicator is specifically calibrated (e.g., Oncology, Neurology, Cardiovascular). Some KRI thresholds are disease-area specific. Null if the indicator applies universally across all therapeutic areas.']
  approval_date date [note: 'Date on which this KRI/KPI definition was formally approved by the designated approver. Marks the transition from draft to active status and is required for regulatory audit trail.']
  approved_by varchar [note: 'Name or user identifier of the individual who formally approved this KRI/KPI definition or its most recent version change. Required for electronic signature compliance under 21 CFR Part 11.']
  benchmark_source varchar [note: 'The source of the industry benchmark or historical baseline used to set the target and warning thresholds (e.g., \'TransCelerate Industry Benchmark 2023\', \'Internal Historical Average 2020-2023\', \'FDA Guidance\', \'Sponsor SOPs\'). Provides auditability for threshold-setting decisions.']
  benchmark_value decimal(18,4) [note: 'The industry or historical benchmark value for this indicator against which the target threshold was calibrated. Enables comparison of program performance against external standards.']
  capa_required_on_breach boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) must be initiated in MasterControl when this indicator breaches its critical threshold. Supports GCP compliance and quality management workflows.']
  change_rationale varchar [note: 'Business justification for the most recent change to this indicator definition, including threshold adjustments, metric redefinition, or ownership transfers. Required for audit trail completeness under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+.']

  data_source_object varchar [note: 'The specific module, dataset, form, or table within the source system from which indicator data is extracted (e.g., \'AE Form\' in Medidata Rave, \'Case Safety Report\' in Oracle Argus Safety, \'Visit Tracking\' in Oracle Siebel CTMS). Supports precise data lineage documentation.']
  data_source_system varchar [note: 'The operational system of record from which the raw data for this indicator is sourced (e.g., Medidata Rave, Oracle Argus Safety, Oracle Siebel CTMS, SAP S/4HANA). Enables data lineage tracing and source system reconciliation.']
  dsmb_reportable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a critical threshold breach for this indicator must be reported to the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC). Drives automated DSMB notification workflows.']
  effective_end_date date [note: 'The date on which this KRI/KPI definition is retired or superseded. Null for currently active indicators. Enables temporal versioning of the program monitoring framework.']
  effective_start_date date [note: 'The date from which this KRI/KPI definition becomes active and measurements begin. Supports versioning and historical comparison of indicator definitions over the program lifecycle.']
  escalation_owner varchar [note: 'Name or role of the individual or committee to whom a critical threshold breach is escalated (e.g., \'Program Steering Committee\', \'DSMB\', \'Sponsor Medical Monitor\'). Distinct from the indicator owner who manages routine monitoring.']
  governance_committee varchar [note: 'The governance body (e.g., Program Review Board, Portfolio Governance Committee, DSMB/DMC, Joint Steering Committee) in whose meetings this indicator is reviewed. Links the KRI/KPI to the appropriate oversight forum.']
  indicator_category varchar [note: 'Business domain category grouping this indicator for portfolio governance reporting (e.g., safety, data_quality, enrollment, site_performance, regulatory, supply_chain, finance, operational). Enables domain-level roll-up in governance dashboards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: safety|data_quality|enrollment|site_performance|regulatory|supply_chain|finance|operational|workforce|biostatistics — promote to reference product]']
  indicator_code varchar [note: 'Unique business-facing alphanumeric code identifying this KRI/KPI definition within the program portfolio (e.g., PRG-KRI-001, PRG-KPI-042). Used as the externally-known identifier in governance reports and portfolio dashboards.']
  indicator_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the KRI or KPI (e.g., \'Protocol Deviation Rate\', \'Site Activation Cycle Time\', \'SAE Reporting Compliance Rate\'). Used as the display label in governance meetings and portfolio reviews.']
  indicator_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of this KRI/KPI definition. \'draft\' = under development; \'active\' = in use for governance monitoring; \'suspended\' = temporarily paused; \'retired\' = no longer monitored; \'under_review\' = being reassessed for threshold or definition changes.']
  indicator_subtype varchar [note: 'Further classification within the indicator category (e.g., \'SAE Reporting\' under safety, \'Protocol Deviation\' under data_quality, \'Screen Failure Rate\' under enrollment). Provides granular segmentation for drill-down analytics.']
  indicator_type varchar [note: 'Classifies whether this indicator is a Key Risk Indicator (KRI) — measuring risk exposure — or a Key Performance Indicator (KPI) — measuring operational performance. Drives how thresholds are interpreted and escalated in governance.']
  is_critical_path boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this indicator is on the critical path for program delivery milestones. Critical path KRIs/KPIs receive priority escalation and are featured in executive portfolio dashboards.']
  is_regulatory_commitment boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this KRI/KPI is a formal regulatory commitment to a health authority (e.g., FDA, EMA) as part of a Risk Management Plan, IND, or study protocol. Regulatory commitment indicators require mandatory reporting and cannot be retired without authority approval.']
  is_safety_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this indicator is classified as a safety-related KRI (e.g., SAE reporting timeliness, SUSAR submission compliance, AE data completeness). Safety indicators receive heightened governance scrutiny and may trigger DSMB notification.']
  last_reviewed_date date [note: 'Date on which this indicator definition was most recently reviewed by the governance committee or indicator owner, even if no changes were made. Supports periodic review compliance and governance cadence tracking.']
  measurement_direction varchar [note: 'Indicates whether a higher value is favorable (e.g., consent rate), a lower value is favorable (e.g., protocol deviation rate), or the value should remain within a target range. Governs how threshold breaches are evaluated in governance logic.']
  measurement_frequency varchar [note: 'How often this indicator is measured and reported (e.g., daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly). Determines the cadence of data collection and governance review cycles. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|bi_weekly|monthly|quarterly|per_visit|ad_hoc — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  measurement_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the indicator value (e.g., \'percentage\', \'days\', \'count\', \'rate per 100 patient-years\', \'USD\'). Required for correct threshold interpretation and cross-program comparability.']
  metric_definition varchar [note: 'Precise business definition of what this indicator measures, including the numerator and denominator logic where applicable (e.g., \'Number of SAEs reported within 24 hours divided by total SAEs reported in the period, expressed as a percentage\'). Ensures consistent interpretation across sites and studies.']
  reporting_period_type varchar [note: 'Defines whether the indicator is measured over a rolling window (e.g., last 30 days), cumulatively from study start, at a specific point in time, or study-to-date. Critical for consistent interpretation of computed values.']
  responsible_function varchar [note: 'The organizational function or department accountable for monitoring and responding to this indicator (e.g., \'Clinical Operations\', \'Biostatistics\', \'Pharmacovigilance\', \'Data Management\', \'Regulatory Affairs\'). Drives escalation routing in governance workflows.']
  review_cycle varchar [note: 'Frequency at which the indicator definition itself (thresholds, metric definition, ownership) is formally reviewed and potentially updated by the governance committee. Distinct from measurement_frequency which governs data collection cadence.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The operational system of record from which this KRI/KPI definition record was originated or is mastered (e.g., Oracle Siebel CTMS, MasterControl, internal governance tool). Supports data lineage and system-of-record traceability.']
  source_system_record_reference varchar [note: 'The native identifier of this KRI/KPI record in the originating source system (e.g., CTMS indicator ID, MasterControl document number). Enables bidirectional reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and operational systems.']
  target_threshold decimal(18,4) [note: 'The desired or optimal value for this indicator representing expected performance under normal operating conditions. Serves as the baseline against which warning and critical thresholds are calibrated.']
  threshold_operator varchar [note: 'Logical operator defining how the measured value is compared to the warning and critical thresholds (e.g., \'gt\' = greater than triggers alert, \'lt\' = less than triggers alert, \'between\' = value must remain within a range). Required for automated threshold evaluation logic.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this KRI/KPI definition record was most recently modified. Required for change tracking and audit trail under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Version identifier for this KRI/KPI definition (e.g., \'1.0\', \'2.1\'). Incremented when metric definition, thresholds, or ownership changes are approved. Supports audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness.']
  warning_threshold decimal(18,4) [note: 'The threshold value at which the indicator triggers a yellow/amber alert, indicating early risk signal requiring heightened monitoring or investigation. Distinct from the critical threshold which triggers escalation.']

  Note: 'Master record defining Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) monitored at the program level for portfolio governance. Captures indicator name, indicator type (KRI or KPI), metric definition, measurement unit, target threshold, warning threshold, critical threshold, measurement frequency, data source, responsible owner, and indicator status. Provides the program-level performance monitoring framework used in governance meetings and portfolio reviews. NOTE: This is the DEFINITION of the indicator, not the computed value — no analytics or aggregations are stored here.'
}

Table program.kri_reading {
  kri_reading_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each periodic KRI/KPI reading record captured at the program level. Serves as the primary key for this transactional observation event.']
  clinical_program_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical development program for which this KRI reading was captured. Links the observation to the governing program entity.']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the user (program lead, medical monitor, or governance committee chair) who formally confirmed and accepted this KRI reading. Required for electronic signature compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 when reading_status transitions to \'confirmed\'.']
  governance_meeting_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the governance committee meeting (e.g., DSMB, PMC, Portfolio Review) during which this KRI reading was formally reviewed. Nullable when readings are generated outside a formal meeting cycle.']
  kri_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the KRI/KPI definition record that specifies the metric name, threshold configuration, and measurement methodology for this reading. Ensures each reading is traceable to its governing definition.']
  previous_kri_reading_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on kri_reading (previous_kri_reading_id)']
  superseded_by_reading_kri_reading_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the corrected KRI reading record that supersedes this one when reading_status is \'superseded\'. Enables full audit chain reconstruction for regulatory inspection, ensuring the history of corrections is traceable per ALCOA+ and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.']
  action_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this KRI reading requires a documented corrective or mitigation action. True = a CAPA or risk mitigation action must be initiated; False = no action required beyond continued monitoring.']
  amber_threshold_lower decimal(18,6) [note: 'The lower boundary of the caution (amber) performance range for this KRI at the time of reading. Values within the amber band trigger heightened monitoring and management attention without requiring immediate escalation.']
  amber_threshold_upper decimal(18,6) [note: 'The upper boundary of the caution (amber) performance range for this KRI at the time of reading. Denormalized from the KRI definition to preserve the threshold configuration in effect at reading time.']
  capa_reference varchar [note: 'Reference identifier of the CAPA record initiated in response to this KRI threshold breach. Links the reading to the formal quality management response tracked in MasterControl. Null when no CAPA has been initiated.']
  computation_method varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the observed value was computed automatically by an analytics pipeline, entered manually by a data manager or CRA, or produced through a semi-automated process requiring human validation. Relevant for data quality assessment and audit purposes under 21 CFR Part 11.']
  confirmed_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which this KRI reading was formally confirmed by the governance reviewer. Represents a distinct lifecycle event timestamp required for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance and audit trail completeness.']
  consecutive_breach_count varchar [note: 'Number of consecutive review cycles (including the current one) during which this KRI has been in amber or red status. Used by governance committees to assess persistence of risk signals and trigger escalation protocols when a defined breach duration threshold is exceeded.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which this KRI reading record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance and data lineage tracking.']
  data_quality_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a data quality concern was identified with the underlying source data used to compute this reading (e.g., incomplete EDC data, site data not yet reconciled, known system outage). True = data quality caveat applies; False = data considered complete and reliable.']
  data_quality_note varchar [note: 'Free-text description of the specific data quality issue identified when data_quality_flag is True. Documents the nature of the concern (e.g., \'Site 007 data not yet entered in EDC\', \'CTMS extract delayed by 3 days\') to support audit review and reading interpretation.']
  data_snapshot_reference varchar [note: 'Identifier or version label of the source data snapshot used to compute this KRI reading (e.g., EDC data extract version, CTMS report run ID, database lock reference). Ensures full traceability of the observed value back to the underlying data state, supporting ALCOA+ principles.']
  denominator_value decimal(18,6) [note: 'The denominator used in computing a rate or percentage KRI (e.g., total enrolled subjects for a protocol deviation rate, total expected visits for a visit completion rate). Stored alongside the observed value to enable independent verification of the computed metric and support audit traceability.']
  escalation_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this KRI reading has triggered a formal escalation to senior management, the sponsor, or a regulatory body based on threshold breach severity or consecutive breach count. True = escalation initiated; False = no escalation required.']
  escalation_level varchar [note: 'The organizational level to which this KRI reading has been escalated when escalation_flag is True. Determines the appropriate response protocol and notification recipients. Null when no escalation is required.']
  green_threshold_lower decimal(18,6) [note: 'The lower boundary of the acceptable (green) performance range for this KRI at the time of reading. Denormalized from the KRI definition to preserve the threshold configuration that was in effect at the time of this specific reading, supporting historical audit and trend analysis.']
  green_threshold_upper decimal(18,6) [note: 'The upper boundary of the acceptable (green) performance range for this KRI at the time of reading. Denormalized from the KRI definition to preserve the threshold configuration in effect at reading time.']
  kri_category varchar [note: 'High-level domain category classifying the KRI for portfolio-level aggregation and governance reporting. Enables committee members to filter and group indicators by risk domain. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: safety|data_quality|enrollment|site_performance|regulatory|supply_chain|finance|other — promote to reference product]']
  numerator_value decimal(18,6) [note: 'The numerator used in computing a rate or percentage KRI (e.g., number of protocol deviations, number of completed visits). Stored alongside the denominator to enable independent verification of the observed_value and full audit traceability per ALCOA+ principles.']
  observed_value decimal(18,6) [note: 'The raw numeric value of the KRI/KPI as measured at the reading date. This is the principal quantitative fact of the observation event (e.g., 0.85 for 85% enrollment rate, 3.2 for 3.2 days average SAE reporting lag). Stored at full precision to support downstream statistical analysis.']
  prior_reading_value decimal(18,6) [note: 'The observed value from the immediately preceding review cycle for this KRI. Stored on the current reading record to enable direct trend comparison without requiring a self-join, supporting governance committee dashboards and period-over-period analysis.']
  reading_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which this KRI observation was captured or the data snapshot was taken. Represents the principal business event date for this measurement, distinct from the record creation timestamp. Aligns with the review cycle cadence (weekly, monthly, quarterly).']
  reading_reference_code varchar [note: 'Human-readable business identifier for this KRI reading event, typically formatted as KRI-RDG-{PROGRAM_CODE}-{YYYYMMDD}. Used in governance reports, dashboards, and audit trails to uniquely reference a specific reading without exposing the surrogate key.']
  reading_status varchar [note: 'Lifecycle status of this KRI reading record. \'draft\' = computed but not yet reviewed; \'under_review\' = submitted for governance committee review; \'confirmed\' = formally accepted by the governance body; \'superseded\' = replaced by a corrected reading; \'voided\' = invalidated due to data quality issues.']
  review_cycle_period varchar [note: 'The governance review period this reading belongs to, expressed as a standardized period label (e.g., \'2024-Q1\', \'2024-W23\', \'2024-03\'). Enables time-series alignment across multiple KRIs within the same review cycle for governance committee reporting.']
  review_cycle_type varchar [note: 'Frequency classification of the review cycle during which this reading was generated. Determines the expected cadence for trend analysis and threshold breach escalation.']
  reviewer_commentary varchar [note: 'Free-text narrative commentary provided by the governance committee reviewer or program lead explaining the context of the observed value, root cause of any threshold breach, mitigating factors, or planned actions. Captured at the time of formal review.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The operational system of record from which the underlying data for this KRI reading was extracted (e.g., Medidata Rave for EDC-based metrics, Oracle Siebel CTMS for site performance metrics, Oracle Argus Safety for safety metrics). Supports data lineage and audit traceability. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Medidata Rave|Oracle Siebel CTMS|Oracle Argus Safety|SAS Drug Development|Oracle Clinical One|SAP S/4HANA|Veeva Vault|manual — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  target_value decimal(18,6) [note: 'The planned or aspirational target value for this KRI in the current review cycle, as defined in the program plan or Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP). Distinct from threshold boundaries — represents the desired performance level, enabling variance-from-target analysis.']
  threshold_status varchar [note: 'Red-Amber-Green (RAG) status classification of the observed value against the defined thresholds at the time of reading. \'green\' = within acceptable range; \'amber\' = caution zone requiring heightened monitoring; \'red\' = threshold breached requiring escalation and action; \'not_applicable\' = KRI not relevant for this cycle; \'data_unavailable\' = source data not available for computation.']
  trend_direction varchar [note: 'Directional trend classification comparing the current observed value to the prior period reading. \'improving\' = moving toward green; \'worsening\' = moving toward or deeper into red; \'stable\' = no material change; \'insufficient_data\' = fewer than two data points available; \'new_metric\' = first reading for this KRI.']
  trend_magnitude decimal(18,6) [note: 'The absolute numeric change between the current observed_value and the prior_reading_value, expressed in the same unit_of_measure. Positive values indicate increase; negative values indicate decrease. Enables quantitative trend severity assessment beyond directional classification.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'The unit in which the observed_value is expressed (e.g., \'percentage\', \'days\', \'count\', \'rate_per_site\', \'ratio\'). Essential for correct interpretation of the numeric reading across heterogeneous KRI types.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which this KRI reading record was most recently modified. Required for audit trail completeness under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles. Updated on any field change including status transitions and commentary additions.']
  variance_from_target decimal(18,6) [note: 'The arithmetic difference between the observed_value and the target_value (observed minus target). Negative values indicate underperformance; positive values indicate overperformance relative to target. Stored as a raw operational field to support governance reporting without requiring recalculation.']

  Note: 'Transactional record capturing periodic observed readings of program-level KRIs and KPIs against their defined thresholds. Captures the KRI reference, reading date, observed value, threshold status (green/amber/red), trend direction, data source snapshot reference, and any commentary on the reading. Stores the raw operational measurement events — not aggregated analytics — enabling governance committees to review program health at each review cycle.'
